subject: History
question: What demands did the British Indian Association make to the British Parliament in 1853 AD on the occasion of the renewal of the Charter Act? (a) The Legislature, Executive and Judiciary should have separate jurisdictions. (b) The salaries of high-ranking officials should be reduced. (c) A new legislature should be formed and Indians should be represented in it. (d) Salt, excise and stamp duty should be abolished.
explanation: The right pick is option B. When the Charter Act came up for renewal in 1853, the British Indian Association asked for separation of the legislature, executive and judiciary, a cut in the salaries of high-ranking officials, and abolition of salt, excise and stamp duties — that is (a), (b) and (d). Forming a fresh legislature with Indian representation (c) was not part of this particular memorial, which is exactly what the other options try to slip in.

subject: History
question: Choose the correct pairs: List I - List II (a) Harshcharitra - (i) Kalidas (b) Maalati Madhav - (ii) Vishakhadatta (c) Malvikagnimitra - (iii) Banbhatta (d) Mudrarakshas - (iv) Bhavabhuti
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Harshacharita was written by Banabhatta (iii), Malati Madhava by Bhavabhuti (iv), Malavikagnimitram by Kalidasa (i) and Mudrarakshasa by Vishakhadatta (ii). Fixing even one author you are sure of — Kalidasa or Vishakhadatta — lets you eliminate the wrong sets quickly.

subject: History
question: Which of the following provisions were included in the August Resolution of 1940 AD? (a) After the end of the Second World War, assistance will be provided to establish a fully responsible system of governance in India on the lines of a colony. (b) Some Indian representatives will be included in the board of the Governor General.

options.A: Option (a) is correct, option (b) is incorrect.
options.B: Option (b) is correct, option (a) is incorrect.

explanation: The verified answer here is option C. The August Offer of 1940 did promise both things — post-war help to set up a fully responsible government in India on colonial lines (a), and the inclusion of more Indians in the Governor General's council (b). Since neither statement is faulty, 'both provisions are correct' is the fit.

subject: History
question: Match the following: List I - List II (a) Varahamihira - (i) Panchasiddhantika (b) Vagbhat - (ii) Ashtang Samgraha (c) Ishvara Krishna - (iii) Samkhya Karika (d) Prasatapada - (iv) Vaisheshika Sutra
explanation: The right pick is option D. Varahamihira wrote Panchasiddhantika (i), Vagbhata the Ashtanga Sangraha (ii), Ishvara Krishna the Samkhya Karika (iii) and Prashastapada the work on the Vaisheshika Sutra (iv) — a clean one-to-one order. When a match set runs sequentially like this, double-check it isn't a distractor built to look tidy.

subject: History
question: Which of the following statements apply to Adilshah's Wajir Hemu? (a) Adilshah gave Hemu the title of 'Vikramjit'. (b) Hemu started his career as a Market Superintendent. (c) Hemu had not lost a single battle out of 22 battles. (d) Hemu defeated Akbar in the second battle of Panipat.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. About Hemu, statements (a), (b) and (c) hold: Adilshah gave him the title 'Vikramjit', he began as a market superintendent, and he was unbeaten in his 22 battles. Statement (d) is the odd one out, because Hemu was actually defeated at the Second Battle of Panipat (1556), not the victor over Akbar's side.

subject: History
question: Match the following Sanskrit authors of Mughal India and their works: List I - List II (a) Anantadeva - (i) Chaitanya Charitamritam (b) Gangadhara - (ii) Nirnaya Sindhu (c) Kamlakara Bhatta - (iii) Manorama (d) Krishna Das Kaviraja - (iv) Samskarakaustubha
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Among these Sanskrit scholars of Mughal India, Anantadeva pairs with Samskarakaustubha (iv), Gangadhara with Manorama (iii), Kamlakara Bhatta with Nirnaya Sindhu (ii) and Krishna Das Kaviraja with the Chaitanya Charitamrita (i). Krishna Das Kaviraja–Chaitanya Charitamrita is the safest anchor to start eliminating from.

subject: Geography
question: Match the following: List I - List II (a) Sindhri - (i) Fertilizer Factory (b) Chittaranjan - (ii) Railway Coach Factory (c) Perambur - (iii) Locomotive Factory (d) Pimpri - (iv) Penicillin Factory
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Sindri is the fertilizer factory (i), Chittaranjan the locomotive factory (iii), Perambur the railway coach factory (ii) and Pimpri the penicillin (antibiotics) factory (iv). Location-to-industry pairs like these are pure memory marks — group them by sector while revising.

subject: History
question: __________, a Sanskrit scholar and a staunch social reformer, resigned from government service in 1864 to devote himself to the cause of social reforms.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. It was Vishnushastri Pandit, the Sanskrit scholar and staunch social reformer, who quit government service in 1864 to devote himself to social reform, particularly widow remarriage. Note the year 1864 as your quick tag for him.

subject: History
question: Who among the following was arrested in the Bhusawal Bomb Case?
explanation: The right pick is option A. Sadashiv Malkapurkar is the name linked with the arrests in the Bhusawal Bomb Case. With single-name factual questions, don't overthink the famous-sounding distractors — go with the one you have actually read in the source.

subject: History
question: What are the three special practices that are included in the practice of Sufism?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The three special spiritual practices associated with Sufi sadhana are Mujahada, Zikr and Murakabah. The other options mix in terms like Wasl and Tawajjuh to blur the set, so lock the trio firmly.

subject: Geography
question: Meteorologist R.L. Singh (1971) has classified the Indian climate region into how many zones?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. R.L. Singh's 1971 classification splits India's climate into ten regions. Number-based facts like this reward a quick flashcard — R.L. Singh = ten climatic zones.

subject: History
question: Name the social reformer described in the following sentences: (a) He showed courage in practising what he preached. (b) He was a staunch supporter of women's education. (c) He was against child marriages; marriages of his sons and daughters were performed only when they were old enough to choose their partners. (d) As he advocated widow remarriage, he gave consent to the remarriage of his own daughter who was a widow.
explanation: The right pick is option B. The clues — courage to practise what he preached, firm support for women's education, marrying his children only when they could choose partners, and consenting to his widowed daughter's remarriage — all point to R.G. Bhandarkar. Read every clue in a description question; one line often rules out a close name.

subject: History
question: Choose the correct pairs of authors: List I - List II (a) Storia-Do-Mogor - (i) Burnier (b) Travel in Mughal Empire - (ii) Niccolao Manucci (c) Early Travels in India - (iii) William Foster (d) Historical Fragment - (iv) Robert
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Storia do Mogor is by Niccolao Manucci (ii), Travels in the Mughal Empire by Bernier (i), Early Travels in India by William Foster (iii) and the Historical Fragment by Robert (iv). Travel-account authors are a recurring MPSC favourite, so it pays to memorise them in pairs.

subject: History
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Jiyauddin Barni - (i) Fatuh-Us-Salatin (b) Khwaja Abu Malik Isami - (ii) Kitab-Ur-Rahlah (c) Ibn Batuta - (iii) Tariq-e-Salatin Afgana (d) Ahmed Yadgar - (iv) Fatwa-e-Janhadari
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Ziauddin Barani wrote Fatwa-e-Jahandari (iv), Isami the Futuh-us-Salatin (i), Ibn Batuta the Kitab-ur-Rehla (ii) and Ahmed Yadgar the Tarikh-e-Salatin-e-Afghana (iii). Ibn Batuta–Rehla is the giveaway pair to anchor on.

subject: History
question: Match the following dynasties and their kingdoms: List I - List II (a) Maitrakas - (i) Valabhi (b) Chahumanas - (ii) Sakambhari (c) Gurjaras - (iii) Broach (d) Paramaras - (iv) Dhara
explanation: The right pick is option A. Maitrakas ruled from Valabhi (i), the Chahamanas from Sakambhari (ii), the Gurjaras from Broach (iii) and the Paramaras from Dhara (iv). Capitals of early dynasties are steady scoring items — tie each dynasty to its seat of power.

subject: Geography
question: Observe the following statements: (a) As per the State Mineral Policy 1999, iron, sulphur, gold, copper and lead mineral production was opened to the private sector. (b) Konkan region has the highest mineral availability after Nagpur region. (c) Maharashtra State Mining Corporation was established in 1973.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. All three statements check out: the 1999 State Mineral Policy opened iron, sulphur, gold, copper and lead to the private sector, Konkan ranks next to Nagpur in mineral availability, and the Maharashtra State Mining Corporation was set up in 1973. When each statement is independently true, 'all correct' is the honest choice.

subject: Geography
question: Match the following forest circles with their share in percentage to total forest area of Maharashtra: Forest circles of Maharashtra - Percentage to total forest area (Economic Survey of Maharashtra 2024) (a) Gadchiroli - (i) 12.5 (b) Nagpur - (ii) 20.8 (c) Dhule - (iii) 9.5 (d) Thane - (iv) 10.4
explanation: The right pick is option A. As per the Economic Survey of Maharashtra 2024, Gadchiroli's share is 20.8% (ii), Nagpur 12.5% (i), Dhule 10.4% (iv) and Thane 9.5% (iii). With percentage-match questions, pin the largest figure first — here 20.8% to Gadchiroli — and the rest fall into place.

subject: Geography
question: Consider the following statements: (a) The Aravalli is one of the youngest fold mountains in the world. (b) The Aravalli is rich in minerals such as marble, granite, zinc and copper. (c) The Aravalli mountain ranges have supported mining and construction activities for centuries. (d) Historical forts such as Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh and Ranthambore are situated here.
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Statements (b), (c) and (d) about the Aravalli are correct — rich in marble, granite, zinc and copper; long a base for mining and construction; and home to forts like Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh and Ranthambore. Statement (a) is the flaw, because the Aravalli is one of the oldest fold mountains, not the youngest.

subject: Polity
question: As per the Government Resolution dated October 9, 2024, what is the minimum population requirement for establishment of a 'Gram Panchayat' in Banjara/Laman/Labhan Tanda areas?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The Government Resolution dated 9 October 2024 fixes the minimum population at 700 for setting up a Gram Panchayat in Banjara / Laman / Labhan Tanda areas. GR-based numbers are current-affairs staples — tag the date with the figure.

subject: History
question: For what process is 'Time Lapse Analysis' (Kalantar Sanskar) used in the time measurement process? (a) Leap Year (b) Adhik Mass (c) Kshay Mass (d) Tithi Vridhhi - lope
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. In calendar reckoning, the 'Kalantar Sanskar' correction is applied across all of these — the leap year, Adhik Mass, Kshay Mass and Tithi Vridhhi–lope. Since every listed item genuinely uses the correction, the (a), (b), (c), (d) option is the honest answer.

subject: Economy
question: What was the per hectare yield of Rice and Wheat in the year 2023-2024 in India?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. For 2023-24 in India, the per hectare yield works out to 2882 kg for rice and 3559 kg for wheat. The distractors sit close on purpose, so trust the exact figures you revised rather than a rough guess.

subject: Geography
question: Match the regional divisions of the Himalayas (List I) with their West-East extension (List II): List I (Regional Divisions of Himalayas) - List II (West-East Extension) (a) The Punjab Himalayas - (i) Sutlej to Kali (b) The Kumaon Himalayas - (ii) Kali to Tista (c) The Nepal Himalayas - (iii) Tista to Brahmaputra (d) The Assam Himalayas - (iv) Indus to Sutlej
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. West to east, the Punjab Himalayas run from the Indus to the Sutlej (iv), the Kumaon from the Sutlej to the Kali (i), the Nepal from the Kali to the Tista (ii) and the Assam from the Tista to the Brahmaputra (iii). Trace the rivers left to right and the sequence sorts itself out.

subject: Geography
question: Match the following: List I (Country) - List II (Local Names of Shifting Cultivation) (a) Congo and Central Africa - (i) Roca (b) North-East India - (ii) Masole (c) Vietnam - (iii) Jhum (d) Brazil - (iv) Ray
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. The local names of shifting cultivation are Masole in Congo and Central Africa (ii), Jhum in North-East India (iii), Ray in Vietnam (iv) and Roca in Brazil (i). Jhum for North-East India is the giveaway most students already know.

subject: Geography
question: Find the correct ascending order of the following atmospheric layers from the earth's surface: (a) Mesosphere (b) Thermosphere (c) Troposphere (d) Stratopause (e) Stratosphere (f) Mesopause (g) Tropopause
explanation: The right pick is option C. Rising from the surface, the layers go Troposphere (c), Tropopause (g), Stratosphere (e), Stratopause (d), Mesosphere (a), Mesopause (f) and Thermosphere (b). The trick is that each 'sphere' is capped by its 'pause' before the next sphere begins.

subject: History
question: The village agricultural lands were jointly held by the village communities and members were responsible for the payment of the land revenue. What was this system?
explanation: The right pick is option B. When village lands were held jointly by the community and the members were collectively responsible for paying the land revenue, that arrangement is the Mahalwari system. Contrast it with Zamindari (through landlords) and Ryotwari (individual cultivators) to avoid the mix-up.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statement/s is/are not correct? (a) UN Conference on Environment and Development was held at Montreal in 1992. (b) Bruntland Report, 1987 was related with the UN second conference at Nairobi. (c) The aim of the Kyoto Protocol was to address the problems of anthropogenic climate change.
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Statements (a) and (b) are the wrong ones: the 1992 UN Conference on Environment and Development was held at Rio de Janeiro, not Montreal, and the 1987 Brundtland Report was not tied to a Nairobi second conference. Statement (c) on the Kyoto Protocol's aim is accurate, so only (a) and (b) are incorrect.

subject: General Studies
question: Assertion (A): An ecosystem is a natural resource system. Reason (R): An ecosystem is a single concept in which the physical environment (physical or inorganic factors) and biotic factors (humans, animals, microorganisms and plants) live together in a single framework. Which one of the following is correct?

options.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options.B: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

explanation: The right pick is option A. Both the assertion and the reason are true, and the reason genuinely explains the assertion: an ecosystem is a natural resource system precisely because it binds the physical environment and the biotic components into one working framework. When R directly gives the 'why' behind A, this is the option to choose.

subject: Geography
question: Match the following: List I (Districts) - List II (2001-2011 decadal growth in population (%)) (a) Thane - (i) 25.50 (b) Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar - (ii) 30.4 (c) Pune - (iii) 27.33 (d) Nandurbar - (iv) 35.94
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. For 2001-2011 decadal growth, Thane stands at 35.94% (iv), Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar at 27.33% (iii), Pune at 30.4% (ii) and Nandurbar at 25.50% (i). Anchoring the highest growth to Thane makes the rest easy to slot.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following statement/s are correct? (a) There are 61 satellites to Uranus planet in the solar system. (b) The average distance of Mercury planet from the Sun is 58 million k.m. (c) The average distance from the Sun to the planet Uranus is 4495 million k.m.
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Statement (b) is fine — Mercury sits about 58 million km from the Sun. But (a) and (c) are the faulty ones: Uranus does not have 61 satellites, and its average distance from the Sun is not 4495 million km (that figure is closer to Neptune). So 'statements (a) and (c) are not correct' is the fit.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statement/s is/are related to the Montreal Protocol? (a) Reduction of the production and consumption of ozone depleting Chloro-Fluoro-Carbons (CFCs) in order to check depletion of the ozone layer. (b) Work for the protection of the earth and its environment, maintenance of ecological balance and to enrich biodiversity. (c) Study of pollution at the pole.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The Montreal Protocol is specifically about cutting the production and consumption of ozone-depleting CFCs to protect the ozone layer — that is statement (a) alone. Broad environmental protection (b) and polar pollution study (c) belong to other frameworks, not this treaty.

subject: Reasoning
question: Arrange the following major greenhouse gases in descending order according to the percentage of their contribution to global warming:

options.A: Carbon dioxide, Methane, Nitrous oxide, Fluorinated Gases
options.B: Carbon dioxide, Methane, Fluorinated Gases, Nitrous oxide
options.C: Methane, Carbon dioxide, Nitrous oxide, Fluorinated Gases
options.D: Methane, Nitrous oxide, Fluorinated Gases, Carbon dioxide

explanation: The verified answer here is option A. By their share in global warming, the descending order is Carbon dioxide, Methane, Nitrous oxide and then Fluorinated gases. CO2 leading and fluorinated gases trailing is the anchor that rules out the other sequences.

subject: Polity
question: With reference to the 'National Policy on the Voluntary Sector-2007', consider the following statements regarding the characteristics of Voluntary Organizations (VOs): (a) These organizations are private in nature and separate from the Government. (b) They do not return profits generated to their owners or directors. (c) They are self-governing and are controlled by the Government. (d) They are registered organizations or informal groups with defined aims and objectives. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Under the National Policy on the Voluntary Sector-2007, VOs are private and separate from government (a), do not return profits to owners (b), and are registered or informal groups with defined aims (d). Statement (c) is the flaw — VOs are self-governing but are not controlled by the government — so (a), (b) and (d) hold.

subject: Economy
question: The periods of the First and Fourth Five Year Plans are __________ and __________ respectively.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The First Five Year Plan ran 1951-56 and the Fourth Five Year Plan ran 1969-74. The gap before the Fourth Plan (the 'plan holiday' of 1966-69) is the detail that fixes 1969 as its start.

subject: Economy
question: Match the pairs: Poverty Eradication Programs in India - Year of launch (a) Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP) - (i) 2001 (b) Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) - (ii) 1989 (c) Jawahar Rojgar Yojana - (iii) 1983 (d) Sampoorna Grameen Rojgar Yojana - (iv) 1978
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. By launch year, IRDP is 1978 (iv), RLEGP 1983 (iii), Jawahar Rojgar Yojana 1989 (ii) and Sampoorna Grameen Rojgar Yojana 2001 (i). Ordering these poverty programmes chronologically is the cleanest way to match them.

subject: General Studies
question: Who laid the concept of Biome?
explanation: The right pick is option B. The concept of the Biome was put forward by F. Clements in 1916. The other name-year pairs are placed to tempt you, so hold on to 'Clements, 1916' as your fixed tag.

subject: Geography
question: Consider the following statements: Statement-I: As per projection on 1st March 2026, the total projected population of Maharashtra is about 12.93 crore. Statement-II: During the same period, the urban population of Maharashtra is higher than its rural population. Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?

options.A: Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect.
options.B: Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct.
options.C: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct.
options.D: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are incorrect.

explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Statement-I is right — Maharashtra's projected population on 1 March 2026 is about 12.93 crore — but Statement-II is wrong, since the urban population is not projected to exceed the rural population for that period. So Statement-I correct, Statement-II incorrect.

subject: Geography
question: Consider the following statements: (a) India's population density was higher than South Korea in 2017. (b) India's population density was lower than Bangladesh in 2017. Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
explanation: The right pick is option B. Only statement (b) holds — in 2017 India's population density was lower than Bangladesh's, which is one of the most densely populated countries. Statement (a) fails because India's density was actually lower than, not higher than, South Korea's that year.

subject: Polity
question: Under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961, which of the following statement/s is/are incorrect regarding the employment regulations for women before and after childbirth? (a) The Act mandates six weeks of leave after childbirth. (b) The Act mandates six weeks of leave before and ten weeks after childbirth. (c) The Act applies to all establishments without considering minimum number of employees. (d) The Act provides maternity and other benefits.
explanation: The right pick is option D. The incorrect statements are (b) and (c): the Maternity Benefit Act does not fix six weeks before and ten after in that form, and it does not apply to every establishment regardless of size — a minimum employee threshold applies. Statements (a) and (d) are correct, which is why (b) and (c) is the answer.

subject: Economy
question: Consider the following statements regarding the Public Distribution System (PDS) in Maharashtra: (a) By December 2025, there were 270.48 lakh ration card holders in the state. (b) As of 31 October 2025, 51,636 Fair price shops were functioning in the state. (c) By October 2025, about 1.55 crore families received food grains through Aadhaar-based biometric authentication. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Statements (b) and (c) are correct — about 51,636 fair price shops functioning as of 31 October 2025, and roughly 1.55 crore families served via Aadhaar-based biometric authentication by October 2025. Statement (a)'s ration-card-holder figure does not match, so only (b) and (c) stand.

subject: Economy
question: On the basis of Tendulkar Committee estimation, __________% of the rural population and __________% of the urban population was below the poverty line in 2004-05.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. On the Tendulkar Committee's 2004-05 estimate, 41.8% of the rural and 25.7% of the urban population were below the poverty line. Keep the rural figure higher than the urban one as a sanity check against the swapped distractors.

subject: Economy
question: Consider the following statements: (a) In the overall Capital Stock, David Pearce and Jeremy Warford include man-made physical capital, human capital and environmental capital. (b) According to David Pearce and Jeremy Warford, sustainable development implies that man-made physical capital, human capital and environmental capital decrease in the growth process. Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Statement (a) is correct — Pearce and Warford count man-made physical, human and environmental capital within the overall capital stock. Statement (b) reverses their idea: sustainable development does not require these to decrease in the growth process, so only (a) is right.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following are disadvantages of subdivision and fragmentation of land holding? (a) Wastage of Land (b) Disguised Unemployment (c) Easy to Land Management (d) Low Productivity
explanation: The right pick is option B. Fragmentation of holdings brings wastage of land (a), disguised unemployment (b) and low productivity (d). Statement (c) — 'easy land management' — is actually a benefit, not a drawback, so it drops out and (a), (b) and (d) remain.

subject: Economy
question: Social security measures are typically divided into two main categories. Which of the following best represents these categories? (a) Social insurance (b) Social welfare (c) Social assistance (d) Social inclusion
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Social security is usually split into two broad heads — social insurance (a) and social assistance (c). Social welfare and social inclusion are wider ideas, not the two core categories, so (a) and (c) is the tidy pair.

subject: Science
question: The net electric charge that passes through the surface per unit time is called __________.
explanation: The right pick is option A. Net electric charge crossing a surface per unit time is, by definition, the electric current. The other terms describe voltage or motion, not the rate of charge flow, so 'electric current' is the clean answer.

subject: Economy
question: As pointed out by the Tendulkar Committee, the concept of poverty is associated with socially perceived deprivation with respect to basic human needs like __________. (a) the need to be adequately nourished (b) the need to be reasonably sheltered (c) the need to be decently clothed (d) the need to escape avoidable diseases (e) the need to be minimally educated Which of the above point/s is/are correct?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Tendulkar Committee framed poverty around socially perceived deprivation across all these needs — adequate nourishment, reasonable shelter, decent clothing, escape from avoidable disease and minimal education. Since every point belongs to the list, 'all of the above' is the fit.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following statement/s is/are correct regarding National Food Security Act - 2013? (a) Women empowerment is a feature of the National Food Security Act - 2013. (b) State Food Commission is the monitoring, reviewing and implementing authority of this Act - 2013.
explanation: The right pick is option A. Statement (a) is correct — women empowerment is a built-in feature of the National Food Security Act, 2013, which treats the eldest woman as the head of the household for the ration card. Statement (b)'s description of the State Food Commission's role does not match the Act's wording, so only (a) stands.

subject: Economy
question: Consider the following statements in the context of the aims of the National Population Policy, 2000: (a) Promote delayed marriage for girls, not earlier than age 18 and preferably after 21 years of age. (b) The long-term objective is to achieve a stable population by 2030. Which of the statement/s given above is/are incorrect?
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Both statements are wrong here — the age framing in (a) does not match the National Population Policy 2000's actual aim, and the long-term stable-population target in the policy is set for 2045, not 2030 as in (b). So both (a) and (b) are incorrect.

subject: Science
question: According to the Second Law of thermodynamics, how much will be the efficiency of a heat engine?
explanation: The right pick is option D. By the Second Law of thermodynamics, no heat engine can be perfectly efficient — some heat is always rejected — so its efficiency is always less than one. 'One' would mean a perfect engine, which the law forbids.

subject: Science
question: If the refractive index of the medium is more than the refractive index of a double concave or double convex lens, then the focal length of the lens becomes __________.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. If the surrounding medium has a higher refractive index than the lens, the lens's behaviour reverses and its focal length turns negative. This is why a convex lens can act divergent inside a denser medium — a favourite conceptual twist.

subject: Science
question: Predict which of the following organisms will have the highest percentage of unsaturated phospholipids in their membranes:
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Organisms in very cold habitats keep more unsaturated phospholipids in their membranes to stay fluid at low temperatures, so the Antarctic fish leads here. Warm-habitat animals like the desert snake need fewer unsaturated lipids.

subject: Science
question: Match the quantities in Column I with their dimensions in Column II: Column I - Column II (a) Permeability (μ₀) - (i) ML²T⁻¹ (b) Coefficient of Viscosity (η) - (ii) MLT⁻²I⁻² (c) Planck's Constant (h) - (iii) ML⁻¹T⁻¹ (Where M is mass, L is length, T is time and I is the current)
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Permeability μ₀ carries the dimensions MLT⁻²I⁻² (ii), the coefficient of viscosity η is ML⁻¹T⁻¹ (iii) and Planck's constant h is ML²T⁻¹ (i). Deriving each dimension from a defining formula is safer than memorising the whole grid.

subject: Science
question: Select the organelle that contains its own DNA and 70S ribosomes but is found in eukaryotic cells.
explanation: The right pick is option B. The mitochondrion is the eukaryotic organelle that carries its own DNA and 70S (bacterial-type) ribosomes — the classic evidence for the endosymbiotic theory. Lysosomes, Golgi and ER have no genome of their own.

subject: Science
question: How does the nuclear force behave when the spin of nucleons are parallel?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. The nuclear force is spin-dependent, and when the spins of the nucleons are parallel the attraction between them is stronger. This spin dependence is a key reason the deuteron exists in its bound state.

subject: Science
question: Apomixis is a type of reproduction that results in the development of a/an __________.

options.A: New organism without fusion of gametes
options.B: New organism from fusion products of gametes

explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Apomixis is asexual seed formation, so it produces a new organism without any fusion of gametes. That 'no fertilisation' point is exactly what separates it from normal sexual reproduction.

subject: Science
question: Identify the correct statements about jumping genes: (a) These are genes that can change their positions. (b) These are also called transposons. (c) These were firstly discovered by Barbara McClintock in 1965.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. As per the key, all three statements about jumping genes are accepted — they can change their positions, they are also called transposons, and they are credited to Barbara McClintock. That makes 'all of the above' the marked choice.

subject: Science
question: A polypeptide hormone Calcitonin (CT) is produced by parafollicular cells of the __________ gland.
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Calcitonin is secreted by the parafollicular (C) cells of the thyroid gland, and it helps lower blood calcium. Linking 'parafollicular cells' straight to the thyroid is the quickest route to the answer.

subject: Science
question: Evolution of marsupials and placental mammals is an example of __________.
explanation: The right pick is option B. Marsupials and placental mammals developed similar body forms independently in different regions — that is convergent evolution, where unrelated groups arrive at like adaptations. Divergent evolution would be the opposite, one ancestor branching into different forms.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following is not a natural plant growth hormone?
explanation: The right pick is option C. Auxins, ethylene and abscisic acid are all genuine natural plant growth regulators, but 'methylene' is not a plant hormone at all — it is the odd one out. Watch for such near-sound-alikes slipped into science lists.

subject: Science
question: During which stage of HIV infection do the symptoms of AIDS usually appear?

options.A: When the infecting retrovirus enters host cells
options.B: When viral DNA is produced by reverse transcriptase enzyme
options.C: When HIV replicates rapidly in helper T-lymphocytes and damages a large number of these cells
options.D: Within 15 days of sexual contact with an infected person

explanation: The verified answer here is option C. AIDS symptoms typically surface only when HIV multiplies rapidly in the helper T-lymphocytes and destroys large numbers of them, collapsing immunity. The earlier steps — entry into host cells and reverse transcription — happen well before symptoms appear.

subject: Science
question: A colloidal dispersion of one liquid in another immiscible with it is called __________.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. A colloidal dispersion of one liquid within another it cannot mix with is called an emulsion — milk being the everyday example. Foam is gas-in-liquid and gel is a different colloidal state, so they don't fit.

subject: Science
question: Chloramphenicol is a __________. (a) Narrow spectrum antibiotic (b) Broad spectrum antibiotic (c) Limited spectrum antibiotic (d) Antiseptic drug
explanation: The right pick is option B. Chloramphenicol is a broad spectrum antibiotic, effective against a wide range of bacteria — so only statement (b) is right. It is not narrow or limited spectrum, nor a mere antiseptic.

subject: Science
question: Identify the mineral acid/acids from the following acids: (a) Oxalic acid (b) Sulphuric acid (c) Nitric acid (d) Hydrochloric acid
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Mineral (inorganic) acids here are sulphuric (b), nitric (c) and hydrochloric (d). Oxalic acid (a) is an organic acid, which is why it is left out and (b), (c) and (d) form the set.

subject: Science
question: The oxidation states of all elements in any allotropic form is __________.
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. An element in its allotropic (free, uncombined) form is not bonded to any other element, so its oxidation state is zero — think of O₂, O₃, graphite or diamond. This 'free element = zero' rule is a reliable shortcut.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following elements has the highest electronegativity?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Fluorine has the highest electronegativity of all elements, sitting at the top-right pull of the periodic table. Oxygen, nitrogen and chlorine are all electronegative too, but none beats fluorine.

subject: Polity
question: Under which of the closure motions are only important clauses taken up for debate and voting, and the intervening clauses skipped over and taken as passed?
explanation: The right pick is option C. Under the kangaroo closure, the presiding officer allows only selected important clauses to be debated and voted on, while the clauses in between are 'jumped over' and deemed passed. The name itself hints at the skipping motion.

subject: Polity
question: Select the correct statements from the following: (a) Prohibition is issued by a Higher Court to a Lower Court or tribunal and is intended to prohibit it from exceeding its jurisdiction. (b) Writ of prohibition can be issued against administrative agencies. (c) Writ of prohibition is issued against judicial and quasi-judicial bodies.
explanation: The right pick is option B. Statements (a) and (c) are correct — a writ of prohibition is issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to keep it within jurisdiction, and it lies against judicial and quasi-judicial bodies. It does not run against purely administrative agencies, so (b) drops out.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following statement/s is/are incorrect? (a) B.N. Rau was advisor of the Constituent Assembly. (b) B.N. Rau prepared draft Constitution in October, 1947. (c) A draft Constitution prepared by B.N. Rau contained 310 Articles and 8 Schedules. (d) A draft Constitution prepared by B.N. Rau contained 243 Articles and 13 Schedules.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Only statement (c) is incorrect — B.N. Rau's draft Constitution did not contain 310 Articles and 8 Schedules. His draft is placed at 243 Articles and 13 Schedules, so statement (d) is the correct figure and (c) is the flawed one.

subject: Polity
question: Select the incorrect statement from the following:

options.A: The President can pardon sentences inflicted by Court Martial while the Governor cannot.
options.B: The President is bound to give reasons for pardoning power.
options.C: The petitioner for mercy has no right to an oral hearing by the President.
options.D: The pardoning power is to be exercised by the President on the advice of the Union Cabinet.

explanation: The right pick is option B, because the question asks for the incorrect statement. The President is not bound to give reasons while exercising the pardoning power, so that claim is false. The other three — pardoning court-martial sentences, no right to an oral hearing, and acting on the Cabinet's advice — are all accurate.

subject: Polity
question: Who determines the remuneration of the Advocate General for the State?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Under Article 165, the Advocate General holds office during the Governor's pleasure and receives such remuneration as the Governor determines. So it is the Governor, not Parliament or the President, who fixes the pay.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following matters are included in the 12th Schedule of the Constitution of India? (a) Promotion of artistic vision, fire fighting services (b) Cremation ground and electric crematorium (c) Market & fairs, rural housing (d) Protection of the interest of the handicapped and mentally retarded, protection of the environment.
explanation: The right pick is option A. The Twelfth Schedule subjects here include promotion of artistic vision and fire services (a), cremation grounds and electric crematoria (b), and protection of the interests of the handicapped and the environment (d). Statement (c) is the one that does not belong in this set, so (a), (b) and (d) stand.

subject: Polity
question: Find the correct statements regarding Inter-State Council: (a) It is mentioned in Article 263. (b) The President is empowered to establish it. (c) The President of India has never exercised this power and has not so far established any such Inter-State Council under power of Article 263.
explanation: The right pick is option B. Statements (a) and (b) hold — the Inter-State Council is mentioned in Article 263 and the President is empowered to establish it. Statement (c) is false, because the Council was in fact set up in 1990, so the 'never established' claim doesn't survive.

subject: Polity
question: The National Commission to review the working of the Constitution has recommended that, for effectuating fundamental duties, these are __________. (a) Duty to vote at elections (b) To pay taxes (c) Duty of industrial organisations to provide education to children of their employees (d) To foster a spirit of family values and responsible parenthood in the matter of education, physical and moral well-being of children
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. The National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution recommended adding the duty to vote (a) and the duty to pay taxes (b) among the fundamental duties. The industrial-education and parenthood ideas in (c) and (d) were not part of that recommendation.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following statements about the Veto power of the President are correct? (a) He/she can withhold his/her assent to the bill. (b) Governor may reserve a bill for consideration of the President in any case he/she thinks fit. (c) President can return a bill to Parliament for reconsideration with a message to both houses.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. All three points about the President's veto are correct — withholding assent to a bill, the Governor reserving a bill for the President's consideration, and the President returning a bill to Parliament with a message for reconsideration. So (a), (b) and (c) together is the answer.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following statement/s are correct? (a) According to K.C. Wheare, Indian Federalism is 'quasi-federal'. (b) According to Morris Jones, Indian Federalism is 'bargaining federalism'. (c) According to C.F. Strong, Indian Federalism is 'less federalism'. (d) According to Granville Austin, Indian Federalism is 'Cooperative federalism'.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Each label matches its scholar — Wheare called Indian federalism 'quasi-federal', Morris Jones 'bargaining federalism', C.F. Strong 'less federalism' and Granville Austin 'cooperative federalism'. Since all four descriptions are correctly attributed, everything holds.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following Article of the Indian Constitution establishes the independent office of the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Article 148 sets up the independent office of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. Don't confuse it with the neighbouring articles — 149 deals with the CAG's duties and powers, not the creation of the office.

subject: Polity
question: According to simple majority of the Parliament, which types of Constitutional Amendments shall be made? Choose the correct statement/s: (a) Establishment of new States. (b) Amendment related to President's emoluments and allowances. (c) Amendment related to Directive Principles of State Policy. (d) Delimitation of Constituencies.
explanation: The right pick is option C. Amendments made by simple majority include the formation of new states (a), changes to the President's emoluments and allowances (b) and delimitation of constituencies (d). The DPSP amendment in (c) is not in this simple-majority basket, so (a), (b) and (d) is the set.

subject: Polity
question: The provision of double citizenship to overseas citizens of India applies only to those in some specified countries. These are: (a) Finland (b) Israel (c) Republic of Cyprus (d) Portugal
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Per the key, the overseas-citizenship (double citizenship) provision applies to those in all the listed countries — Finland, Israel, Republic of Cyprus and Portugal. So 'all of the above' is the marked choice.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following statement/s is incorrect about the Committee on Public Undertakings of the Parliament? (a) Pandit Nehru recommended the creation of this Committee in 1963. (b) The Chairman of this Committee is appointed only from amongst its members who are drawn from the Lok Sabha. (c) From 1974, 15 members are elected from Lok Sabha and 7 members are elected from Rajya Sabha on this Committee. (d) The tenure of members of this Committee is two years.
explanation: The right pick is option B. The incorrect statements are (a) and (d): the Committee on Public Undertakings was set up in 1964 (not on a 1963 Nehru recommendation), and the tenure of its members is one year, not two. Statements (b) and (c) about its composition are accurate.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Who among the following became the 38th President of Chile?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Jose Antonio Kast Rist is the one recorded as the 38th President of Chile. With current-affairs 'who became' questions, pair the name firmly with the office and number to shake off familiar distractors.

subject: Polity
question: Match the correct pairs of the following articles of the Constitution of India with the subject: Subject - Articles (a) Language to be used in the complaint for redressal of grievances - (i) 350 A (b) Facilities for education in mother tongue at primary level - (ii) 351 (c) Special officer for linguistic minority communities - (iii) 350 (d) Directive for development of Hindi Language - (iv) 350 B
explanation: The right pick is option D. Article 350 covers the language for grievance representations (a), Article 350A the mother-tongue instruction at primary stage (b), Article 350B the special officer for linguistic minorities (c) and Article 351 the directive to develop Hindi (d). Grouping the 350 family together makes this match quick.

subject: Current Affairs
question: State the correct statements regarding Chabahar Port: (a) Chabahar port in Iran gives India direct access to Afghanistan, bypassing Pakistan. (b) Chabahar port provides a strategic counterweight to China, which has built Karachi port in Pakistan. (c) India Ports Global Limited is the special purpose vehicle created to operate and develop the Chabahar Port. (d) The 2026-27 budget has not allocated any funds for the Chabahar Port. Which of the above statements are correct?
explanation: The right pick is option C. Statements (a), (c) and (d) about Chabahar hold — it gives India access to Afghanistan bypassing Pakistan, India Ports Global Limited is the SPV running it, and the specified budget point is accurate. Statement (b) is the flaw, since China's port project in the region is Gwadar, not Karachi.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Select the correct and incorrect statement/s from the following: (a) The 31st National Children's Science Congress (NCSC) was held in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh from 3rd to 6th January, 2026. (b) The 31st National Children's Science Congress (NCSC) was held on theme "Understanding ecosystem for Health and Wellbeing".
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Statement (b) is correct — the 31st National Children's Science Congress carried the theme on understanding the ecosystem for health and wellbeing. Statement (a) is the incorrect one, as its venue/date details do not match, so 'b correct, a incorrect' is the fit.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Which of the following is proposed as the third new district of Goa by the Chief Minister of Goa?
explanation: The right pick is option A. Kushavati is the one proposed as Goa's third new district by the Chief Minister. When close-sounding Goan place names are offered together, go strictly with the one named in the announcement.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Select the correct statements from the following about PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana: (a) The Union Cabinet approved the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana on 16th July, 2025. (b) The scheme identifies 100 districts based on low productivity, low cropping intensity and less credit disbursement. (c) The scheme will be governed through a four-tier implementation structure.
explanation: The right pick is option A. Statements (a) and (b) are correct — the Union Cabinet approved the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana on 16 July 2025, and it targets 100 districts chosen for low productivity, low cropping intensity and low credit disbursement. The four-tier structure claim in (c) does not match, so only (a) and (b) hold.

subject: Current Affairs
question: According to the Economic Survey of India 2025-26: (a) An increase in immigration control across countries favoured by Indian emigrants may reduce the growth in remittances. (b) Global trade is being increasingly influenced by geopolitical alignments and economic statecraft. (c) Trade policy at the global level is driven by protectionist and retaliatory tariffs. (d) Geoeconomic factors are now critical determinants in shaping key bilateral trade patterns. Which of the above statement is/are correct?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. All four observations of the Economic Survey of India 2025-26 hold — tighter immigration control can slow remittance growth, global trade is shaped by geopolitical alignments and statecraft, protectionist and retaliatory tariffs drive trade policy, and geoeconomic factors now steer bilateral trade patterns. So every statement is correct.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Women Technology Parks (WTPs) have been set up in which of the following states to promote gender equality and empower women through science and technology based solutions? (a) Gujarat (b) Tamilnadu (c) Sikkim (d) Maharashtra (e) Uttar Pradesh
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Women Technology Parks have been set up in all the states listed — Gujarat, Tamilnadu, Sikkim, Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh — to empower women through science and technology solutions. Hence 'all of the above'.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Match the pairs: (Nobel Prize, 2025) List A - List B (a) Discovery of macroscopic quantum mechanical tunnelling and energy quantisation in an electric circuit - (i) Maria Carina Machado (b) The development of metal-organic frameworks - (ii) Fred Ramsdell (c) Discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance - (iii) Richard Robson (d) Promoting democratic rights for the people of Venezuela - (iv) John Clarke
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. For the 2025 Nobel Prizes, the quantum-tunnelling-in-a-circuit work goes to John Clarke (iv), metal-organic frameworks to Richard Robson (iii), peripheral immune tolerance to Fred Ramsdell (ii) and the Venezuela democracy award to Maria Corina Machado (i). Anchoring the Peace laureate to Venezuela fixes the whole chain.

subject: Current Affairs
question: During which tenure did Shri Suresh Kalmadi hold the presidency of the 'Asian Athletics Association'?
explanation: The right pick is option D. Suresh Kalmadi headed the Asian Athletics Association during the 2000 to 2013 tenure. For sports-administration questions, tie the person to the exact term of office rather than a rough decade.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Which of the following statement/s given is/are correct? (a) The National Institutional Ranking Framework provides a methodology to rank educational institutions across the country. (b) The National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) was launched in 2020. (c) The ranking is based on five parameters. (d) Indian Institute of Technology Madras tops in the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) category.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Statements (a), (c) and (d) hold — NIRF provides a methodology to rank institutions nationwide, the ranking rests on five parameters, and IIT Madras tops the SDG category. Statement (b) is the slip, since NIRF was launched in 2015, not 2020, so (a), (c) and (d) is correct.

subject: History
question: Arrange the classical languages of India in an appropriate order as per their recognition: (a) Telugu (b) Sanskrit (c) Pali (d) Odia (e) Tamil
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. By order of classical-language recognition, Tamil came first (e), then Sanskrit (b), Telugu (a), Odia (d) and Pali (c). Anchoring Tamil as the earliest recognised classical language fixes the whole sequence.

subject: Current Affairs
question: How many gold, silver and bronze medals did India secure at the 'World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2026', New Delhi?
explanation: The right pick is option B. At the World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2026 in New Delhi, India secured 75 gold, 69 silver and 64 bronze. Note that gold outnumbers silver and silver outnumbers bronze here — a quick check against the swapped options.

subject: History
question: ब्रिटीश इंडियन असोसिएशन या संस्थेने इ.स. 1853 मध्ये चार्टर कायद्याच्या नूतनीकरण प्रसंगी संसदेकडे कोणत्या मागण्या केल्या होत्या? (a) कायदेमंडळ, कार्यकारी मंडळ व न्यायमंडळ यांचे कार्यक्षेत्र स्वतंत्र असावे. (b) मोठमोठ्या उच्च पदांचे वेतन कमी करण्यात यावे. (c) नव्या कायदेमंडळाची निर्मिती करून त्यात भारतीयांना प्रतिनिधीत्व द्यावे. (d) मीठ, अबकारी व मुद्रा कर समाप्त करण्यात यावा.
explanation: इथे बरोबर पर्याय B आहे. 1853 मध्ये चार्टर कायद्याच्या नूतनीकरणाच्या वेळी ब्रिटीश इंडियन असोसिएशनने कायदेमंडळ, कार्यकारी व न्यायमंडळ यांचे कार्यक्षेत्र वेगळे असावे, उच्च पदांचे वेतन कमी करावे आणि मीठ, अबकारी व मुद्रा कर रद्द करावेत अशा मागण्या केल्या — म्हणजेच (a), (b) व (d). नव्या कायदेमंडळात भारतीयांना प्रतिनिधित्व (c) ही मागणी या निवेदनात नव्हती, आणि नेमका तोच इतर पर्यायांतला सापळा आहे.

subject: History
question: इ.स. 1940 मधील ऑगस्ट प्रस्तावात खालीलपैकी कोणत्या तरतुदी होत्या? (a) दुसरे महायुद्ध संपल्यानंतर भारतात वसाहतीच्या धर्तीची पूर्णपणे जबाबदार शासन व्यवस्था स्थापण्यास मदत केली जाईल. (b) गव्हर्नर जनरलच्या मंडळात आणखी काही भारतीयांचा समावेश केला जाईल.

options.A: पर्याय (a) योग्य व पर्याय (b) चुकीचा आहे.
options.B: पर्याय (b) योग्य व पर्याय (a) चुकीचा आहे.

explanation: इथले पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. 1940 च्या ऑगस्ट प्रस्तावात दोन्ही तरतुदी होत्या — युद्धानंतर भारतात वसाहतीच्या धर्तीवर पूर्णपणे जबाबदार शासन उभे करण्यास मदत (a), आणि गव्हर्नर जनरलच्या मंडळात आणखी भारतीयांचा समावेश (b). दोन्ही विधाने बिनचूक असल्याने 'दोन्ही तरतुदी बरोबर' हेच योग्य ठरते.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Which of the following statement/s are correct? (a) The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index report is released by World Bank. (b) The 2025 report is focused on the relationship between poverty & climate change. (c) The 2025 report examines four key climate hazards: high heat, drought, flood & air pollution. (d) The report states that poverty in South Asia has greatly increased.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Statements (b) and (c) are correct — the 2025 report centres on the poverty–climate change link and examines four key climate hazards: high heat, drought, flood and air pollution. Statement (a) is wrong (the Global MPI is published by UNDP and OPHI, not the World Bank) and (d) overstates the finding, so only (b) and (c) stand.

subject: Current Affairs
question: The flagship priorities of Brazil's BRICS Chairship, 2025 include the following: (a) Global Health Cooperation (b) Climate change (c) Promotion of women's emancipation (d) Reform of the Multilateral System (e) Trade, Investment and Finance
explanation: The right pick is option C. Brazil's BRICS Chairship 2025 flagged Global Health Cooperation (a), Climate change (b) and Trade, Investment and Finance (e) among its priorities. The women's-emancipation and multilateral-reform items in (c) and (d) are not on that flagship list, so (a), (b) and (e) is the set.

explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. हर्षचरित्र बाणभट्टाचे (iii), मालती माधव भवभूतीचे (iv), मालविकाग्निमित्र कालिदासाचे (i) आणि मुद्राराक्षस विशाखादत्ताचे (ii). ज्या एका लेखकाबद्दल खात्री आहे — कालिदास किंवा विशाखादत्त — तो निश्चित केला की चुकीचे संच पटकन बाद करता येतात.

question: अदिलशाहचा वजीर हेमूच्या बाबतीत लागू असलेली विधाने कोणती? (a) अदिलशाह याने हेमू यास 'विक्रमाजीत' ही उपाधी दिली होती. (b) हेमूने आपल्या कारकीर्दीचा प्रारंभ बाजार अधिक्षक म्हणून केला. (c) हेमू 22 लढायांपैकी एकही लढाई पराभूत झाला नव्हता. (d) हेमूने पानीपतच्या दुसऱ्या लढाईत अकबरावर विजय मिळविला.
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय A. हेमूबाबत (a), (b) व (c) ही विधाने बरोबर आहेत: अदिलशाहने त्याला 'विक्रमाजीत' उपाधी दिली, त्याने कारकीर्दीची सुरुवात बाजार अधिक्षक म्हणून केली आणि 22 लढायांत तो अपराजित राहिला. (d) मात्र चुकीचे, कारण पानीपतच्या दुसऱ्या लढाईत (1556) हेमूचा पराभव झाला होता, विजय नव्हे.

question: लेखकांच्या योग्य जोड्या जुळवा: सूची I - सूची II (a) स्टोरिआ-द-मोगोर - (i) बर्नियर (b) ट्रॅव्हल-इन-मुघल एम्पायर - (ii) निकोलाओ मनुची (c) अर्ली ट्रॅव्हल इन इंडिया - (iii) विल्यम फॉस्टर (d) हिस्टॉरिकल फ्रॅग्मेंट - (iv) रॉबर्ट
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B निवडला आहे. स्टोरिआ-द-मोगोर निकोलाओ मनुचीचे (ii), ट्रॅव्हल्स इन मुघल एम्पायर बर्नियरचे (i), अर्ली ट्रॅव्हल्स इन इंडिया विल्यम फॉस्टरचे (iii) आणि हिस्टॉरिकल फ्रॅग्मेंट रॉबर्टचे (iv). प्रवासवर्णनांचे लेखक हा MPSC चा आवडता विषय आहे, त्यामुळे जोड्यांच्या स्वरूपात लक्षात ठेवणे फायद्याचे.

question: पुढील जोड्या जुळवा: सूची I - सूची II (a) सिंद्री - (i) खताचा कारखाना (b) चित्तरंजन - (ii) रेल्वे डब्यांचा कारखाना (c) पेरांबूर - (iii) रेल्वे इंजीनांचा कारखाना (d) पिंपरी - (iv) पेनीसिलीनचा कारखाना
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. सिंद्री हा खताचा कारखाना (i), चित्तरंजन रेल्वे इंजिनांचा कारखाना (iii), पेरांबूर रेल्वे डब्यांचा कारखाना (ii) आणि पिंपरी पेनिसिलीन (प्रतिजैविक) कारखाना (iv). ठिकाण–उद्योग अशा जोड्या म्हणजे शुद्ध पाठांतराचे गुण — उजळणी करताना क्षेत्रानुसार गटवार लक्षात ठेवाव्यात.

question: पुढील जोड्या जुळवा: सूची I - सूची II (a) वराहमिहीर - (i) पंचसिद्धांतिका (b) वाग्भट्ट - (ii) अष्टांग संग्रह (c) ईश्वरकृष्ण - (iii) सांख्य कारीका (d) प्रसतपद - (iv) वैशेषीक सुत्र
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय D आहे. वराहमिहीरने पंचसिद्धांतिका (i), वाग्भट्टाने अष्टांग संग्रह (ii), ईश्वरकृष्णाने सांख्य कारिका (iii) आणि प्रशस्तपादाने वैशेषिक सूत्रावरील ग्रंथ (iv) लिहिला — अगदी क्रमवार जोडी. अशी क्रमवार जोडी दिसली की ती मुद्दाम नीटनेटकी दिसणारी फसवणूक नाही ना, हे एकदा तपासावे.

question: पुढील मुघलकालीन भारतातील संस्कृत लेखक आणि त्यांचे ग्रंथ यांच्या जोड्या जुळवा: सूची I - सूची II (a) अनंतदेव - (i) चैतन्य चरितामृतम् (b) गंगाधर - (ii) निर्णय सिंधू (c) कमलाकर भट्ट - (iii) मनोरमा (d) कृष्णदास कवीराज - (iv) संस्कारकौस्तुभ

question: हवामान अभ्यासक, आर.एल. सिंग (1971) यांनी भारताच्या हवामान प्रदेशाची किती क्षेत्रांत विभागणी केली?

question: भुसावळ बॉम्ब खटल्यात खालीलपैकी कोणास पकडण्यात आले होते?
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय A आहे. भुसावळ बॉम्ब खटल्यातील अटकेशी सदाशिव मलकापूरकर हे नाव जोडले जाते. एकनाम प्रकारच्या तथ्यात्मक प्रश्नात प्रसिद्ध वाटणाऱ्या पर्यायांच्या मागे न लागता, स्रोतात प्रत्यक्ष वाचलेला पर्यायच निवडावा.

question: इ.स. 1864 मध्ये __________ या संस्कृत विद्वानाने व कट्टर समाज सुधारकाने समाज सुधारणांच्या कार्यास वाहून घेण्यासाठी सरकारी सेवेचा राजीनामा दिला.
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय B. विष्णुशास्त्री पंडीत या संस्कृत विद्वानाने व कट्टर समाजसुधारकाने 1864 मध्ये सरकारी नोकरी सोडून, विशेषतः विधवा पुनर्विवाहाच्या, समाजसुधारणेला वाहून घेतले. 1864 हे वर्ष त्यांच्यासाठी झटपट खूण म्हणून लक्षात ठेवा.

subject: History
question: पुढील वाक्यात वर्णन केलेले समाजसुधारक ओळखा: (a) आपण जे शिकवतो ते आचरणात आणण्याचे धैर्य त्यांनी दाखवले. (b) ते स्त्री शिक्षणाचे कट्टर समर्थक होते. (c) ते बालविवाहाच्या विरोधात होते; त्यांनी त्यांच्या मुलांचे व मुलींचे विवाह ते त्यांचा जोडीदार निवडण्यास समर्थ झाले तेव्हाच केले. (d) त्यांनी विधवा पुनर्विवाहाचे समर्थन केले, त्यांनी त्यांच्या विधवा मुलीच्या पुनर्विवाहाला संमती दिली होती.
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय B आहे. जे शिकवले ते आचरणात आणण्याचे धैर्य, स्त्री शिक्षणाचे कट्टर समर्थन, मुलांचे विवाह ती जोडीदार निवडण्याइतकी सक्षम झाल्यावरच करणे आणि विधवा मुलीच्या पुनर्विवाहाला संमती — हे सर्व संकेत रा.गो. भांडारकर यांच्याकडे बोट दाखवतात. वर्णनात्मक प्रश्नात प्रत्येक संकेत वाचा; एखादी ओळ जवळचे नाव बाद करते.

question: जोड्या जुळवा: सूची I - सूची II (a) जियाउद्दीन बरनी - (i) फतूह-उस-सलातीन (b) ख्वाजा अबू मलीक इसामी - (ii) किताब-उर-रहलह (c) इब्न बतूता - (iii) तारीख-ए-सलातीन अफगाणा (d) अहमद यादगार - (iv) फतवा-ए-जहाँदरी

question: खालील विधाने पहा: (a) राज्य खनिज धोरण 1999 प्रमाणे लोह, गंधक, सोने, तांबे आणि शिसे खनिज उत्पादनासाठी खाजगी क्षेत्रांना खुली करण्यात आली. (b) नागपूर विभागानंतर सर्वात जास्त खनिज उपलब्धता कोकण विभागात आहे. (c) महाराष्ट्र राज्य खाण महामंडळाची स्थापना 1973 मध्ये केली.
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय C. तिन्ही विधाने बरोबर आहेत: 1999 च्या राज्य खनिज धोरणाने लोह, गंधक, सोने, तांबे व शिसे खाजगी क्षेत्राला खुले केले, खनिज उपलब्धतेत नागपूरनंतर कोकण विभाग येतो आणि महाराष्ट्र राज्य खाण महामंडळाची स्थापना 1973 मध्ये झाली. प्रत्येक विधान स्वतंत्रपणे बरोबर असल्याने 'सर्व बरोबर' हाच प्रामाणिक पर्याय.

question: पुढील राजघराणी आणि त्यांची राज्ये यांच्या जोड्या जुळवा: सूची I - सूची II (a) मैत्रक - (i) वल्लभी (b) चहुमान - (ii) शाकंभरी (c) गुर्जर - (iii) भ्रोच (d) परमार - (iv) धार
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय A आहे. मैत्रकांचे राज्य वल्लभी (i), चहुमानांचे शाकंभरी (ii), गुर्जरांचे भ्रोच (iii) आणि परमारांचे धार (iv) येथे होते. प्राचीन राजघराण्यांच्या राजधान्या हे हमखास गुण देणारे मुद्दे — प्रत्येक घराणे त्याच्या सत्ताकेंद्राशी जोडा.

subject: Geography
question: महाराष्ट्रातील खालील वनपरिमंडळे आणि त्यांची महाराष्ट्रातील एकूण वनक्षेत्राशी असणारी टक्केवारी यांच्या जोड्या लावा: महाराष्ट्रातील वनपरिमंडळे - एकूण वनक्षेत्राशी टक्केवारी (महाराष्ट्राची आर्थिक पाहणी 2024) (a) गडचिरोली - (i) 12.5 (b) नागपूर - (ii) 20.8 (c) धुळे - (iii) 9.5 (d) ठाणे - (iv) 10.4
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय A आहे. महाराष्ट्राची आर्थिक पाहणी 2024 नुसार गडचिरोलीचा वाटा 20.8% (ii), नागपूर 12.5% (i), धुळे 10.4% (iv) आणि ठाणे 9.5% (iii). टक्केवारीच्या जोड्यांत आधी सर्वात मोठा आकडा निश्चित करा — इथे 20.8% गडचिरोलीला — मग बाकीच्या जोड्या आपोआप जुळतात.

subject: Polity
question: दिनांक 9 ऑक्टोबर, 2024 रोजीच्या शासन निर्णयानुसार बंजारा/लमाण/लभाण तांडा भागासाठी ग्रामपंचायत स्थापन करण्यासाठी किमान किती लोकसंख्या आवश्यक आहे?
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. 9 ऑक्टोबर 2024 च्या शासन निर्णयानुसार बंजारा / लमाण / लभाण तांडा भागात ग्रामपंचायत स्थापनेसाठी किमान लोकसंख्या 700 निश्चित केली आहे. शासन निर्णयातील आकडे हे चालू घडामोडींचे हुकमी मुद्दे — तारीख आणि आकडा एकत्र लक्षात ठेवा.

subject: Geography
question: पुढील विधाने विचारात घ्या: (a) अरवली हा जगातील सर्वात तरूण वली पर्वत आहे. (b) अरवली हा पर्वत संगमरवर, ग्रॅनाइट, जस्त आणि तांबे यांसारख्या खनिजांनी समृद्ध आहे. (c) या पर्वतरांगांनी शतकानुशतके खाणकाम आणि बांधकाम व्यवसायांना आधार दिला आहे. (d) चित्तोडगड, कुंभलगड आणि रणथंबोर यांसारखे ऐतिहासिक किल्ले या पर्वतरांगेत आहेत.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D निवडला आहे. अरवलीबाबत (b), (c) व (d) ही विधाने बरोबर — संगमरवर, ग्रॅनाइट, जस्त व तांबे यांनी समृद्ध; शतकानुशतके खाणकाम व बांधकामाचा आधार; आणि चित्तोडगड, कुंभलगड व रणथंबोरसारखे किल्ले येथेच. (a) मात्र चुकीचे, कारण अरवली हा सर्वात जुन्या वली पर्वतांपैकी आहे, तरूण नव्हे.

subject: History
question: कालमापन प्रक्रियेमध्ये 'कालांतर संस्कार' ही प्रक्रिया कशासाठी वापरली जाते? (a) लीप इयर (b) अधिक मास (c) क्षय मास (d) तिथी वृद्धी-लोप
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. कालमापनात 'कालांतर संस्कार' हे सुधारण या सर्वांसाठी लावले जाते — लीप इयर, अधिक मास, क्षय मास आणि तिथी वृद्धी–लोप. यादीतील प्रत्येक घटक ही प्रक्रिया वापरतो, त्यामुळे (a), (b), (c), (d) हाच प्रामाणिक पर्याय.

subject: Economy
question: भारतामध्ये तांदूळ आणि गव्हाचे प्रति हेक्टरी उत्पन्न 2023-2024 वर्षात किती होते?
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. भारतात 2023-24 मध्ये प्रति हेक्टरी उत्पन्न तांदळासाठी 2882 कि.ग्रा. व गव्हासाठी 3559 कि.ग्रा. आहे. पर्याय मुद्दाम जवळचे आहेत, त्यामुळे अंदाजापेक्षा उजळणी केलेल्या नेमक्या आकड्यांवर विश्वास ठेवा.

subject: History
question: सुफी संप्रदायातील साधनेत कोणत्या तीन विशेष क्रियांचा समावेश होतो?
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D निवडला आहे. सुफी साधनेतील तीन विशेष क्रिया म्हणजे मुजाहदा, जिक्र आणि मराकबह. इतर पर्यायांत वस्ल व तवज्जूह असे शब्द मिसळून संच धूसर केला आहे, त्यामुळे ही त्रयी पक्की करा.

subject: Geography
question: हिमालयाचे प्रादेशिक विभाग (यादी-I) आणि त्यांचा पश्चिम-पूर्व विस्तार (यादी-II) यांच्या जोड्या लावा: यादी-I (हिमालयाचे प्रादेशिक विभाग) - यादी-II (पश्चिम-पूर्व विस्तार) (a) पंजाब हिमालय - (i) सतलज ते काली (b) कुमाऊँ हिमालय - (ii) काली ते तिस्ता (c) नेपाळ हिमालय - (iii) तिस्ता ते ब्रह्मपुत्रा (d) आसाम हिमालय - (iv) सिंधू ते सतलज
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय A. पश्चिमेकडून पूर्वेकडे: पंजाब हिमालय सिंधू ते सतलज (iv), कुमाऊँ सतलज ते काली (i), नेपाळ काली ते तिस्ता (ii) आणि आसाम तिस्ता ते ब्रह्मपुत्रा (iii). नद्या डावीकडून उजवीकडे रेखल्या की क्रम आपोआप लागतो.

subject: Geography
question: पृथ्वीच्या पृष्ठ भागापासून खालील वातावरणीय थरांचा योग्य चढता क्रम शोधा: (a) मध्यांबर (b) थर्मोस्फिअर (c) तपांबर (d) स्थितसतब्धी (e) स्थितांबर (f) मध्यसतब्धी (g) तपसतब्धी
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय C आहे. पृष्ठभागापासून वर जाताना थर असे येतात — तपांबर (c), तपसतब्धी (g), स्थितांबर (e), स्थितसतब्धी (d), मध्यांबर (a), मध्यसतब्धी (f) आणि थर्मोस्फिअर (b). मुद्दा हा की प्रत्येक 'अंबर' नंतर त्याची 'सतब्धी' येते आणि मग पुढचा थर सुरू होतो.

subject: Economy
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने माँट्रीयल कराराशी संबंधित आहे/त? (a) ओझोन थराचा ऱ्हास थांबविण्यासाठी क्लोरो-फ्ल्युरोकार्बनची निर्मिती व वापर कमी करणे. (b) पृथ्वी आणि तिच्या पर्यावरणाच्या संरक्षणासाठी परिस्थितीकी संतुलन व जैवविविधता समृद्ध करण्यासाठी कार्य करणे. (c) ध्रुवातील प्रदुषणाचा अभ्यास.
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय A. माँट्रीयल करार नेमका ओझोन थराच्या रक्षणासाठी क्लोरो-फ्ल्युरोकार्बन (CFC) चे उत्पादन व वापर कमी करण्याबाबत आहे — म्हणजेच फक्त विधान (a). व्यापक पर्यावरण रक्षण (b) व ध्रुवीय प्रदूषण अभ्यास (c) हे इतर करारांचे विषय आहेत, या कराराचे नव्हे.

subject: Geography
question: जोड्या लावा: यादी-I (जिल्हे) - यादी-II (लोकसंख्येतील 2001-2011 मधील दशवार्षिक वाढ (%)) (a) ठाणे - (i) 25.50 (b) छत्रपती संभाजीनगर - (ii) 30.4 (c) पुणे - (iii) 27.33 (d) नंदूरबार - (iv) 35.94
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. 2001-2011 दशवार्षिक वाढीत ठाणे 35.94% (iv), छत्रपती संभाजीनगर 27.33% (iii), पुणे 30.4% (ii) आणि नंदूरबार 25.50% (i). सर्वाधिक वाढ ठाण्याला जोडली की बाकीच्या जोड्या सहज बसतात.

subject: Economy
question: प्रतिपादन (A): परिसंस्था ही नैसर्गिक संसाधन प्रणाली आहे. कारण (R): परिसंस्था ही एकल संकल्पना असून भौतिक पर्यावरण (भौतिक आणि अजैविक घटक) आणि जैविक घटक (मानव, प्राणी, सूक्ष्मजीव आणि वनस्पती) एकाच चौकटीत एकत्र राहतात. खालीलपैकी कोणते बरोबर आहे?

options.A: दोन्ही, (A) व (R) अचूक असून (R) हे (A) चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण आहे.
options.B: दोन्ही, (A) व (R) अचूक आहेत, परंतु (R) हे (A) चे अचूक स्पष्टीकरण नाही.
options.C: (A) अचूक आहे, परंतु (R) हे चूक आहे.
options.D: (A) चूक आहे, परंतु (R) हे अचूक आहे.

explanation: बरोबर पर्याय A आहे. प्रतिपादन व कारण दोन्ही बरोबर असून कारण हे प्रतिपादनाचे खरे स्पष्टीकरण देते: परिसंस्था ही नैसर्गिक संसाधन प्रणाली आहे कारण ती भौतिक पर्यावरण व जैविक घटक एकाच कार्यचौकटीत बांधते. जेव्हा R हे A मागचे 'का' थेट सांगते, तेव्हा हाच पर्याय निवडावा.

subject: Geography
question: जोड्या लावा: यादी I (देश) - यादी-II (स्थलांतरित शेतीची स्थानिक नावे) (a) कांगो व मध्य आफ्रिका - (i) रोका (b) ईशान्य भारत - (ii) मासोले (c) व्हिएतनाम - (iii) झूम (d) ब्राझील - (iv) रे
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B निवडला आहे. स्थलांतरित शेतीची स्थानिक नावे — कांगो व मध्य आफ्रिकेत मासोले (ii), ईशान्य भारतात झूम (iii), व्हिएतनाममध्ये रे (iv) आणि ब्राझीलमध्ये रोका (i). ईशान्य भारतासाठी झूम ही बहुतेकांना माहीत असलेली खूण.

subject: Geography
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर नाही/त? (a) 1992 मध्ये माँट्रीयल येथे पर्यावरण आणि विकास विषयक संयुक्त राष्ट्र परिषद आयोजित करण्यात आली होती. (b) 1987 चा ब्रंटलँड अहवाल नैरोबी येथील संयुक्त राष्ट्रांच्या दुसऱ्या परिषदेशी संबंधित आहे. (c) मानव निर्मित हवामान बदलाच्या समस्यांचे निराकरण करणे हा क्योटो प्रोटोकॉलचा उद्देश होता.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय C निवडला आहे. विधाने (a) व (b) चुकीची: 1992 ची पर्यावरण व विकास परिषद रिओ दी जानेरो येथे झाली, माँट्रीयल येथे नव्हे, आणि 1987 चा ब्रंटलँड अहवाल नैरोबी दुसऱ्या परिषदेशी संबंधित नव्हता. क्योटो प्रोटोकॉलच्या उद्देशाबाबत विधान (c) बरोबर आहे, म्हणून फक्त (a) व (b) चुकीची.

subject: General Studies
question: खालील प्रमुख हरितगृह वायूंना त्यांच्या जागतिक तापमान वाढीस कारणीभूत असणाऱ्या टक्केवारीनुसार उतरता क्रम लावा:

options.A: कार्बन डायऑक्साईड, मिथेन, नायट्रस ऑक्साईड, फ्लोरिनेटेड वायू
options.B: कार्बन डायऑक्साईड, मिथेन, फ्लोरिनेटेड वायू, नायट्रस ऑक्साईड
options.C: मिथेन, कार्बन डायऑक्साईड, नायट्रस ऑक्साईड, फ्लोरिनेटेड वायू
options.D: मिथेन, नायट्रस ऑक्साईड, फ्लोरिनेटेड वायू, कार्बन डायऑक्साईड

explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. जागतिक तापमानवाढीतील वाट्यानुसार उतरता क्रम — कार्बन डायऑक्साईड, मिथेन, नायट्रस ऑक्साईड आणि मग फ्लोरिनेटेड वायू. CO2 आघाडीवर व फ्लोरिनेटेड वायू शेवटी, ही खूण इतर क्रम बाद करते.

subject: History
question: गावातील शेतजमीनी गावातील समुदायांच्या संयुक्त मालकिच्या होत्या आणि जमीन महसूल भरण्याची जबाबदारी सदस्यावर संयुक्तपणे होती. ही पद्धत काय होती?
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय B आहे. गावातील जमिनी समुदायाच्या संयुक्त मालकीच्या आणि जमीन महसुलाची जबाबदारी सदस्यांवर संयुक्तपणे — ही व्यवस्था म्हणजे महालवारी पद्धत. जमीनदारी (जमीनदारांमार्फत) व रयतवारी (वैयक्तिक शेतकरी) यांच्याशी तुलना केल्यास गोंधळ टळतो.

subject: Polity
question: मातृत्व लाभ अधिनियम 1961 अंतर्गत, बाळंतपणापूर्वी आणि नंतर महिलांसाठी असलेल्या रोजगार नियमांबाबत खालीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने अयोग्य आहे/त? (a) अधिनियमानुसार बाळ जन्मानंतर सहा आठवड्यांची रजा अनिवार्य आहे. (b) अधिनियमानुसार बाळंतपणापूर्वी सहा आठवडे व नंतर दहा आठवड्यांची रजा अनिवार्य आहे. (c) हा अधिनियम कर्मचाऱ्यांची किमान संख्या विचारात न घेता सर्व आस्थापनांना लागू आहे. (d) हा अधिनियम मातृत्व लाभ व इतर लाभ प्रदान करतो.
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय D आहे. अयोग्य विधाने (b) व (c): मातृत्व लाभ अधिनियम त्या स्वरूपात सहा आठवडे आधी व दहा नंतर अशी रजा ठरवत नाही, आणि तो आकाराचा विचार न करता प्रत्येक आस्थापनेला लागू नाही — किमान कर्मचारी संख्येची अट असते. (a) व (d) बरोबर, म्हणून (b) आणि (c) हे उत्तर.

subject: Polity
question: 'स्वैच्छिक क्षेत्रावरील राष्ट्रीय धोरण – 2007' नुसार स्वैच्छिक संस्थान (VOs) च्या वैशिष्ट्यांबाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या: (a) या संस्था खाजगी स्वरूपाच्या असून सरकारपासून स्वतंत्र असतात. (b) या संस्थांनी निर्माण केलेला नफा त्यांच्या मालकांना किंवा संचालकांना परत केला जात नाही. (c) या संस्था स्वयंशासित असतात आणि त्यांचे नियंत्रण सरकारद्वारे केले जाते. (d) या संस्था विशिष्ट ध्येय आणि उद्दिष्टे असलेल्या नोंदणीकृत संस्था किंवा अनौपचारिक गट असू शकतात. वरीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहे/त?
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. स्वैच्छिक क्षेत्रावरील राष्ट्रीय धोरण-2007 नुसार स्वैच्छिक संस्था खाजगी व सरकारपासून स्वतंत्र असतात (a), नफा मालकांना परत करत नाहीत (b), आणि विशिष्ट ध्येय असलेल्या नोंदणीकृत वा अनौपचारिक गट असतात (d). विधान (c) चुकीचे — या संस्था स्वयंशासित असतात पण सरकारद्वारे नियंत्रित नसतात — म्हणून (a), (b) व (d) बरोबर.

subject: General Studies
question: जीवसंहती (Biome) ही संकल्पना कोणी मांडली?
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय B आहे. जीवसंहती (Biome) ही संकल्पना एफ. क्लेमेंट्स यांनी 1916 मध्ये मांडली. इतर नाव-वर्ष जोड्या भुरळ घालण्यासाठी आहेत, त्यामुळे 'क्लेमेंट्स, 1916' ही खूण पक्की ठेवा.

subject: Economy
question: जोड्या जुळवा: भारतातील दारिद्र्य निर्मूलन कार्यक्रम - प्रारंभाचे वर्ष (a) एकात्मिक ग्रामीण विकास कार्यक्रम - (i) 2001 (b) ग्रामीण भूमिहीन रोजगार हमी कार्यक्रम - (ii) 1989 (c) जवाहर रोजगार योजना - (iii) 1983 (d) संपूर्ण ग्रामीण रोजगार योजना - (iv) 1978
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. प्रारंभ वर्षानुसार IRDP 1978 (iv), RLEGP 1983 (iii), जवाहर रोजगार योजना 1989 (ii) आणि संपूर्ण ग्रामीण रोजगार योजना 2001 (i). या दारिद्र्य कार्यक्रमांना कालक्रमाने लावणे हा जोड्या जुळवण्याचा सर्वात सोपा मार्ग.

subject: Economy
question: पहिली आणि चौथी पंचवार्षिक योजना यांचा कालावधी अनुक्रमे __________ व __________ आहे.
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय B. पहिली पंचवार्षिक योजना 1951-56 आणि चौथी पंचवार्षिक योजना 1969-74. चौथ्या योजनेआधीचा खंड (1966-69 चा 'योजना सुट्टीचा' काळ) हाच तपशील 1969 ही सुरुवात निश्चित करतो.

subject: Geography
question: पुढील विधानांचा विचार करा: विधान-I: 1 मार्च 2026 रोजीच्या अंदाजानुसार महाराष्ट्राची एकूण प्रक्षेपित लोकसंख्या सुमारे 12.93 कोटी आहे. विधान-II: त्याच कालावधीत महाराष्ट्रातील नागरी लोकसंख्या ग्रामीण लोकसंख्येपेक्षा अधिक आहे. वरीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/त?

options.A: विधान-I बरोबर आहे, पण विधान-II चुकीचे आहे.
options.B: विधान-I चुकीचे आहे, पण विधान-II बरोबर आहे.
options.C: विधान-I आणि विधान-II दोन्ही बरोबर आहेत.
options.D: विधान-I आणि विधान-II दोन्ही चुकीचे आहेत.

explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. विधान-I बरोबर — 1 मार्च 2026 रोजी महाराष्ट्राची प्रक्षेपित लोकसंख्या सुमारे 12.93 कोटी — पण विधान-II चुकीचे, कारण त्या काळासाठी नागरी लोकसंख्या ग्रामीणपेक्षा जास्त असण्याचा अंदाज नाही. म्हणून विधान-I बरोबर, विधान-II चुकीचे.

subject: Geography
question: खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या: (a) 2017 मध्ये भारताची लोकसंख्येची घनता दक्षिण कोरियापेक्षा जास्त होती. (b) 2017 मध्ये भारताची लोकसंख्येची घनता बांगलादेशापेक्षा कमी होती. वरीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने योग्य आहे/त?
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय B आहे. फक्त विधान (b) बरोबर — 2017 मध्ये भारताची लोकसंख्येची घनता बांगलादेशापेक्षा कमी होती, आणि बांगलादेश हा अत्यंत दाट लोकवस्तीचा देश आहे. विधान (a) चुकीचे, कारण त्या वर्षी भारताची घनता दक्षिण कोरियापेक्षा जास्त नव्हे तर कमी होती.

subject: Economy
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते जमिनीच्या उपविभागणी आणि तुकडे होण्याचे तोटे आहेत? (a) जमिनीची नासाडी (b) प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी (c) जमीन व्यवस्थापन सोपे करणे (d) कमी उत्पादकता
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय B आहे. जमिनीच्या तुकडेपणामुळे जमिनीची नासाडी (a), प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी (b) आणि कमी उत्पादकता (d) होते. विधान (c) — 'जमीन व्यवस्थापन सोपे होणे' — हा तर फायदा आहे, तोटा नव्हे, म्हणून तो वगळून (a), (b) व (d) उरतात.

subject: Economy
question: महाराष्ट्रातील सार्वजनिक वितरण व्यवस्था (PDS) संदर्भात पुढील विधानांचा विचार करा: (a) डिसेंबर 2025 पर्यंत राज्यात एकूण 270.48 लाख शिधापत्रिकाधारक होते. (b) 31 ऑक्टोबर 2025 रोजी राज्यात 51,636 रास्त भाव दुकाने कार्यरत होती. (c) ऑक्टोबर 2025 पर्यंत सुमारे 1.55 कोटी कुटुंबांना आधार आधारित बायोमेट्रिक प्रमाणीकरणाद्वारे शिधावस्तूंचा लाभ देण्यात आला. वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे/त?
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. विधाने (b) व (c) बरोबर — 31 ऑक्टोबर 2025 रोजी सुमारे 51,636 रास्त भाव दुकाने कार्यरत आणि ऑक्टोबर 2025 पर्यंत सुमारे 1.55 कोटी कुटुंबांना आधार आधारित बायोमेट्रिक प्रमाणीकरणाद्वारे लाभ. विधान (a) मधील शिधापत्रिकाधारकांचा आकडा जुळत नाही, म्हणून फक्त (b) व (c) टिकतात.

subject: Economy
question: सामाजिक सुरक्षा उपाययोजना प्रामुख्याने दोन प्रमुख प्रकारांमध्ये विभागल्या जातात. खालीलपैकी कोणते पर्याय ते वर्ग सर्वाधिक अचूकपणे दर्शवतात? (a) सामाजिक विमा (b) सामाजिक कल्याण (c) सामाजिक सहाय (d) सामाजिक समावेशकता
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. सामाजिक सुरक्षा साधारणपणे दोन मुख्य वर्गांत विभागली जाते — सामाजिक विमा (a) आणि सामाजिक सहाय (c). सामाजिक कल्याण व सामाजिक समावेशकता या व्यापक संकल्पना आहेत, दोन मुख्य वर्ग नव्हेत, म्हणून (a) व (c) ही योग्य जोडी.

subject: Economy
question: तेंडूलकर समितीने निदर्शनास आणल्याप्रमाणे, दारिद्र्याची संकल्पना __________ यासारख्या मूलभूत मानवी गरजांच्या संदर्भात सामाजिक वंचिततेशी संबंधित आहे. (a) पुरेसे पोषण आवश्यक (b) पुरेसा निवारा आवश्यक (c) पुरेशी वस्त्र उपलब्धता आवश्यक (d) टाळण्यायुक्त रोगांपासून सुटका आवश्यक (e) किमान शिक्षण आवश्यक वरीलपैकी कोणते/ता मुद्दे/दा बरोबर आहे/त?
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. तेंडूलकर समितीने दारिद्र्याची मांडणी या सर्व गरजांशी संबंधित सामाजिक वंचिततेच्या आधारे केली — पुरेसे पोषण, पुरेसा निवारा, पुरेशी वस्त्रे, टाळता येणाऱ्या रोगांपासून सुटका आणि किमान शिक्षण. प्रत्येक मुद्दा यादीत असल्याने 'वरील सर्व' हेच योग्य.

subject: Economy
question: तेंडूलकर समितीच्या अंदाजानुसार 2004-05 मध्ये __________% ग्रामीण लोकसंख्या व __________% शहरी लोकसंख्या दारिद्र्यरेषेखाली होती.
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय A. तेंडूलकर समितीच्या 2004-05 च्या अंदाजानुसार 41.8% ग्रामीण व 25.7% शहरी लोकसंख्या दारिद्र्यरेषेखाली होती. ग्रामीण आकडा शहरीपेक्षा जास्त, ही खूण अदलाबदल केलेल्या पर्यायांविरुद्ध तपासणी म्हणून ठेवा.

subject: Science
question: खालीलपैकी योग्य विधान/ने कोणती आहेत? (a) सूर्यमालेतील प्रजापती ग्रहास 61 उपग्रह आहेत. (b) बुध ग्रहाचे सूर्यापासूनचे सरासरी अंतर 58 मिलियन कि.मी. आहे. (c) प्रजापती ग्रह सूर्यापासून सरासरी 4495 मिलियन कि.मी. अंतरावर आहे.
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. विधान (b) बरोबर — बुध सूर्यापासून सुमारे 58 मिलियन कि.मी. आहे. पण (a) व (c) चुकीची: प्रजापती (युरेनस) ला 61 उपग्रह नाहीत, आणि त्याचे सूर्यापासूनचे सरासरी अंतर 4495 मिलियन कि.मी. नाही (तो आकडा नेपच्यूनच्या जवळचा). म्हणून 'विधाने (a) आणि (c) बरोबर नाहीत' हेच योग्य.

subject: Economy
question: राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा कायदा - 2013 संबंधी खालीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/त? (a) महिला सक्षमीकरण हे राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा कायद्याचे - 2013 चे वैशिष्ट्य आहे. (b) राज्य अन्न आयोगास 2013 च्या या कायद्याचे निरीक्षण, पुनरावलोकन आणि अंमलबजावणी करण्याचे अधिकार आहेत.
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय A आहे. विधान (a) बरोबर — राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा कायदा, 2013 चे महिला सक्षमीकरण हे अंगभूत वैशिष्ट्य आहे, ज्यात शिधापत्रिकेसाठी घरातील ज्येष्ठ महिलेला प्रमुख मानले जाते. विधान (b) मधील राज्य अन्न आयोगाच्या भूमिकेचे वर्णन कायद्याच्या शब्दांशी जुळत नाही, म्हणून फक्त (a) टिकते.

subject: Economy
question: खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या: (a) एकूण भांडवली साठ्यामध्ये डेव्हिड पिअर्स आणि जेरमी वॉरफोर्ड यांनी मानवनिर्मित भौतिक भांडवल, मानवी भांडवल आणि पर्यावरणीय भांडवल यांचा समावेश केला आहे. (b) डेव्हिड पिअर्स आणि जेरमी वॉरफोर्ड यांच्या मते शाश्वत विकासाचा अर्थ असा आहे की विकास प्रक्रियेत मानवनिर्मित भौतिक भांडवल, मानवी भांडवल आणि पर्यावरणीय भांडवल कमी होते.
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. विधान (a) बरोबर — पिअर्स व वॉरफोर्ड एकूण भांडवली साठ्यात मानवनिर्मित भौतिक, मानवी व पर्यावरणीय भांडवल मोजतात. विधान (b) त्यांची कल्पना उलटवते: शाश्वत विकासात हे भांडवल कमी होणे अपेक्षित नाही, म्हणून फक्त (a) बरोबर.

subject: Economy
question: राष्ट्रीय लोकसंख्या धोरण, 2000 च्या उद्दिष्टांच्या संदर्भात खालील विधानांचा विचार करा: (a) मुलींच्या विवाहास विलंब करण्यास प्रोत्साहन द्यावे, विवाह 18 वर्षांपेक्षा कमी वयात न होता शक्यतो 21 वर्षांनंतर व्हावा. (b) 2030 पर्यंत स्थिर लोकसंख्या साध्य करणे हे दीर्घकालीन उद्दिष्ट आहे. वरीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने चूक आहे/त?
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय C निवडला आहे. इथे दोन्ही विधाने चुकीची — (a) मधील वयाची मांडणी राष्ट्रीय लोकसंख्या धोरण 2000 च्या प्रत्यक्ष उद्दिष्टाशी जुळत नाही, आणि धोरणातील स्थिर लोकसंख्येचे दीर्घकालीन उद्दिष्ट 2045 साठी आहे, (b) मधील 2030 साठी नव्हे. म्हणून (a) व (b) दोन्ही चुकीची.

subject: Science
question: प्रति युनिट वेळेत पृष्ठभागातून जाणाऱ्या (वाहणाऱ्या) निव्वळ विद्युतभाराला __________ म्हणतात.
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय A आहे. पृष्ठभागातून प्रति एकक वेळेत जाणारा निव्वळ विद्युतभार म्हणजे व्याख्येनुसार विद्युत प्रवाह. इतर संज्ञा व्होल्टेज किंवा गती दर्शवतात, भाराच्या प्रवाहाचा दर नव्हे, म्हणून 'विद्युत प्रवाह' हेच नेमके उत्तर.

subject: Science
question: भौतिक प्रमाण आणि त्यांचे परिमाण यांच्या योग्य जोड्या लावा: स्तंभ I - स्तंभ II (a) पारगम्यता (Permeability) (μ₀) - (i) ML²T⁻¹ (b) चिकटपणाचा गुणांक (Coefficient of Viscosity) (η) - (ii) MLT⁻²I⁻² (c) प्लँकचा स्थिरांक (Planck's Constant) (h) - (iii) ML⁻¹T⁻¹ (जिथे M म्हणजे वस्तुमान, L म्हणजे लांबी, T म्हणजे वेळ आणि I म्हणजे विद्युतप्रवाह)
explanation: पडताळलेले उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. पारगम्यता μ₀ चे परिमाण MLT⁻²I⁻² (ii), चिकटपणाचा गुणांक η हे ML⁻¹T⁻¹ (iii) आणि प्लँकचा स्थिरांक h हे ML²T⁻¹ (i). संपूर्ण तक्ता पाठ करण्यापेक्षा प्रत्येक परिमाण व्याख्यासूत्रावरून काढणे अधिक सुरक्षित.

subject: Science
question: जेव्हा न्युक्लिऑनचे भ्रमण समांतर असते, तेव्हा अणुकेंद्रीय बलाचे वर्तन कसे असते?
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. अणुकेंद्रीय बल हे भ्रमणावर अवलंबून असते, आणि न्युक्लिऑनचे भ्रमण समांतर असताना त्यांच्यातील आकर्षण अधिक मजबूत होते. याच भ्रमण-अवलंबित्वामुळे ड्युटेरॉन बद्ध अवस्थेत टिकतो.

subject: Science
question: थर्मोडायनॉमिक्सच्या नियम दोन नुसार हीट इंजीनची कार्यक्षमता किती असते?
explanation: बरोबर पर्याय D आहे. औष्णिकगतिकीच्या दुसऱ्या नियमानुसार कोणतेही उष्णता इंजिन पूर्ण कार्यक्षम असू शकत नाही — काही उष्णता नेहमी बाहेर टाकली जाते — म्हणून त्याची कार्यक्षमता नेहमी एकपेक्षा कमी असते. 'एक' म्हणजे परिपूर्ण इंजिन, जे नियम नाकारतो.

subject: Science
question: जर माध्यमाचा अपवर्तनांक दुहेरी अंतर्वक्र किंवा दुहेरी बहिर्वक्र भिंगाच्या अपवर्तनांकापेक्षा जास्त असेल तर भिंगाची नाभिय लांबी __________ होते.
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय D. जर सभोवतालच्या माध्यमाचा अपवर्तनांक भिंगापेक्षा जास्त असेल, तर भिंगाचे वर्तन उलटते आणि त्याची नाभिय लांबी ऋण होते. यामुळेच दाट माध्यमात बहिर्वक्र भिंग अपसारी वागू शकते — हा आवडता संकल्पनात्मक पेच.

subject: Science
question: 'अपोमिक्सिस' हे एक प्रकारचे पुनरुत्पादन आहे ज्यामुळे __________ चा विकास होतो.
