question: शाश्वत विकास ध्येयांच्या (SDGs) संदर्भात खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान/विधाने योग्य आहे/त ? (a) शाश्वत विकासाच्या संदर्भातील संयुक्त राष्ट्रांची परिषद, रिओ दी जानिरो येथे 2015 मध्ये झाली. (b) शाश्वत विकास ध्येये जागतिक ध्येये म्हणूनही ओळखली जातात. (c) शाश्वत विकास ध्येयांनी (SDGs) सहस्रकातील विकास ध्येयांची (MDGs) जागा घेतली. (d) शाश्वत विकास ध्येये (SDGs) जानेवारी 2012 पासून अस्तित्वात आली.
explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. SDGs ला Global Goals म्हणतात आणि त्यांनी MDGs ची जागा घेतली — (b) व (c). Rio de Janeiro मध्ये Rio+20 2012 मध्ये, 2015 नाही; SDGs जानेवारी 2016 पासून, 2012 नाही.

subject: Science
question: नागरी नियोजन आणि प्राचीन वारशाचे जतन हा उद्देश समोर ठेवून केंद्रीय गृह व नागरी खात्यांतर्गत कोणती योजना राबवली जात आहे ?
explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. HRIDAY (Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana) — Housing and Urban Affairs मंत्रालय — ऐतिहासिक शहरांमध्ये urban planning व heritage conservation. Smart Cities, Swachh Bharat, AMRUT व्यापक urban विषय.

subject: General Studies
question: पुढीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत ? (a) 2019 च्या जागतिक विकास अहवालानुसार मानवी भांडवल निर्देशांक हा श्रमिकांच्या पुढील पिढ्यांच्या उत्पादकते संदर्भात सूचित केला जातो. (b) मानवी भांडवल निर्देशांक हा शून्य आणि एक यांच्या दरम्यान असतो.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. World Development Report 2019 ने Human Capital Index सादर केला — पुढच्या पिढीच्या workers ची productivity मोजतो — आणि HCI 0 ते 1 दरम्यान. दोन्ही विधाने WDR 2019 framework शी जुळतात.

subject: Science
question: पुढील विधाने विचारात घ्या : (a) रांगती चलनवाढ ही आर्थिक वृद्धी आणि अनुकूल परिणामांसाठी फायदेशीर असू शकते. (b) चलनवाढीच्या काळात पैशाचे मूल्य वाढते. (c) चलनवाढ ही ऋणकोला लाभदायक असते. (d) चलनवाढीमुळे उत्पन्नातील विषमता कमी होते. वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/विधाने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. सौम्य creeping inflation वाढीस अनुकूल, मुद्दल देणार्‍यांना स्वस्त रुपयांत परतफेड करण्यास मदत — (a) व (c). Inflation दरम्यान पैशाची खरेदी शक्ती वाढत नाही (b), असमानता कमी होत नाही (d).

subject: Economy
question: पुढील विधाने विचारात घ्या : (a) राष्ट्रीय सोलर मिशन 2010 मध्ये सुरू करण्यात आले. (b) सन 2021-2022 पर्यंत 1,00,000 MW वीजनिर्मिती करणे हे त्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे.
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. National Solar Mission जानेवारी 2010 मध्ये NAPCC अंतर्गत सुरू; लक्ष्य 2021–22 पर्यंत 100,000 MW (100 GW) solar capacity. प्रश्न मधील दोन्ही विधाने बरोबर.

subject: General Studies
question: पेन्शन संबंधी प्रधानमंत्री श्रमयोगी मानधन योजना भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्थेतील कोणत्या क्षेत्रातील कामगारांसाठी लागू केली आहे?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) ही unorganised workers साठी स्वैच्छिक pension योजना — construction labour, audio-visual sector workers व mid-day meal scheme workers प्रश्न मधील informal categories.

subject: General Studies
question: असे निरीक्षणात आले आहे की : (a) पर्यावरण शाश्वतता हे उद्दीष्ट व (आर्थिक) वृद्धीचे उद्दीष्ट यात नेहमी संघर्ष असतो. (b) विकास आणि पर्यावरण शाश्वतता यामध्ये नेहमी परस्पर विरोध (ट्रेड ऑफ) असतो. वरीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/त?
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. वेगवान वाढ व कडक environmental sustainability अनेकदा विरोधी दिशांना — (a). उत्तरतालिकेने फक्त (a) स्वीकारले; (b) development–sustainability trade-off या पेपरसाठी बरोबर म्हणून चिन्हांकित नाही.

subject: Economy
question: अकराव्या पंचवार्षिक योजने अंतर्गत देखरेख/मोजमाप करता येण्याजोग्या 27 लक्ष्यांचे/उद्दीष्टांचे किती मुख्य गटात विभाजन केले ?
explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. अकरव्या पंचवार्षिक योजनेने 27 monitorable targets सहा broad categories मध्ये विभागले — वाढ, रोजगार, शिक्षण, आरोग्य, पर्यावरण व governance-type buckets. पाच, चार किंवा नऊ categories official grouping शी जुळत नाहीत.

subject: General Studies
question: रेरा (नियमन आणि विकास) कायदा यासंदर्भात पुढील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधान/विधाने निवडा : (a) सन 2016 मध्ये संमत झाला. (b) घरांच्या खरेदीदारांचे हित सांभाळणे हे त्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे. (c) जम्मू आणि काश्मीर राज्यात लागू नव्हता.
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. RERA 2016 मध्ये home buyers संरक्षणासाठी; या परीक्षेच्या वेळी Jammu and Kashmir वर लागू नव्हती — तीनही विधाने. 2019 नंतर central laws UT वर extended, पण 2021 पेपर pre-extension स्थिती विचारते.

subject: Economy
question: पुढीलपैकी याचा/यांचा सहस्त्रकीय विकास उद्दीष्टांमध्ये समावेश होत नाही? (a) प्राथमिक शिक्षणाचे सार्वत्रीकरण साध्य करणे. (b) स्त्री-पुरुष समानतेस प्रोत्साहन देणे. (c) अर्भक मृत्यूचे प्रमाण कमी करणे. (d) पर्यावरणीय शाश्वतता (सस्टेनेबिलीटी) सुरक्षित करणे.
explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. Universal primary education, gender equality, environmental sustainability हे MDGs होते. 'Reducing infant mortality' standalone MDG नाही — MDG 4 ने under-five child mortality reduction लक्ष्य.

subject: General Studies
question: भारतीय लोकसंख्येच्या बाबतीत खालीलपैकी काय खरे आहे? (a) वार्षिक लोकसंख्या वृद्धीदर घटत आहे. (b) लोकसंख्येतील तरुण लोकसंख्येचा हिस्सा कमी होण्यास सुरुवात झाली आहे.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय C चिन्हांकित केला. भारताचा annual population growth rate दशकांपासून घटत आहे, आणि fertility घटल्यामुळे young population (15 खालील) चा वाटा कमी होऊ लागला — Census व SRS data मध्ये दोन्ही.

subject: Economy
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान/विधाने राष्ट्रीय जनसंख्या धोरण, 2000 च्या ध्येय साध्य करण्याच्या संदर्भात योग्य आहे/आहेत ? (a) मुले आणि मुली या दोघांच्या बाबतीत प्राथमिक आणि माध्यमिक शाळा पातळीवरील गळती 30 टक्केपेक्षा खाली आणणे. (b) जन्माच्या वेळचे दर हजारी अर्भक मृत्यू दर 20 पेक्षा कमी करणे/खाली आणणे. (c) जन्माच्या वेळचे माता मृत्यू दर गुणोत्तर दर लाखामागे/लाखाला 100 पेक्षा खाली आणणे. (d) जन्म, मृत्यू, विवाह आणि गरोदरपणा या संबंधित नोंदणी 100 टक्के पर्यंत साध्य करणे.
explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. National Population Policy 2000 ने MMR 100 पेक्षा कमी per 1,00,000 live births व births, deaths, marriages, pregnancies ची 100% registration — (c) व (d). IMR 20 खाली व dropout 30% खाली NPP 2000 ची stated targets नव्हती.

subject: Science
question: खालील विधाने पहा : (a) अणू हा विद्युतभार दृष्ट्या उदासीन असतो. (b) केंद्रकाभोवती फिरणाऱ्या सर्व इलेक्ट्रॉनचा ऋण विद्युतभार व केंद्रकावरील ऋण भार समान असतो.
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. अणूमध्ये proton व electron संख्या समान, म्हणून तो electrically neutral — विधान (a) बरोबर. nucleus वर proton मुळे positive charge असते, negative नाही — विधान (b) चुकीचे आहे.

subject: General Studies
question: लेसर किरण पृथ्वीवरून चंद्राकडे सोडल्यानंतर चंद्राच्या पृष्ठभागापासून परावर्तित होऊन पृथ्वीवर परत येण्यास 2.56 सेकंद लागतात. तर चंद्राच्या पृथ्वीभोवतीच्या परिभ्रमण कक्षेची त्रिज्या किती ?
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. pulse चंद्रावर जाऊन परत 2.56 s — one-way 1.28 s. Earth–Moon अंतर = c × t = 3 × 10⁸ × 1.28 = 3.84 × 10⁸ m — lunar orbit चा radius.

subject: Science
question: जर प्रकाश पहिल्या माध्यमातून 2 × 10⁸ ms⁻¹ वेगाने जाताना दुसऱ्या माध्यमात त्याचा वेग 1.25 × 10⁸ ms⁻¹ होत असेल तर दुसऱ्या माध्यमाचा पहिल्या माध्यमाच्या संदर्भातील अपवर्तनांक काढा.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. दुस-या माध्यमाचा पहिल्या माध्यमाशी refractive index n = v₁/v₂ = (2 × 10⁸) ÷ (1.25 × 10⁸) = 1.6. denser माध्यमात प्रकाश मंद होतो, म्हणून अनुपात 1 पेक्षा जास्त.

subject: Science
question: युकॅरीऑटीक (eukaryotic) पेशीं संदर्भात गुणसूत्र जनुकीय साहित्य DNA संबंधित खालील विधानांचा विचार करा. (a) युकॅरीऑटीक (eukaryotic) पेशीतील गुणसूत्रांमध्ये जीन साहित्य डी.एन.ए. (DNA) सोबत "हीस्टोन" लघु प्रथिने संलग्नित असतात. (b) या प्रथिनांमध्ये आरजेनीन व लायसीन या मूलभूत अमिनो आम्लाचा जास्त प्रमाणात सहभाग असतो. (c) या प्रथिनांमध्ये ट्रिप्टोफॅन या मूलभूत आम्लाचा अभाव असतो. खालीलपैकी योग्य पर्यायाची निवड करा :

options.C: फक्त पहिले व दुसरे विधान बरोबर आहे परंतु तिसरे चूक आहे.

explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Eukaryotic chromosomal DNA histone proteins भोवती — लहान, basic, arginine व lysine ने rich. Histones मध्ये tryptophan नाही — तीनही विधाने बरोबर.

subject: General Studies
question: इकॉलॉजी (Ecology) हा शब्द खालीलपैकी कोणत्या शास्त्रज्ञाद्वारे शोधण्यात आला ?
explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Ernst Heinrich Haeckel यांनी 1860 मध्ये "Ecology" हा शब्द रूज केला. Krebs, Tansley, Shelford नंतरच्या संकल्पना; मूळ शब्द नाही.

subject: General Studies
question: जर पाण्याची घनता 1000 kgm⁻³ आणि तांब्याची घनता 8.9 × 10³ kgm⁻³ असेल तर तांब्याची सापेक्ष घनता किती ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Relative density हे पदार्थाच्या density चे पाण्याशी अनुपात, unit नसते: (8.9 × 10³) ÷ 1000 = 8.9. kgm⁻³ किंवा 10 च्या extra powers ratio ऐवजी absolute density दाखवतात.

subject: Reasoning
question: खालीलपैकी कोणती प्रक्रिया श्वसन प्रक्रियेत अंतर्भूत नाही ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Glycolysis, citric acid (Krebs) cycle, electron transport chain — respiration चे मुख्य टप्पे. Calvin cycle photosynthesis मध्ये CO₂ fix करते — respiration चा भाग नाही.

subject: General Studies
question: एका माणसाला 25 किलो वजनाची बॅग 5 मीटर उंचीवर नेण्यास 30 सेकंद लागतात, तर त्या माणसाने वापरलेली शक्ती किती ?
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. Power = mgh/t = (25 × 9.8 × 5) ÷ 30 ≈ 40.83 W. bag उचलण्याचे mgh काम 30 सेकंदांनी भागले — work rate म्हणजे power.

explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. Chandigarh ची centenarian athlete Mann Kaur 100+ वयात masters athletics मध्ये पदके जिंकून 'Miracle Mom' म्हणून ओळखली — 2020–21 क्रीडा headline.

subject: General Studies
question: 2021 साली नोबेल शांतता पारितोषिक प्राप्त झालेल्या मारीया रेसा यांनी 'रॅप्लर' नावाची ______ स्थापन केली आहे.
explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. Filipino-American journalist Maria Ressa, 2021 Nobel Peace Prize सह-विजेती, Rappler सह-स्थापक — investigative journalism व तथ्य-तपासणी digital platform.

subject: Polity
question: संघ सरकारने जैन समुदायाचा देखील समावेश अल्पसंख्याकांच्या यादीमध्ये केला आहे. या संदर्भात खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या : (a) देशात आता अधिकृत असे सहा अल्पसंख्याक समुदाय आहेत. (b) अल्पसंख्यांक यादीमध्ये एखाद्या समुदायाचा समावेश करण्यासाठी संसदेने साध्या बहुमताने घटनादुरुस्ती मंजूर करणे आवश्यक असते. (c) भारत सरकारच्या अल्पसंख्यांक व्यवहार मंत्रालयाची स्थापना 2009 मध्ये झाली आहे. वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने योग्य आहे/त ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Jain सहावा notified minority (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi नंतर) — बरोबर. यादीत simple-majority घटनादुरुस्ती नाही, executive notification; Ministry 2006, 2009 नाही.

subject: Reasoning
question: वांग यापिंग, या अलीकडेच अंतराळात चालून आलेल्या अंतराळवीर ________ नागरिक आहेत.
explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. Wang Yaping नोव्हेंबर 2021 मध्ये Shenzhou-13 दरम्यान spacewalk करणारी पहिली Chinese woman astronaut — 2021 space headline.

subject: General Studies
question: 2020 च्या मानवी विकास अहवालात (युएनडीपी तर्फे प्रसिद्ध झालेल्या) मानवी विकास आणि ______ यांच्यामधील संबंधांवर भर दिलेला आहे.
explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. UNDP Human Development Report 2020 Anthropocene भोवती — मानवी विकास आणि पृथ्वीवरील मानवी प्रभुत्वाचा काळ जोडतो.

subject: Economy
question: 2020 चा बुकर पुरस्कार खालीलपैकी कोणत्या कादंबरीला मिळाला आहे ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. Douglas Stuart यांचे Shuggie Bain Booker Prize 2020 — Glasgow मधील गरीबी व आईच्या alcoholism ची कथा.

subject: Economy
question: प्रमुख भूमिकेतील अभिनेत्याचे 2021 चे ऑस्कर पारितोषिक ________ यांनी जिंकले.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय C चिन्हांकित केला. 2021 Oscars (2020 चित्रपट) मध्ये Anthony Hopkins The Father साठी Best Actor — Chadwick Boseman ला मागे टाकले.

subject: General Studies
question: संयुक्त राष्ट्रांशी संबंधित संस्थेने चालवलेले 'ब्लु हार्ट अभियान' खालीलपैकी कशाशी संबंधित आहे ?
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. UNODC चा Blue Heart Campaign human trafficking विरुद्ध जागरूकता — blue heart हे पीडितांचे दु:ख व traffickers च्या cold-heartedness चे प्रतीक.

subject: Economy
question: 'अँथ्रोपोसिन' या संज्ञेचा नेहमी वापर करणारे आणि 1995 साली ज्यांना रसायनशास्त्राचे नोबेल पारितोषिक मिळाले ते पॉल जे. क्रुटझन हे _________ चे नागरिक होते.
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Dutch atmospheric chemist Paul J. Crutzen यांनी 'Anthropocene' popular केले, 1995 Chemistry Nobel ozone layer research साठी.

subject: General Studies
question: भारतातील साहित्यिक क्षेत्रातील सर्वोच्च पुरस्कार मानला गेलेला 'ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार' ________ पुरस्कृत केला आहे.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. Jnanpith Award — भारतातील सर्वोच्च साहित्यिक सन्मान — Bharatiya Jnanpith (Sahu Jain family trust) प्रायोजित, सरकार नाही.

subject: General Studies
question: Research was done at ______ with reference to the Middle Age and Copper Age in terms of human settlement in Maharashtra.
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Patne (Jalgaon), Hatkhamba (Ratnagiri), and Inamgaon (Pune) are all well-known excavation sites where research on Chalcolithic (Copper Age) and early historic settlement in Maharashtra was carried out. MPSC bundles such Maharashtra archaeology sites together often.

subject: General Studies
question: 6,328 चौ.किमी. क्षेत्रात पसरलेल्या मुंबई महानगर परिक्षेत्रामध्ये ________ महानगरपालिका आहेत.
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMRDA नुसार ~6,328 sq km) मध्ये नऊ municipal corporations — BMC, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Kalyan-Dombivli, Ulhasnagar, Bhiwandi-Nizampur, Mira-Bhayandar, Vasai-Virar, Panvel.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) India - (i) Ladang (b) Central America - (ii) Roca (c) Brazil - (iii) Milpa (d) Indonesia - (iv) Jhum
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Shifting cultivation names map as India–Jhum, Central America–Milpa, Brazil–Roca, and Indonesia–Ladang, giving the sequence (iv) (iii) (ii) (i). Pair the region with its local term before scanning the code.

subject: General Studies
question: बँका आणि त्यांची घोषवाक्ये यांच्या जोड्यांपैकी पुढील पर्यायांतून योग्य जोडी कोणती/कोणत्या आहेत ते निवडा. (a) पंजाब नॅशनल बँक - 'द नेम यू कॅन बँक अपॉन' (b) युनियन बँक ऑफ इंडिया - 'गुड पीपल टू बँक विथ' (c) एच.एस.बी.सी. (HSBC) - 'वर्ल्ड्स लोकल बँक' (d) बँक ऑफ महाराष्ट्र - 'वन फॅमिली वन बँक'
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. चारही slogans जुळतात: PNB — 'The Name you can Bank Upon'; Union Bank — 'Good People to Bank with'; HSBC — 'The World's Local Bank'; Bank of Maharashtra — 'One Family One Bank'.

subject: General Studies
question: Observe the following statements : (a) Sagar cyclonic storm originated in May 2019 in Arabian Sea. (b) Sagar cyclonic storm disrupted properties on South Konkan coast.
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Cyclone Sagar formed in May 2018 over the Gulf of Aden/western Arabian Sea and hit the Horn of Africa — not May 2019, and its track did not disrupt the South Konkan coast. Both statements in the stem are factually off.

subject: Polity
question: खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या : (a) 31 ऑक्टोबर 2019 रोजी लडाख हे केंद्रशासित प्रदेश बनले. (b) केंद्रशासित प्रदेश लडाख मध्ये लेह आणि कारगिल या दोन जिल्ह्यांचा अंतर्भाव आहे. (c) उमंग नरुला हे लडाखचे नायब राज्यपाल आहेत. कोणते कथन अयोग्य आहे ?
explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Ladakh 31 ऑक्टोबर 2019 ला UT, Leh व Kargil — (a), (b) बरोबर. Umang Narula Ladakh चे Lieutenant Governor नव्हते; Radha Krishna Mathur प्रथम LG.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Consequent - (i) Stream develops valley across outcrop (b) Obsequent - (ii) Flow controlled by original slope (c) Subsequent - (iii) Flowing opposite to the dip of rock (d) Braided - (iv) Maze of interconnected channels
explanation: On this one, option B. Consequent streams follow the original regional slope; obsequent ones run opposite to rock dip; subsequent streams cut across resistant outcrops; braided streams split into a maze of interconnected channels. Match each river type to its defining behaviour.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Cepheid Theory - (i) Laplace (b) Electromagnetic Theory - (ii) Dr. Banerji (c) Nebular Theory - (iii) Alfven (d) Binary Theory - (iv) Lyttleton
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Cepheid Theory is linked to Dr. Banerji, Electromagnetic Theory to Alfven, Nebular Theory to Laplace, and Binary Theory to Lyttleton. Origin-of-Earth theories are a fixed matching set in geography papers.

subject: General Studies
question: The father of Human Geography is _______.
explanation: The right pick is option C. Paul Vidal de la Blache, the French geographer who stressed human–environment interaction and regional synthesis, is widely called the father of Human Geography. Herodotus and Hecataeus are early geographers; Brunhes worked on human geography later but the title goes to Vidal-de-la-Blache.

subject: Geography
question: Observe the following statements : (a) Jhelum is a tributary of River Indus and flows through Lake Wular. (b) Sutlej is a southern tributary of River Indus.
explanation: Go with option C. Jhelum is an Indus tributary that passes through Wular Lake in Kashmir, and Sutlej joins the Indus from the south/east after flowing through Punjab. Both statements in the stem hold for the Indus system.

subject: Geography
question: Observe the statements regarding agriculture in Maharashtra : (a) Soil erosion is not a serious problem of agriculture. (b) Soil erosion takes place due to flooding in rivers, forest cutting and uncontrolled grazing. (c) Soils are saline due to over-irrigation.
explanation: The right pick is option A. Soil erosion is a serious problem in Maharashtra — statement (a) is false. Flooding, deforestation, and uncontrolled grazing do cause erosion, and over-irrigation can leave soils saline. Only (b) and (c) survive.

subject: Geography
question: Observe the following statements : (a) Mountain located between Pravara and Kukadi river is Harishchandra mountain. (b) River Manjira flows on Balaghat Plateau. (c) Satmala and Ajantha mountain ranges are between Tapi and Godavari river valleys.

options.D: All the above statements are correct

explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Harishchandra range lies between the Pravara and Kukadi rivers; Manjira drains the Balaghat plateau tract; and Satmala–Ajantha ranges sit between the Tapi and Godavari valleys. All three Maharashtra landform statements are correct.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following statements are correct about Bhabhar Plains ? (a) The porosity is very high and hence small rivers disappear. (b) The Bhabhar tract is suitable for crops. (c) The inhabitants of the Bhabhar Plains are cattle-keeping Gujjars.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Bhabhar tracts are highly porous boulder beds where streams sink, so they are not crop-friendly; Gujjars traditionally graze cattle there. Statement (b) alone is wrong — agriculture belongs to the adjoining Terai, not the Bhabhar belt.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Monoclinal fold - (i) Both limbs parallel but inclined to one side (b) Isoclinal fold - (ii) One limb turned over the other limb (c) Recumbent fold - (iii) One limb inclined and the other perpendicular (d) Overturned fold - (iv) Both limbs parallel to each other and the ground
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Monoclinal folds show one limb inclined and the other nearly perpendicular; isoclinal folds have both limbs parallel but tilted; recumbent folds lie with limbs parallel to the ground; overturned folds have one limb flipped over the other. Use the limb geometry given in List II.

subject: Geography
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Dome-shaped Plateau - (i) Deccan Plateau (b) Volcanic Plateau - (ii) Vindhya Plateau (c) Step-like Plateau - (iii) Chota Nagpur Plateau (d) Piedmont Plateau - (iv) Shillong Plateau
explanation: On this one, option C. Chota Nagpur is the classic dome-shaped plateau, the Deccan is a volcanic lava plateau, the Vindhyan tract forms a step-like dissected plateau, and the Shillong plateau is a piedmont feature at the foot of the Khasi hills. Plateau type and example must move as a unit.

subject: Geography
question: Find the correct pair : Dams/Projects - Rivers - States (a) Tehri Dam - (i) Kaveri - (I) Jammu & Kashmir (b) Dulhasti Project - (ii) Bhagirathi - (II) Rajasthan (c) Shivasamudra Dam - (iii) Chambal - (III) Uttarakhand (d) Rana Pratap Sagar Project - (iv) Chenab - (IV) Karnataka
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Only the triple Shivasamudra Dam – Kaveri – Karnataka is correct; Tehri is on the Bhagirathi in Uttarakhand, Dulhasti on the Chenab in J&K, and Rana Pratap Sagar on the Chambal in Rajasthan. Cross-check dam, river, and state together.

subject: General Studies
question: Biosphere reserves are demarcated into ______ .

options.A: Core zone, buffer zone and transition zone
options.B: Core zone, buffer zone and micro ecological zone
options.C: Buffer zone, transition zone and micro ecological zone
options.D: Core zone, transition zone and micro ecological zone

explanation: Pick option A. UNESCO's Man and Biosphere programme divides each biosphere reserve into a strictly protected core zone, a buffer zone for limited activity, and a transition zone where sustainable human use is allowed. The other options swap in non-standard labels.

subject: Geography
question: In India, which of the following has become a hot-spot with reference to threats to biodiversity ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Northeastern India falls in the Indo-Burma global biodiversity hotspot and faces habitat loss, fragmentation, and hunting pressure. The northwest, Deccan interior, and western dry tracts are stressed too, but NE India is the standout hotspot answer in MPSC environment sets.

subject: General Studies
question: Examine the following statements and select the proper options : Statement (A) : Every longitude has a different local time due to the rotation of the Earth. Statement (B) : Standard time system is utilized to remove the difference in the local time.

options.B: Statement (A) is correct but statement (B) is wrong
options.C: Statement (A) is wrong but statement (B) is correct

explanation: Go with option A. Earth's rotation makes local solar time differ for every longitude, and countries adopt standard time (fixed meridian) precisely to avoid that confusion in clocks and schedules. Both Statement (A) and Statement (B) are correct according to the textbook.

subject: General Studies
question: What is Alpha, Beta and Gamma Diversity ? (a) Richness of species (b) Simpson's Diversity Index (c) For measuring biodiversity over geographical scale (d) Whittaker (1972) suggested these terms Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Alpha, beta, and gamma diversity measure species richness at local, between-habitat, and regional scales respectively — that is their core purpose across a geographical gradient. They are not Simpson's index, and the key here accepts only the scale-based description in (c).

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Andhra Pradesh - (i) Radhanagari (b) Maharashtra - (ii) Bhagwan Mahavir (c) West Bengal - (iii) Pulicat (d) Goa - (iv) Jaldapara
explanation: The right pick is option C. Pulicat (shared with Andhra Pradesh), Radhanagari (Maharashtra), Jaldapara (West Bengal), and Bhagwan Mahavir (Goa) match in the order (iii) (i) (iv) (ii). State–protected-area pairs are high-yield MPSC revision.

subject: Economy
question: Given the importance of supply side factors in determination of inflation in India, following long-term policies are likely to help. (a) Changing production patterns (b) Calibrated import policy (c) Focus on transportation (d) Storage infrastructure for perishable commodities Which of the above options is/are correct ?
explanation: On this one, option D. Supply-side inflation in India responds to production-pattern shifts, calibrated imports, better transport logistics, and cold-chain storage for perishables — each listed policy eases bottlenecks that push prices up. All four belong on the supply-side checklist.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following factors are included in chemical environment ? (a) Temperature and soil (b) Water and soil (c) Vegetation and water (d) Human functions and Biological components Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: Pick option D. Chemical environment in ecology means abiotic chemical factors such as nutrients, gases, and pH — not mixed lists of temperature, soil, vegetation, or human activity bundled as in (a)–(d). None of the four options states that correctly.

subject: General Studies
question: Which factor is not considered while calculating Physical Quality of Life Index (PQLI) ?
explanation: Go with option B. Morris David Morris's Physical Quality of Life Index combines life expectancy, infant mortality, and literacy — not per capita income, which enters HDI-style indices instead. Income is the deliberate distractor here.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following are characteristics of Coral Reefs ? (a) These are the oldest living communities on Earth. (b) It is a high biomass producer. (c) It is a rich floral and fauna diversity. (d) These are shallow water tropical ecosystems. Which of the above statement/s is/are correct ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Coral reefs are among Earth's oldest living communities, support very high biomass, harbour rich flora and fauna, and thrive in shallow tropical seas. All four listed traits apply — do not drop any statement when revising reef ecology.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following programmes have been supported by United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) along with Government of India for poverty reduction and livelihoods promotion ? (a) Affordable Rural Housing for All (b) Improving Efficiency of Health Care System in Multiple States (2013 - 2017) (c) Governance and Accelerated Livelihoods Support (GOALS) (2013 - 2017) (d) Strengthening National Capacities in Tribal Areas (2013 - 2017)
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. UNDP partnered with the Government of India on all four listed initiatives — rural housing, multi-state health efficiency, GOALS livelihood support, and tribal-area capacity building (2013–2017 window). Do not treat any single scheme as the only UNDP tie-up.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following statements are correct about the Total Poverty Gap (TPG) ?

options.A: TPG measures the total amount of income necessary to raise everyone below poverty line up to that line.
options.B: TPG is the number of those whose incomes fall below absolute poverty line.
options.C: TPG measures the share of total national income that each factor of production receives.
options.D: TPG measures the relative degree of income inequality in a country.

explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Total Poverty Gap adds up, across all poor households, the shortfall between each person's income and the poverty line — the rupee amount needed to lift everyone to the line. Options (b)–(d) describe headcount, factor shares, and inequality instead.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following is/are applicable to Gender Inequality Index (GII) ? (a) It provides insights into gender disparities in health, empowerment and the labour market. (b) Higher values in the GII indicate worse achievements. (c) The empowerment dimension is partly measured by the share of parliamentary seats held by each gender.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Gender Inequality Index tracks disparities in health, empowerment, and labour-market participation; higher GII values mean worse outcomes; and parliamentary seat share by gender feeds into the empowerment dimension. All three statements match UNDP's GII framework.

subject: Reasoning
question: Which of the following States had the lowest child sex ratio in 2011 ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. Among these four states in Census 2011, Maharashtra's child sex ratio (0–6 years) was 894 — lower than Karnataka (948), Madhya Pradesh (918), and Kerala (964). MPSC often tests state-level demographic figures alongside the national average of 919.

subject: Economy
question: Government of Maharashtra has adopted gender budgeting from the year _________.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Maharashtra introduced gender budgeting in its state budget from fiscal year 2013–14, publishing a dedicated gender budget statement each year since. State budget reforms like this are pinned to specific launch years in MPSC Maharashtra modules.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statements is/are correct about UN Conference on Sustainable Development Rio+20 ?

options.A: The conference was held in June 2014 in Brazil.
options.B: The conference laid out Millennium Development Goals for the world.
options.C: The conference adopted guidelines on green economy policies.
options.D: The member nations de-powered UN Environment Programme in this conference.

explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Rio+20 (June 2012, Rio de Janeiro — not 2014) focused on sustainable development and produced guidance on green-economy policies; it did not lay out the MDGs, and it strengthened rather than weakened UNEP.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statement/s is/are applicable to the web based utility — BhoomiRashi ? (a) It was launched on 1st April, 2018. (b) It has been launched by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways. (c) It has been introduced to fully digitize and automate the entire process of land acquisition.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. BhoomiRashi is the MoRTH web utility launched on 1 April 2018 to fully digitise and automate land acquisition for highway projects. It replaces manual, paper-heavy compensation and possession workflows with an online end-to-end system.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following, according to the World Bank, are critical issues to be addressed in India's urbanisation ? (a) Poor local governance (b) Weak finances (c) Inappropriate planning leading to high costs (d) Rapidly deteriorating environment
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. The World Bank flags poor local governance, weak municipal finances, costly inappropriate planning, and a rapidly deteriorating urban environment as the core bottlenecks in India's urbanisation. Each listed factor is a documented constraint, not an isolated issue.

subject: Economy
question: Goal-wise performance of India by NITI Aayog SDG India Index Report (2020 - 21) reveals that _________. (a) India's overall score improved to 66 in 2020 - 21 from 60 in 2019 - 20 and 57 in 2018 - 19. (b) Despite 2020 - 21 being a pandemic year, India performed well on eight of the 15 SDGs. Which of the above options is/are correct ?
explanation: On this one, option C. NITI Aayog's SDG India Index 2020–21 reported India's composite score rising from 57 (2018–19) and 60 (2019–20) to 66, and noted solid progress on eight of the 15 SDGs despite the pandemic year. Both statements in the stem are supported by that report.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following statements is/are true about Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) achievements in India ? (a) India has achieved the poverty reduction in an even manner. (b) India was on-track to achieve the hunger target after the 2015 deadline. (c) Empowering women remains a major development challenge.
explanation: Option A fits the facts. Poverty reduction was regionally uneven, not evenly spread across India. India missed the MDG hunger target by 2015, yet post-deadline progress kept the country moving toward that goal; women's empowerment remains a major unfinished challenge.

subject: General Studies
question: Name the online platform launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development to support women entrepreneurs.
explanation: Go with option C. Mahila E-Haat is the online platform the Ministry of Women and Child Development launched to help women entrepreneurs showcase and sell products. One Stop Centre and SWADHAR are welfare schemes, not e-commerce portals.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following statements is/are correct about National Commission for Scheduled Tribes [NCST] ? (a) It is a constitutional body which came into existence in 2004. (b) Its function is to inquire into specific complaints with respect to the deprivation of rights and safeguards of Scheduled Tribes. (c) It works to improve literacy rate of Tribal community. (d) Its function is to facilitate women empowerment of Tribal women.
explanation: The right pick is option D. NCST is the constitutional commission for Scheduled Tribes (in force since 2004 under the 89th Amendment); it inquires into specific complaints about deprivation of ST rights and safeguards, and its mandate covers tribal welfare measures including literacy and women's empowerment.

subject: General Studies
question: National Policy on Voluntary Sector (2007) covers which of the following voluntary organizations ? (a) Formal and Informal Groups (b) Community-based organizations (c) Charitable organizations (d) Support organizations
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. The National Policy on Voluntary Sector (2007) explicitly covers formal and informal groups, community-based organisations, charitable bodies, and support organisations — the full spectrum of voluntary action.

subject: General Studies
question: When a potential difference of 33 V is applied to a device whose resistance is 110 Ω, some current flows through it. If the same current is to be passed through a device whose resistance is 500 Ω, then how much potential difference is to be applied ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Current I = V/R = 33/110 = 0.3 A. For the same current through 500 Ω, V = IR = 0.3 × 500 = 150 V. Ohm's law links the two resistances through a fixed current.

subject: General Studies
question: Which one of the following is a natural magnet ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Lodestone (magnetite, Fe₃O₄) occurs naturally and was the first known magnet; copper, silicon, and zinc are not natural magnets. Keep magnetite separate from artificially magnetised iron in your notes.

subject: General Studies
question: SONAR (Sound Navigational Ranging) technique is used for _________.

options.B: the study of heart valve action
options.D: measuring motion and position of the submerged objects like submarines

explanation: On this one, option D. SONAR sends sound pulses underwater and reads the echoes to locate submerged objects such as submarines and map the seabed. Medical ultrasound uses similar physics but SONAR as a term refers to navigational ranging in water.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following methods is used for measurement of distance between Earth and planets ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Astronomers use the parallax method — measuring a nearby object's apparent shift against distant stars from two observation points — to estimate distances to planets and nearby stars. Direct tape-measurement or echo ranging does not work at planetary scales.

subject: General Studies
question: A cat is sitting in between two plane mirrors. If the angle between two plane mirrors is 30 degrees, how many images of the cat will appear ?
explanation: Go with option C. For two plane mirrors inclined at θ, the number of images = (360/θ) − 1. With θ = 30°, that gives (360/30) − 1 = 11 images. This formula assumes the object sits between the mirrors.

subject: Reasoning
question: What will be the eye colour of all female individuals in F1 generation when a white eyed female Drosophila is crossed with a red eyed male Drosophila ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Eye colour in Drosophila is X-linked: a white-eyed female (XʷXʷ) crossed with a red-eyed male (X⁺Y) gives all F1 females X⁺Xʷ — heterozygous red-eyed. Males in F1 would be white-eyed, but the question asks only about females.

subject: General Studies
question: Calculate the distance travelled by a sound wave having frequency 1000 Hz and wavelength 0.25 m, if it travels for 5 seconds in a certain medium.
explanation: Pick option B. Wave speed v = fλ = 1000 × 0.25 = 250 m/s; distance in 5 s = 250 × 5 = 1250 m. Options quoting kilometres are unit traps — multiply frequency and wavelength first, then time.

subject: General Studies
question: Which steps of taxons are followed for classification of animals ?

options.A: Species → Genus → Order → Class → Family → Phylum → Kingdom
options.B: Kingdom → Genus → Order → Species → Phylum → Class → Family
options.C: Genus → Species → Phylum → Class → Order → Family → Kingdom
options.D: Kingdom → Phylum → Class → Order → Family → Genus → Species

explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Animal classification follows the hierarchy Kingdom → Phylum → Class → Order → Family → Genus → Species (largest to smallest). The other options scramble or reverse this sequence.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following substances are components of soil ? (a) Stones and sand (b) Fine soil and decomposed matter (c) Chemical substances (d) Colour substances (Dyes)
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Natural soil is a mix of mineral particles (stones, sand), fine soil and humus, chemical ions, and organic colouring matter — all four listed components appear in standard soil-composition descriptions used in this syllabus.

subject: Science
question: Viroids are identified on the basis of which of the following three characteristic features ? (a) Much smaller in size than viruses (b) Consist of circular RNA molecule (c) RNA molecule covered by protein coat (d) Infect the plant cells
explanation: The right pick is option A. Viroids are much smaller than viruses, consist of circular RNA without a protein coat, and infect plant cells. Statement (c) is wrong — the absence of a protein coat is what distinguishes viroids from viruses.

subject: Science
question: Ecosystem is a self-regulatory and self-sustained structural and functional unit of nature where biotic and abiotic components are linked together with the following processes : (a) Productivity (b) Decomposition (c) Nutrient cycling (d) Energy flow Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. A functional ecosystem links biotic and abiotic parts through productivity, decomposition, nutrient cycling, and energy flow — all four processes are textbook pillars of ecosystem dynamics.

subject: General Studies
question: Pituitary gland is endocrine gland connected to hypothalamus at the base of the brain. It secretes many hormones. (a) It is called as master endocrine gland. (b) Its anterior part is neurohypophysis and posterior is adenohypophysis. (c) Oxytocin and Vasopressin are secreted by posterior pituitary. (d) STH, TSH, ACTH are secreted by adenohypophysis. Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: On this one, option B according to the answer key — (a) the pituitary is the master endocrine gland, and (c) oxytocin and vasopressin come from the posterior lobe. Statement (b) reverses anterior and posterior names; note that (d) is also factually correct in standard texts but is not part of the keyed answer.

subject: Science
question: In a diamond, each carbon atom is _________ surrounded by other carbon atoms.
explanation: Pick option B. In diamond every carbon atom is sp³-hybridised and bonded tetrahedrally to four neighbours, giving the rigid three-dimensional lattice responsible for diamond's hardness. Linear, tetragonal, and octahedral arrangements do not describe diamond's structure.

subject: Reasoning
question: During Krebs cycle in respiration, fumaric acid gets converted into malic acid by
explanation: Go with option B as marked in the answer key: fumaric acid → malic acid in the Krebs cycle is listed under dehydrogenation. Standard biochemistry texts describe this step as hydration (fumarase adds water); if your notes differ, follow the official key for the exam.

subject: Science
question: An atomic number of Tritium is ______.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Tritium is hydrogen-3 (¹H or ³H): one proton in the nucleus, so its atomic number is 1, the same as ordinary hydrogen. Extra neutrons change the mass number, not the atomic number.

subject: General Studies
question: The electrostatic repulsion between electron pairs such as lone pair - lone pair (l.p. - l.p.), bond pair - bond pair (b.p. - b.p.) and lone pair - bond pair (l.p. - b.p.) in a given valence shell decreases in the order of ______.

options.A: l.p. - l.p. < l.p. - b.p. < b.p. - b.p.
options.B: l.p. - l.p. > l.p. - b.p. > b.p. - b.p.
options.C: b.p. - b.p. < l.p. - l.p. < l.p. - b.p.
options.D: l.p. - b.p. > b.p. - b.p. > l.p. - l.p.

explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Lone pairs sit closer to the nucleus and occupy more space, so l.p.–l.p. repulsion is strongest, then l.p.–b.p., and b.p.–b.p. is weakest — that order drives VSEPR shapes in molecules like water and ammonia.

subject: General Studies
question: The ______ part of the Earth's atmosphere contains about 70% of the total air in the atmosphere.
explanation: The right pick is option D. The troposphere — the lowest layer, up to about 8–15 km — holds roughly 75–80% of the atmosphere's total mass and about 70% of its air by volume. Weather, clouds, and most water vapour sit here.

subject: General Studies
question: The maximum number of molecules are present in ______. [H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, I = 127]
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Compare moles: 10 g H₂ = 10/2 = 5 mol; 45 g H₂O = 2.5 mol; 22 g CO₂ = 0.5 mol; 250 g I₂ ≈ 0.98 mol. Five moles means the largest count of molecules, so 10 g hydrogen gas wins.

subject: General Studies
question: Who among the following was the first Chairperson of the National Commission for Women ?
explanation: The right pick is option A. Jayanti Patnaik was the first Chairperson of the National Commission for Women when it was set up in 1992. Dr Poornima Advani and Dr V. Mohini Giri served later; Vibha Parthasarathy was an NCW member, not the founding chair.

subject: Polity
question: "Directive Principles is a novel feature in a constitution framed for parliamentary democracy. They have no binding force. But whoever captures power will not be free to do what he likes with it. He will have to respect the Directive Principles. He cannot ignore them. He may not have to answer for their breach in a court of law, but he will certainly have to answer for them before the electorate at election time." Who said this ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Dr B.R. Ambedkar said Directive Principles have no legal binding force yet constrain any government in power — it must answer to the electorate even if not to a court. This captures his view of DPSP as moral-political directives.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements about the Comptroller and Auditor General of India : (a) He holds office during the pleasure of the President. (b) He draws the same salary as a Supreme Court Judge. (c) Before entering upon his office, he swears an oath or affirmation before the Chief Justice of India. (d) He may be removed by the President only after an enquiry by the Supreme Court of India. Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. The CAG's salary equals that of a Supreme Court judge (Art. 125 read with Art. 148). He does not hold office at the President's pleasure, swears before the President (not the CJI), and removal follows the SC-judge route through Parliament — not a prior Supreme Court enquiry.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following provisions were made by the 44th Amendment Act of 1978 ? (a) Provided for the creation of the All India Judicial Service. (b) Empowered the President to send back once, the advice of the Cabinet for reconsideration. (c) Provided that the Fundamental Rights guaranteed by Article 20 and Article 21 cannot be suspended during the National Emergency. (d) Shifted five subjects from the State list to the Concurrent list.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. The 44th Amendment (1978) restored the President's power to return cabinet advice once for reconsideration and barred suspension of Articles 20 and 21 during emergency. All-India Judicial Service and shifting five State-list subjects came from the 42nd Amendment, not the 44th.

subject: Polity
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament of India to create or abolish Legislative Councils, if the Legislative Assembly of the State passes a resolution to that effect ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Article 169 empowers Parliament to create or abolish a state's Legislative Council when the Legislative Assembly passes the required resolution by a special majority. Articles 166–168 cover state executive and legislature structure, not this power.

subject: Polity
question: According to the provision of which Article of the Constitution can the President of India ask for advice from the Supreme Court ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Article 143 lets the President seek the Supreme Court's opinion on questions of law or fact of public importance — the advisory jurisdiction. Article 142 is for enforcement decrees; 145 and 147 cover rules and staff of the Court.

subject: Polity
question: The National Commission for Scheduled Castes (SC) is constituted by which Article of the Constitution ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. Article 338 (as amended) provides for the National Commission for Scheduled Castes. Articles 335–337 are older reservation and educational provisions; the NCSC's constitutional base is 338.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following committees contains representatives of both the Houses of the Parliament ? (a) Committee on Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (b) Committee on Empowerment of Women (c) Business Advisory Committee (d) Committee on Privileges (e) Estimates Committee
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Joint committees of both Houses include the Committee on Welfare of SCs/STs and the Committee on Empowerment of Women. Business Advisory, Privileges, and Estimates are House-specific — Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha panels, not joint bodies.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements : (a) No person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offence more than once, including any departmental proceedings. (b) The protection against self-incrimination extends to both oral evidence and documentary evidence. (c) The protection against self-incrimination extends to both criminal and civil proceedings.
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Article 20(3) protection against self-incrimination covers oral testimony and documents the accused is compelled to produce — not every civil suit. Double jeopardy under Article 20(2) shields against a second prosecution for the same offence, not routine departmental action.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements and choose the correct option : (a) The special provisions for Nagaland are made in Article 371 (A). (b) No act of the Parliament in respect to the religious or social practices of Nagas can be applied without the approval of the Legislative Assembly of Nagaland. (c) Tuensang is the most developed district of Nagaland.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Article 371(A) gives Nagaland special status, and Parliament cannot apply laws on Naga religious or social practices without the State Assembly's approval. Tuensang was historically underdeveloped and specially administered — not the most developed district.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following is not a Panchsheel principle of India's foreign policy ?

options.A: Mutual respect for each other's territorial integrity and sovereignty

explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Mutual respect for territorial integrity, mutual non-interference, and peaceful coexistence are all core Panchsheel principles from the 1954 agreement. The question asks which is not Panchsheel — since every listed phrase belongs to Panchsheel, "None of the above" is correct.

subject: Polity
question: Which one of the following statements about dismissal or removal of persons employed in civil capacities under the Union or State (Article 311) is not correct ?

options.A: Protection under Article 311 is not available to military personnel.
options.B: The employees of statutory corporations such as the LIC, ONGC are not entitled to the protection of Article 311.
options.C: The provisions of Article 311 are applicable to permanent civil servants only and not to temporary servants.
options.D: Suspension of government servant from service is neither dismissal nor removal and is not within the scope of protection of Article 311.

explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Article 311 safeguards civil servants against arbitrary dismissal or removal — including temporary appointees who hold a civil post under the Union or State. Saying protection applies only to permanent staff and excludes temporary servants is the incorrect statement.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements and choose the correct option : (a) The subject, 'Co-operative Societies' has been included in the Constitution of India by the 97th Amendment in 2011. (b) The right to establish 'Co-operative Societies' is given in Article 19(1)(c). (c) The first law related to Co-operative Societies in India was passed in the tenure of Lord Curzon.

options.D: All the three statements are correct

explanation: The right pick is option D. The 97th Amendment (2011) added co-operative societies to the Constitution; Article 19(1)(c) covers the right to form them; and the first co-operative law in India was the Cooperative Credit Societies Act, 1904, passed during Lord Curzon's tenure.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements : (a) A panel of Chairpersons is elected by the Lok Sabha from amongst its members. (b) A member of the panel of Chairpersons can preside over the Lok Sabha when the office of the Speaker or the Deputy Speaker is vacant. (c) In absence of the Speaker, the Deputy Speaker and member of the panel of Chairpersons, the Speaker's duties are to be performed by a member appointed by the President. Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The Speaker nominates — the House does not elect — a panel of chairpersons for short absences. A panel member cannot preside when both Speaker and Deputy Speaker offices are vacant, and the President does not step in for routine absence under Lok Sabha rules.

subject: History
question: On 13th December, 1946 ______ moved the Objective Resolution in the Constituent Assembly of India.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. On 13 December 1946, Jawaharlal Nehru moved the Objective Resolution in the Constituent Assembly — the charter of India's constitutional goals. Dr Rajendra Prasad presided; he did not move the resolution.

subject: General Studies
question: The oxidation state of V in V₂O₇⁻⁴ is ______.
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. For V₂O₇⁴⁻: 2x + 7(−2) = −4 gives 2x − 14 = −4, so x = +5. Balance oxygen first, then solve for vanadium — a standard oxidation-state drill.

subject: General Studies
question: R. Nagaswamy died in January 2022. He was related to the field of ______.
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. R. Nagaswamy (1930–2022) was a pioneering Tamil archaeologist, epigraphist, and former Director of the Tamil Nadu Archaeology Department — known for temple art, inscriptions, and Chola studies.

subject: General Studies
question: Which country launched the Hwasong-12 mid-range ballistic missile ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. North Korea test-fired the Hwasong-12, a mid-range ballistic missile, as part of its missile programme. China, Japan, and South Korea did not launch this system.

subject: General Studies
question: Who amongst the following was chosen as the 'Time Person of the Year, 2021' by the Internationally acclaimed magazine — Time ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. Time magazine named Elon Musk its Person of the Year for 2021, citing his impact on space, electric vehicles, and public markets. Malala, Ratan Tata, and Kamala Harris were not the 2021 choice.

subject: General Studies
question: Choose the appropriate option among the following statements : (a) Crimea was a part of Ukraine till 2014. (b) Russia annexed Crimea in 2014. (c) NATO consists of 30 member countries.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Crimea was part of Ukraine until Russia annexed it in March 2014, and NATO had 30 member countries at the time of this 2022 paper (before Finland and Sweden joined later). All three statements hold for the exam frame.

subject: Economy
question: How much tax would be imposed on Cryptocurrency, as declared by the Central Finance Minister, Nirmala Sitharaman in the Budget 2022 - 23 ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Budget 2022-23 imposed a 30% tax on income from virtual digital assets (cryptocurrency), plus applicable surcharge and cess; the separate 1% TDS on transfers is a detail students often mix up with the headline rate.

subject: General Studies
question: Find out the incorrect statement from the following about the Yazidi group.

options.A: It is one of Iraq's oldest minorities.
options.B: They are concentrated in northern Iraq around Mount Sinjar.
options.C: This ancient religion is rumoured to have been founded in 11th century by Umayyad Shaikh.
options.D: This religion has taken some elements from Christianity so they are targeted by Islamic terrorist groups.

explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Yazidis are an ancient minority centred around Mount Sinjar in northern Iraq — (a) and (b) hold, and (c) merely reports a rumour about 11th-century origins. Statement (d) is wrong because ISIS targeted them for their distinct Yazidi faith, not because they borrowed from Christianity.

subject: Science
question: Former JNU Vice Chancellor Mamidala Jagadesh Kumar has been appointed as the Chairperson of which institution ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Former JNU Vice Chancellor Mamidala Jagadesh Kumar was appointed Chairperson of the University Grants Commission (UGC), the apex body for higher-education standards and funding — not NCERT, UPSC, or ISRO.

subject: Geography
question: Which racing driver won the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix Tournament held in March 2022 ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Max Verstappen won the 2022 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix in Jeddah (March 2022), edging Charles Leclerc after a closely fought race — a headline sports item from that exam cycle.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following statements is incorrect about Pulwama ? (a) It is known as the Rice Bowl of Kashmir. (b) Veshu and Jhelum rivers are flowing from Pulwama. (c) Aharbal Falls and Avantishwar Temple are famous tourist places near Pulwama.
explanation: The right pick is option D — none of the statements is incorrect. Pulwama is called the Rice Bowl of Kashmir, the Veshu (Veshaw) and Jhelum flow through the district, and Aharbal Falls plus the Avantishwar Temple are well-known nearby sites.

subject: Reasoning
question: Which State has signed Bollywood actor Sanjay Dutt as the Brand Ambassador for its Golden Jubilee celebrations ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Bollywood actor Sanjay Dutt was signed as brand ambassador for Arunachal Pradesh's golden jubilee (50th statehood) celebrations — a state-specific current-affairs fact from early 2022.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following UN specialized agencies has completed 100 years of its formation ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The International Labour Organization (ILO), founded in 1919 under the Treaty of Versailles, completed 100 years in 2019; WHO (1948), FAO (1945) and UPU (1874) do not match that centenary timeline.

subject: General Studies
question: Choose the correct option. (a) Deon Lendore of Trinidad and Tobago died in a car accident in January 2022. (b) He won a Bronze medal in the London Olympics, 2012. (c) Deon Lendore was a Chess Player.

options.D: All the three statements are correct

explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Trinidadian sprinter Deon Lendore died in a January 2022 car crash; he won 400 m relay bronze at London 2012 — statement (c) calling him a chess player is plainly wrong.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements and choose the appropriate option : (a) Padma Shri Awardee Milena Salvini was born in Italy. (b) She was a famous Kathakali dancer and had established a dance school named 'Centre Mandapa' in Paris. (c) The Indian Government honoured her with Padma Shri Award in 2019.
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Italy-born Milena Salvini was a Kathakali dancer who ran Centre Mandapa in Paris, and the Government of India honoured her with Padma Shri in 2019 — all three sub-statements hold together.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following two places in Mumbai had Salt Markets during the British time ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Under British rule Mumbai had salt markets at Bhendi Bazar and Wadala — colonial trade-administration trivia MPSC likes pairing with local geography.

subject: General Studies
question: Which bank has became the first Indian Bank to have an office in Australia's Victoria State ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. State Bank of India opened the first Indian bank office in Victoria, Australia — a trade-and-banking current-affairs marker from the 2022 exam window.

subject: General Studies
question: Pick out the odd person from the following :
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Dr. Laura D'Souza, Sudhatai Joshi and Hirve Guruji were tied to the Goa liberation (Goa Mukti) struggle; Sane Guruji, though a major Maharashtra reformer, was not part of that campaign — that makes him the odd one out.

subject: History
question: Before the formation of 'All India States Peoples' Congress' at the national level, which of the following organizations was active in Kolhapur to raise the concerns of the people ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Before the All India States Peoples' Conference (1927), Kolhapur had local 'Lok Sabha' bodies — people's forums to air grievances in the princely state; the other options name national parliamentary bodies or Vivekananda's Paropakarini Sabha.

subject: History
question: After passing away of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar, who from the followers of Dr. Ambedkar, became members of the Congress ? (a) R.D. Bhandare (b) Rajabhau Bhole (c) Dadasaheb Rupwate (d) Bapusaheb Rajbhoj
explanation: The right pick is option B. After Babasaheb Ambedkar's death, R.D. Bhandare, Rajabhau Bhole and Dadasaheb Rupwate moved into the Congress; Bapusaheb Rajbhoj had a different political trajectory and is excluded in the key.

subject: General Studies
question: Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) is related with which of the following subjects ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. IPC Section 377 (since read down in Navtej Johar, 2018) criminalised carnal intercourse against the order of nature — in exam keys it is standardly tagged with homosexuality, not temple entry, adultery or surrogacy.

subject: Polity
question: Who was the president of the 1957 National Commission for Female Education ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Durgabai Deshmukh chaired the 1957 National Commission for Female Education set up to review women's schooling — do not confuse her with Durgabai Bhagwat (literature) or Anutai Wagh / Shantabai Dani.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following is a large Mesolithic site in Rajasthan ?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Bagor on the Kothari river in Rajasthan is a major Mesolithic site with deep stratified deposits; Adamgarh (MP), Chopani-Mando (UP) and Pratapgarh belong to other regions or periods.

subject: General Studies
question: Who had established the Manav Dharma Sabha at Surat and Paramahansa Mandali at Bombay ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Dadoba Pandurang Tarkhadkar founded Manav Dharma Sabha (Surat, 1844) and Paramahansa Mandali (Bombay, 1849) — early reform societies predating the Prarthana Samaj milieu; do not swap him with brother Atmaram.

subject: General Studies
question: Who wrote the book called Tahqiq-i-Hind, which gives a detailed description of North India ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Al-Biruni's Tahqiq-i-Hind (Kitab al-Hind) is the classic 11th-century survey of Indian society, religion and sciences based on his stay in the Punjab — not Ghazni, Ibn Battuta or Abdul Razzak.

subject: General Studies
question: Where was the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association established by revolutionaries like Chandrashekher Azad and Sardar Bhagat Singh ? (a) Mumbai (b) Nagpur (c) Kolkata (d) Delhi
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was formed at Delhi (Feroz Shah Kotla, 1928) under Chandrashekhar Azad and Bhagat Singh after the Kakori case split — not Mumbai or Nagpur/Kolkata pairings in the options.

subject: Polity
question: Which Act was sanctioned by British Parliament on 18th July, 1947 ? (a) Indian Partition Act (b) Indian Independence Act (c) Draft Constitution Act (d) Constitutional Amendment Act Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Only the Indian Independence Act received Royal Assent on 18 July 1947; 'Indian Partition Act' and 'Draft Constitution Act' are not the formal names — the 1947 statute transferred power and partitioned British India.

subject: General Studies
question: The British appointed Mir Jafar as the Nawab of ______ after the Battle of Plassey in 1757.
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. After Plassey (1757) the British installed Mir Jafar as Nawab of Bengal — the opening move in Company control of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa through the puppet nawab.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Kashi - (i) Bimbisara (b) Kosal - (ii) Ashwasena (c) Magadha - (iii) Udayan (d) Vatsa - (iv) Prasenjit
explanation: The right pick is option B. Match: Kashi–Ashwasena, Kosal–Prasenjit (Pasenadi), Magadha–Bimbisara, Vatsa–Udayan — the standard Mahajanapada king list; map each kingdom before scanning the code string.

subject: General Studies
question: Who founded the Slave Dynasty which ruled from 1206 to 1290 ? (a) Mahmud Ghazni (b) Muhammad Ghori (c) Qutb-ud-Din Aibak (d) Iltutmish Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Qutb-ud-Din Aibak, a former slave of Muhammad Ghori, founded the Mamluk (Slave) dynasty in 1206 after Ghori's death — not Ghazni (invader) or Ghori (patron) or Iltutmish (successor).

subject: Economy
question: महाराष्ट्रातील मानवी वसाहतीच्या दृष्टीने मध्याश्म युग आणि ताम्रपाषाण युगाच्या संदर्भासाठी ______ येथे संशोधन करण्यात आले.
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. पाटणे (जळगाव), हातखंबा (रत्नागिरी) आणि इनामगाव (पुणे) — हे सर्व महाराष्ट्रातील Chalcolithic (ताम्रदातु युग) व प्रारंभिक ऐतिहासिक वस्तीसंबंधी संशोधनासाठी ओळखले जाणारे उत्खनन स्थळ आहेत. MPSC अशी महाराष्ट्रातील पुरातत्त्व स्थळे एकत्र विचारते.

subject: Geography
question: खालील विधाने पहा : (a) सागर चक्रीवादळ मे 2019 मध्ये अरबी समुद्रात तयार झाले. (b) सागर चक्रीवादळाने दक्षिण कोकण किना-यावर मालमत्तेचे नुकसान केले.
