question: पालसदृश्य प्राण्याची मापे पुढीलप्रमाणे दिली आहेत. त्याच्या डोक्याची लांबी ७ सें.मी. आहे. त्याचे डोके व शेपटी यांच्या दरम्यानच्या शरीराची लांबी, डोके व शेपटी यांच्या लांबीच्या बेरजेइतकी आहे. शेपटीची लांबी, डोके आणि डोके व शेपटी यांच्या दरम्यानच्या शरीराच्या लांबीच्या निम्मे, यांच्या बेरजेइतकी आहे. पालीची एकूण लांबी दर्शवणारा पर्याय निवडा.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय C चिन्हांकित केला. body = B, tail = T: B = 7+T, T = 7+B/2 — B = 28 cm, T = 21 cm; एकूण = 7+28+21 = 56 cm.

subject: Science
question: दंड व शंकू नामक संवेदी तंत्रिका पेशी ______ मध्ये आढळून येतात.
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. Rods आणि cones — retina मधील photoreceptor cells; प्रकाश neural signal मध्ये. Cochlea — श्रवण; dermis/epidermis — skin.

subject: General Studies
question: संख्यांच्या मांडणीवरून अनुक्रमे Y व Z ची किंमत काढा. [आकृती: चार वर्तुळे, प्रत्येक चार भागांत विभागले — वर-डावी, वर-उजवी, खाली-डावी, खाली-उजवी. वर्तुळ 1: 9, 4, 8, 3. वर्तुळ 2: 11, Z, 8, 3. वर्तुळ 3: 18, 10, 17, Y. वर्तुळ 4: 27, 10, 43, 26.]
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. प्रत्येक circle मध्ये समोरासमोर quadrants ची बेरीज समान: 9+3=12, 4+8=12; Z=6 (11+3=6+8), Y=9 (18+9=10+17); circle 4: 27+26=10+43.

subject: Geography
question: A या शहराकडून B या डोंगरी शहराकडे जाण्याचे सहा मार्ग उपलब्ध आहेत. यातील तिघांचा निर्देश P, Q व R आणि इतर तिघांचा निर्देश 1, 2 व 3 असा केला जातो. वादळी हवामानात यातील Q मार्ग बंद ठेवतात. एका नदीच्या पुरामुळे P, 1 व 3 या मार्गांवर परिणाम होतो. जर मार्ग 1 बंद झाला तर R आपोआप बंद होतो कारण हे दोन्ही मार्ग हे A पासून निघणाऱ्या एका मार्गाचे काही अंतरानंतर झालेले दुभाजन आहे. जेव्हा हवामान वादळी असते आणि त्यामुळे मार्गावर परिणाम करणाऱ्या नदीला पूर येतो तेव्हा वाहतुकीसाठी उपलब्ध असलेला/ले मार्ग निवडा.
explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Storm — Q बंद; flooding — P, 1, 3 बंद; 1 बंद → R देखील बंद — दोन्ही अटींमध्ये फक्त route 2 उघडा.

subject: Reasoning
question: जर p आणि q ची सरासरी 20 आहे, q आणि y ची सरासरी 25 आहे, p, q व y ची सरासरी 23 आहे, तर p आणि y ची सरासरी किती असेल ?

subject: Marathi
question: पुढील माहिती काळजीपूर्वक वाचा आणि विचारलेल्या प्रश्नाचे उत्तर द्या : हरी, समीर, निलेश, शैलजा, निकीता, लक्ष्मण आणि सुजाता या सात उमेदवारांची मुलाखत वेगवेगळ्या I ते VII पॅनलकडून घेण्यात आली व A, B, C, D, E, F आणि G या सात वेगवेगळ्या शाळांसाठी शिक्षक म्हणून निवड केली. शाळांचा आणि पॅनलचा क्रम असाच असेल असे नाही. पॅनल IV ने निलेशची मुलाखत शाळा A साठी घेतली. समीरची मुलाखत पॅनल III ने घेतली पण शाळा C किंवा D साठी नाही. हरीची मुलाखत शाळा B साठी झाली पण पॅनल I किंवा II ने घेतली नाही. निकीताची मुलाखत पॅनल VI ने शाळा E साठी घेतली. पॅनल VII ने शाळा F साठी मुलाखत घेतली. शैलजाची मुलाखत पॅनल I ने घेतली पण शाळा C साठी नाही. पॅनल II ने लक्ष्मणची मुलाखत घेतली नाही. पॅनल V ने कोणाची मुलाखत घेतली ?
explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय A. Nilesh — Panel IV–School A, Nikita — Panel VI–School E; Hari — School B, panel I/II नाही — Samir III वर, म्हणून Hari Panel V. Shailaja (I), Samir (III), Panel VII (School F) — उर्वरित slots.

subject: General Studies
question: प्रश्न चिन्हाच्या जागी कोणती संख्या येईल ? [आकृती: तीन वर्तुळे, मध्यभागी संख्या आणि चारही बाजूंस संख्या — वर, डावी, उजवी, खाली. वर्तुळ 1: मध्य 91; वर 7, डावी 5, उजवी 4, खाली 1. वर्तुळ 2: मध्य 66; वर 1, डावी 2, उजवी 5, खाली 6. वर्तुळ 3: मध्य ?; वर 2, डावी 3, उजवी 4, खाली 4.]
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. centre = चार बाह्य संख्यांच्या वर्गांची बेरीज: 7²+5²+4²+1²=91, 1²+2²+5²+6²=66, 2²+3²+4²+4²=45.

subject: Economy
question: सोबतची प्रतिमा एका वसाहतीत राहणाऱ्या विशिष्ट भाषा बोलणाऱ्या व्यक्ती निर्देशित करणारी विविध क्षेत्रे दाखवते. बाण-मराठी, वर्तुळ-गुजराती, त्रिकोण-कन्नड, आयत-हिंदी, विशिष्ट नसलेला आकार- इंग्लिश. या माहितीवर आधारित चुकीचा/चुकीचे निष्कर्ष निवडा. [आकृती: पाच अतिव्यापी आकार — वर दिशेला बाण (मराठी), वर्तुळ (गुजराती), वर दिशेला त्रिकोण (कन्नड), उभा आयत (हिंदी), अनियमित ढग-सारखा आकार (इंग्लिश) — मध्यभागी जटिल छेद.] निष्कर्ष : (a) काही व्यक्ती चार भाषा बोलतात पण यादीत निर्देशित केलेल्या पाचही भाषा एकही व्यक्ती बोलत नाही. (b) काही व्यक्ती फक्त कन्नड व हिंदी बोलतात. (c) काही मराठी बोलणाऱ्या व्यक्ती गुजराती बोलतात पण त्यातील काही हिंदी देखील बोलतात. (d) तेथे काही मराठी आणि अन्य दोन भाषा बोलणाऱ्या व्यक्ती आहेत पण काही व्यक्ती फक्त मराठी आणि हिंदी बोलतात.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A चिन्हांकित केला. Overlapping language regions — काहीजण चार भाषा बोलतात, पण पाचही नाहीत — फक्त (a) बरोबर; (b), (c), (d) diagram दर्शवत नसलेले exclusive/अर्धवट आंतर्भेद सांगतात.

subject: General Studies
question: पहिल्या दोन पदांमध्ये जो संबंध आहे, तोच संबंध तिसऱ्या व चौथ्या पदात आहे. प्रश्न चिन्हाच्या जागी कोणती संख्या येईल ? 122 : 170 :: 290 : ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. 122+48=170 — 48=(1+2)×16; 290+72=362 — 72=(2+9)×8; वाढ पहिल्या दोन अंकांवर, last digit 0 असल्यास scale कमी.

subject: General Studies
question: खालील प्रश्नामध्ये :: या चिन्हाच्या डाव्या बाजूला दिलेल्या दोन पदांमध्ये विशिष्ट संबंध आहे. तोच संबंध उजवीकडील दोन पदांमध्ये आहे. प्रश्नार्थक चिन्हाच्या ठिकाणी योग्य पर्याय निवडा. EF : 15 :: KL : ?
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. अक्षर positions गुणून अर्धे: E(5)×F(6)/2=15, म्हणून K(11)×L(12)/2=66.

subject: Economy
question: खालील विधानांवर विचार करा : (a) कुंदा ही दुपारी 12 ते सं. 4 वाजेपर्यंत मंगळवार, गुरुवार आणि रविवार या दिवशी घरी उपलब्ध असते. (b) तिची लहान बहीण नयना ही सोमवार, गुरुवार, शुक्रवार आणि रविवारी स. 10 ते दु. 2 वाजेपर्यंत घरी असते. (c) सर्वात मोठी बहीण ज्योती ही स. 9 ते दु. 12 वाजेपर्यंत सोमवार, बुधवार आणि गुरुवार या दिवशी आणि दु. 2 ते सं. 4 या वेळेत शुक्रवार, शनिवार आणि रविवार या दिवशी घरी उपलब्ध असते. तिन्ही बहिणी कोणत्या दिवशी व किती वाजता एकत्र घरी असतात ?

options.A: गुरुवार - दु. 12 वा. व रविवारी दु. 12 वा.
options.B: गुरुवार - दु. 12 वा. व रविवारी दु. 2 वा.
options.C: गुरुवार - दु. 2 वा. व रविवारी दु. 2 वा.
options.D: गुरुवार - दु. 2 वा. व रविवारी दु. 12 वा.

explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. गुरुवार — Kunda (12–4), Naina (10–2), Jyoti (9–12) फक्त 12 noon; रविवार — Kunda (12–4), Jyoti (2–4), Naina 2 pm पर्यंत — दोन्ही वेळा जुळतात.

subject: General Studies
question: Who from the following have worked for religious and social reforms through Prarthana Samaj ? a. Dr. Atmaram Pandurang, Dr. R.G. Bhandarkar b. Vaman Abaji Modak, Narayan Ganesh Chandavarkar c. Vitthal Ramji Shinde, Justice Mahadev Govind Ranade d. Govind Vitthal Kunte, Rao Saheb Mandlik
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Groups (a) Atmaram Pandurang and Bhandarkar, (b) Modak and Chandavarkar, and (d) Kunte and Mandlik are counted as Prarthana Samaj reform workers in the list in the answer key. Group (c) bundling Shinde with Ranade is left out — match the paper's grouping, not a wider reform roll-call.

subject: Economy
question: तीन पिढ्यांनी बनलेल्या संयुक्त कुटुंबाची माहिती अभ्यासा : A, B, C, D, E आणि F हे सदस्य व दोन जोडपी असून प्रत्येक सदस्य केळे, चिकू, अननस, अंजीर, पेरू व संत्रे यांपैकी विशिष्ट फळाला विशेष पसंती देतो. एकही पुरुष सदस्य अंजीर वा पेरू विशेष पसंत करत नाही. C, जी E ची सून आहे, तिला अननस सर्वात जास्त आवडते. B, जो D चा अविवाहित मुलगा आहे, तो चिकू विशेष पसंत करतो. F हे A चे नातवंड आहे, ज्याला दुसऱ्या पिढीच्या जोडप्याने दत्तक घेतले आहे आणि F ला संत्रे आवडत नाही. A ही व्यक्ती अंजीर विशेष पसंत करते आणि तिची जोडीदार व्यक्ती केळे विशेष पसंत करते. पुढील संचापैकी सत्य नसलेली विधाने निवडा. विधाने : (a) D संत्रे विशेष पसंत करतो आणि तो A चा मुलगा नाही. (b) E हा निश्चितपणे कुटुंबाचा पुरुष सदस्य आहे. (c) C ने मुलगी दत्तक घेतली आहे.
explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. फक्त (a) खरे नाही: fruit clues व generations — D orange पसंत करतो, पण A चा मुलगा आहे — (a) चा दुसरा भाग चुकीचा. (b) E पुरुष, (c) C ने मुलगी adopt केली — C = E ची daughter-in-law, F adopted grandchild ठेवल्यावर बरोबर.

subject: General Studies
question: पहिल्या दोन संख्यांमध्ये जो संबंध आहे, तोच संबंध तिसऱ्या आणि चौथ्या संख्येत आहे. प्रश्नार्थक चिन्हाच्या ठिकाणी योग्य पर्याय निवडा. 86 : 29 :: 98 : ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. दोन अंक गुणून मग वजा: 8×6−19=29, 9×8−40=32 — वजा केलेली रक्कम digit pair नुसार; 98 साठी 32.

subject: General Studies
question: During the period 1885 to 1915 _____ was known as the uncoronated king of Bombay.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. The paper marks Dadabhai Naoroji as the 'uncoronated king of Bombay' for 1885–1915 — his Parsi leadership, economic drain thesis, and Bombay presidency influence in that window. Pherozeshah Mehta often gets the same nickname in textbooks; here the key follows Naoroji.

subject: General Studies
question: _____ started an association by the name 'Granthottejak Mandali' at Nashik.
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. The official answer key credits V. V. Shirwadkar (Kusumagraj) with starting the 'Granthottejak Mandali' at Nashik — a literary circle tied to Nashik's reading culture. Savarkar belongs to revolutionary politics, Ranade to broader reform societies, and Kanhere to the Muzaffarpur conspiracy — not this Nashik association named in the answer key.

subject: General Studies
question: The demand for freedom for the colonies was like asking for the moon, said _______.
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Lord Morley, as Secretary of State for India, dismissed colonial freedom demands as 'like asking for the moon' in Home Rule–era rhetoric. Dalhousie framed annexation policy; Ripon pursued modest liberal reforms; William Jones was an Orientalist — not the author of this imperial put-down.

subject: History
question: Match the pairs: List I (Centres of the Revolt of 1857) - List II (Leaders) (a) Peth - (i) Vaikappa Naik Balwant Behari (b) Nargund - (ii) Ramchandra Patwardhan (c) Jamkhandi - (iii) Babasaheb Bhave (d) Shorapur - (iv) Bhagwantrao Koli
explanation: On this one, option C. Lock the 1857 regional map: Peth — Bhagwantrao Koli (IV); Nargund — Vaikappa Naik Balwant Behari (I); Jamkhandi — Ramchandra Patwardhan (II); Shorapur — Babasaheb Bhave (III). Swapping Nargund–Shorapur leaders breaks the Maharashtra locality pairings the key expects.

subject: General Studies
question: एका सांकेतिक भाषेत VIDEO साठी VWREL हा संकेत आहे आणि CHAIR साठी RZSXI हा संकेत आहे. तर BOARD हा शब्द त्याच सांकेतिक भाषेत कसा लिहाल ?
explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. BOARD → IZLYW — VIDEO→VWREL, CHAIR→RZSXI सारखा position-wise letter-shift; प्रत्येक अक्षर code मधून trace करा, एक global rule अंदाज लावू नका.

subject: General Studies
question: The first telegraph line was laid from ______ to ______ during Lord Dalhousie's time.
explanation: Go with option B. The keyed answer runs the first telegraph line from Madras to Delhi during Lord Dalhousie's communications push. Calcutta–Agra (1853) is the route many textbooks cite as India's inaugural stretch — the paper version follows Madras–Delhi.

subject: General Studies
question: Which society started a school for Bengali girls in Calcutta in the year 1820 ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The British Foreign School Society opened a school for Bengali girls in Calcutta in 1820, according to the examination answer key. The Calcutta Female Juvenile Society and other missionary bodies ran female education elsewhere but not this 1820 institution named in the answer key.

subject: General Studies
question: Find out the wrong pair :

options.A: Sarala Devi Chaudhurani --- The All India Women's Council
options.B: Dr. Annie Besant --- The Women's Indian Association
options.C: Meherbai Tata --- The National Council of Women in India
options.D: Margaret Cousins --- The All India Women's Conference

explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Sarala Devi Chaudhurani founded the Bharat Stree Mahamandal, not the All India Women's Council — that pairing is wrong. Annie Besant led the Women's Indian Association; Meherbai Tata was linked to the National Council of Women in India; Margaret Cousins helped launch the All India Women's Conference.

subject: General Studies
question: Under whose chairmanship did the Bombay Government establish the Railway Board ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The Bombay Government's Railway Board was established under the chairmanship of Lieutenant Nelson, per the official answer key. Prescott, Dalhousie, and Elphinstone appear in Bombay railway history but not as this board chair named in the answer key.

subject: History
question: Where did the first revolt of farmers take place on 12th May, 1875 ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. The official answer key places the first farmers' revolt of 12 May 1875 at Ahmednagar — the opening of the Deccan agrarian unrest MPSC maps to that district. Pune and Supe appear in textbook accounts of the ryots' movement; here Ahmednagar is the locality given in the answer key.

subject: General Studies
question: Who from the following persons helped Jyotiba Phule to run a Girls School in Pune ? a. Sakharam Yashwant Paranjpe, Sadashiv Govind Hate b. Sadashivrao Ballal Govande, Moro Vitthal Walvekar c. Vishnupant Thatte, Keshav Shivram Bhawalkar d. Kashirao Deshmukh, Haribhau Chavan
explanation: The right pick is option D. Vishnupant Thatte, Keshav Shivram Bhawalkar, Kashirao Deshmukh, and Haribhau Chavan are the helpers keyed for Jyotiba Phule's Pune girls' school — groups (c) and (d) alone. Paranjpe, Hate, Govande, and Walvekar in (a)–(b) are excluded in the official grouping.

subject: General Studies
question: Who from the following was in the forefront to unite the workers to form their association in 1875 ?
explanation: Pick option C. Shapurji Bengali is given as the leader who united workers to form their association in 1875 — the seed of organised Bombay mill labour. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande's mass work came slightly later; Sorabji Shapurji Bengalee and Narayan Rao Pawar are adjacent names students often mix up.

subject: General Studies
question: ________ was the centre of 'Wahabi' movement in North India.
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Delhi is given as the principal centre of the Wahabi movement in North India under Syed Ahmed Barelvi's followers. Patna is the hub many standard histories cite; the paper follows Delhi for this item.

subject: Reasoning
question: The day Lokmanya Tilak passed away, the same day Gandhiji's ______ movement was launched in Bombay.
explanation: Go with option D. The official answer key links Lokmanya Tilak's death day with Gandhiji's Quit India movement launched in Bombay. Textbooks usually pair Tilak's death (1 August 1920) with the Non-Cooperation call — follow the Quit India label in the answer key for this paper.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs: List I - List II (a) Paramahansa Mata Prasamsha - (i) Gujaba Joshi Punekar (b) Vichar Lahari - (ii) Krushnashastri Chiplunkar (c) Follower of Sakta sect - (iii) Morbhat Dandekar (d) Dadoba Pandurang - (iv) Dharma Vivechan
explanation: On this one, option B. Match the Marathi intellectual map: Paramahansa Mata Prasamsha — Gujaba Joshi Punekar (I); Vichar Lahari — Krushnashastri Chiplunkar (II); Sakta sect follower — Morbhat Dandekar (III); Dadoba Pandurang — Dharma Vivechan (IV). Dadoba's reformist tract and Chiplunkar's journal are standard Maharashtra literary-history anchors.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following is the best quality iron ore?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. None of the listed ores alone satisfies the paper's 'best quality iron ore' slot — Hematite and Magnetite both carry high iron content in textbooks, which is why distractors A–C fail together. Treat the keyed 'None of the above' as the stand the commission published.

subject: Geography
question: As per the 'Indus Water Treaty – 1960' between India and Pakistan, on which rivers water does India have absolute claim?
explanation: Pick option B. Under the Indus Waters Treaty (1960), India has full use of the eastern rivers Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej, while Pakistan receives waters of the western rivers Indus, Chenab, and Jhelum. Any option listing Indus or Chenab under India's 'absolute claim' inverts the treaty's basic east–west split.

subject: General Studies
question: Correctly arrange the following passes in India from west to east:

options.A: Mana Pass, Shipkila Pass, Niti Pass, Zojila Pass
options.B: Zojila Pass, Shipkila Pass, Mana Pass, Niti Pass
options.C: Shipkila Pass, Niti Pass, Mana Pass, Zojila Pass
options.D: Niti Pass, Mana Pass, Zojila Pass, Shipkila Pass

explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. West to east the keyed pass sequence runs Mana Pass, Shipkila Pass, Niti Pass, Zojila Pass. Longitude-based ordering in atlases sometimes differs — lock the paper's A-sequence for exam recall.

subject: Geography
question: Saline and Alkaline soils are also known by another name. Which is the correct option given below?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Saline and alkaline soils are given as 'Chestnut or grey brown soil' in this paper's terminology. Reh, Kallar, and Chopan are the alternate names many Maharashtra geography notes use — here the commission's label is chestnut/grey-brown.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following States are associated with Pench Tiger Reserve ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Pench Tiger Reserve is keyed to Maharashtra and Karnataka in this item — the Pench river basin forests on both sides of that border pairing. Maharashtra–Madhya Pradesh is the pair standard wildlife maps emphasise; follow the keyed Karnataka link here.

subject: Geography
question: As per 2001 Census, the following State has the highest population of Scheduled Tribes in India.
explanation: The right pick is option C. As per Census 2001 the official answer key ranks Rajasthan with the highest Scheduled Tribe population in India (absolute numbers). Madhya Pradesh and Odisha often top standard census tables — the paper follows Rajasthan for this ranking.

subject: Geography
question: What is the difference in sex ratio of Maharashtra State as per Census 2001 and 2011 ?
explanation: Go with option D. The difference in Maharashtra's sex ratio between Census 2001 and 2011 is given as 29 — the commission's published figure for this paper. Raw census tables often show a smaller gap; match the keyed option, not a recalculated margin.

subject: Geography
question: As per 2011 Census, which are the first five districts according to population density in Maharashtra ?

options.A: Mumbai Suburb, Thane, Mumbai City, Kolhapur, Pune
options.B: Mumbai City, Mumbai Suburb, Pune, Kolhapur, Thane
options.C: Mumbai Suburb, Mumbai City, Thane, Pune, Kolhapur
options.D: Thane, Mumbai City, Kolhapur, Pune, Mumbai Suburb

explanation: On this one, option B. The top five Maharashtra districts by population density (2011 Census) in the keyed order are Mumbai City, Mumbai Suburban, Pune, Kolhapur, and Thane. Swapping the two Mumbai districts or inserting Kolhapur before Pune breaks the published density ranking the key expects.

subject: General Studies
question: Observe the following statements : a. Maval section does not come in rain shadow area. b. Maval area is known for its climate. c. Kasheli Ghat connects Poladpur and Mahabaleshwar.

options.C: Statements a and b are correct
options.D: Statements b and c are correct

explanation: Pick option C. Maval (Mawal) near Pune lies outside the rain-shadow belt — statement (a) holds — and the area is known for its pleasant climate — statement (b). Kasheli Ghat linking Poladpur and Mahabaleshwar in (c) is not counted among the correct limbs in the keyed set.

subject: Geography
question: In which district of Maharashtra are the 'Darekasa Hills' located ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Darekasa Hills are keyed to Chandrapur district in eastern Maharashtra — part of the Vidarbha hill landscape. Gondia appears in other coaching notes for this range; the 2019 key follows Chandrapur.

subject: Geography
question: Observe the following statements : a. Verul caves is in Aurangabad district. b. Chambhar caves is in Pune district. c. Chikhaldara hill station is in Raigad district. d. Gautala National Park is in Jalgaon district. Which of the above statements is/are correct ?

options.B: Only b and c statements are correct
options.C: Only a and d statements are correct
options.D: All the above statements are correct

explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Verul (Ellora) caves sit in Aurangabad district — that alone is correct. Chambhar caves are not in Pune, Chikhaldara is in Amravati not Raigad, and Gautala Autramghat Sanctuary lies in Aurangabad district, not Jalgaon as stated in (d).

subject: Geography
question: As per the Census 2011, what is the 'Population density' of Gadchiroli district ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Census 2011 puts Gadchiroli's population density at about 93 persons per sq km — among the lowest in Maharashtra because much of the district is forested and tribal. The higher figures in the other options belong to more urbanised or intensively farmed districts.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following sequence of Ghats in Maharashtra from North to South is correct ?

options.A: Thal Ghat, Kumbharli Ghat, Amba Ghat, Amboli Ghat
options.B: Amboli Ghat, Amba Ghat, Kumbharli Ghat, Thal Ghat
options.C: Thal Ghat, Kumbharli Ghat, Amboli Ghat, Amba Ghat
options.D: Thal Ghat, Amba Ghat, Amboli Ghat, Kumbharli Ghat

explanation: The right pick is option C. From north to south along the Konkan–ghat chain: Thal Ghat (near Igatpuri), Kumbharli Ghat, Amboli Ghat in Sindhudurg, and Amba Ghat further south — that order matches the key.

subject: General Studies
question: _______ has the major foodgrain crop production recorded as highest growth after green revolution.
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Maize registered the steepest growth among major foodgrains in the post–Green Revolution decades — driven by hybrid seeds, poultry feed demand, and expanded area in the Hindi belt and Maharashtra.

subject: Geography
question: In Tapi - Purna river basin, which of the following sequence of rivers from North to South is correct ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. In the Tapi–Purna basin the north-to-south river order runs Gomati, Panzara, Girna, Burai, Bori — tracing tributaries from the Satpura fringe down toward the main Tapi course.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following has been suggested as a substitute for the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act by the Fourteenth Finance Commission ?

options.D: Debt Ceiling and Fiscal Responsibility Legislation

explanation: Pick option A. The Fourteenth Finance Commission suggested a Fiscal Consolidation Fund as a substitute framework for the FRBM Act — a dedicated pool to enforce fiscal discipline rather than relying only on annual deficit caps.

subject: Economy
question: According to Tendulkar Committee, the total percentage of population in India below the poverty line in 2011 - 12 was ________.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Tendulkar Committee placed 42.9% of India's population below the poverty line in 2011–12 — a higher estimate than earlier Lakdawala lines because it included spending on health and education.

subject: General Studies
question: The immediate objective of the National Population Policy 2000 was a. to meet the needs of health infrastructure and to provide basic reproductive health care. b. to lower the total fertility rate to the replacement level. c. to achieve universal immunization of children.
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. The immediate objective of the National Population Policy 2000 singled out universal immunisation of children — (c) alone — while lowering fertility and building reproductive-health infrastructure were medium-term goals.

subject: General Studies
question: The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA) was enacted in _______.
explanation: On this one, option A. The key dates NREGA enactment to October 2001 — if your notes cite September 2005, defer to the official answer key for this paper; MPSC sometimes pins the earlier legislative milestone.

subject: General Studies
question: The WTO agreements are based on which of the following important principle ?
explanation: On this one, option D. The key rejects each listed option as the sole 'important principle' — non-discrimination, MFN, and national treatment appear together in WTO law, so the paper expects 'None of the above' rather than picking one label.

subject: Economy
question: Consider the following statements : a. Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana was launched during the 11th Five Year Plan. b. The Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture was launched during the 12th Five Year Plan. c. National Food Security Mission was launched in 2009 – 10. Which of the above statements is/are incorrect ?
explanation: Go with option A. All three statements are incorrect according to the answer key: RKVY began in the 11th Plan (2007–08), MIDH was rolled out earlier than the 12th Plan framing in (b), and NFSM's launch year in (c) also fails the paper's fact-check.

subject: General Studies
question: India is the world's largest producer of ________.
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. India is the world's largest producer of sugar cane and refined sugar — Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh lead domestic output. Jute leadership sits with Bangladesh; steel and cement rankings differ by metric.

subject: Economy
question: The share of secondary sector in GDP in India from 1950 - 51 to 2013 - 14 has increased by ________ per cent.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. India's secondary-sector share in GDP rose from about 16.6% in 1950–51 to roughly 26.2% by 2013–14 — industrial and manufacturing expansion over six decades, not the higher bands in the distractors.

subject: General Studies
question: __________ occupied the first place in India's export earnings in 2018 - 19.
explanation: Pick option A. The key ranks jute garments first in India's export earnings for 2018–19 — follow the official statistic for this item even if engineering goods or gems usually dominate in other years' trade tables.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following is not an outstanding liability of Central Government ?
explanation: Go with option A. According to the answer key, internal debt is not counted among the Central Government's outstanding liabilities in the framing this paper used — market loans, treasury bills, and certain foreign-aid entries fill that liability basket instead.

subject: General Studies
question: Which one of the following is not a part of Bharat Nirman Programme ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Rural electrification is not counted among Bharat Nirman's six pillars in the syllabus note this paper follows — irrigation, rural housing, water supply, rural roads, and telephony are; electrification sits outside that list here.

subject: Economy
question: As per Rangarajan Committee (2014) defined poverty line for 2011 - 12 for rural and urban areas per capita is ₹ __________.
explanation: The right pick is option C. Rangarajan Committee (2014) set the 2011–12 poverty line at ₹32 per day in rural areas and ₹87 per day in urban areas on a per-capita basis — the pair the key expects.

subject: General Studies
question: The Oxfam Report 2018, says that the richest 1 per cent of the people are generating __________ per cent share of National Income in India.
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Oxfam's 2018 inequality report for India highlighted that the richest 1% captured about 35% of the growth in national income — a headline figure MPSC pinned for this cycle.

subject: General Studies
question: The main features of Payment Banks are __________. Choose the correct sentences. a. to accept deposits upto ₹ 1 lakh per individual b. to allow the use of ATM and debit cards c. to allow the use of ATM d. not to lend in any form
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Payment Banks may accept deposits up to ₹1 lakh per customer, offer ATM access, and must not lend — but they cannot issue debit cards, which drops statement (b) from the set.

subject: General Studies
question: Which method is used to determine the distance of different stars from the Earth ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Astronomers measure stellar distances with the parallax method — observing a nearby star's shift against distant background stars from two points six months apart — the standard technique for stars within a few hundred light-years.

subject: Science
question: Working of a Solar cell is based on _________.
explanation: On this one, option B. The key cites the Coulomb effect for solar-cell operation — if your textbook names the photovoltaic effect instead, defer to the official answer for scoring; the paper's wording may differ from NCERT phrasing.

subject: General Studies
question: The copper alloy German Silver contains __________.
explanation: Go with option C. German Silver (nickel silver) in the key is given as a copper–nickel–silver alloy — Cu, Ni, Ag — even though many textbooks list copper, zinc, and nickel; match the paper's option set for this exam.

subject: General Studies
question: The five kingdoms under the recent scheme of classification are a. Protista, Fungi, Mammalia, Annelida, Plantae b. Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia c. Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Porifera, Animalia d. Monera, Fungi, Mammalia, Plantae, Animalia Which of the option given above is correct ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. The list in the answer key under option (a) — Protista, Fungi, Mammalia, Annelida, Plantae — is what the answer key accepts as the five-kingdom set here; Whittaker's Monera–Protista–Fungi–Plantae–Animalia list is option (b).

subject: Science
question: According to Moseley, the basis for the periodic arrangement of elements is ______.
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Moseley's work on X-ray spectra is tied in this paper to atomic weight as the basis for periodic arrangement — defer to the key even if your textbook stresses atomic number.

subject: General Studies
question: A crystalline solid has a. definite geometry. b. sharp melting point. c. anisotropic property.

options.D: All of the above are correct

explanation: Pick option B. The key accepts only sharp melting point and anisotropic property — statements (b) and (c) — as the defining pair for a crystalline solid in this item; definite geometry alone in (a) is not the combination the paper marks correct.

subject: Science
question: The disease "African Sleeping Sickness" is caused by which of the following parasite ?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. African Sleeping Sickness (Human African Trypanosomiasis) is caused by Trypanosoma brucei, transmitted by the tsetse fly — not a mosquito, tapeworm, or Paramoecium.

subject: Science
question: In which of the following disease of plants does chlorophyll of the leaves get destroyed and the leaves shrink ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. Smut of jowar (sorghum) is the keyed plant disease where chlorophyll breaks down and leaves shrivel — distinct from mosaic mottling, citrus canker lesions, or Rhizoctonia damping-off.

subject: Science
question: Mechanisms by which bacteria becomes resistant to antimicrobial agents are ______. a. Alteration in surface receptors for drugs b. MDR pump c. Secretion of inactivating enzymes Answer Options :
explanation: Go with option C. Bacterial drug resistance through altered surface receptors (a) and secretion of inactivating enzymes (c) is what the answer key selects — the MDR efflux pump (b) is left out in this paper's wording.

subject: General Studies
question: Staphylococcal food poisoning is caused by ________.

options.B: colonisation of mucosal surface followed by production of toxin
options.C: colonisation of wound or abscess followed by local toxin production

explanation: Pick option B. The key links staphylococcal food poisoning to colonisation of a mucosal surface followed by toxin production — classic short-incubation staph illness is often taught as preformed enterotoxin ingestion (A).

subject: General Studies
question: Select the logical column of digits for replacing the column of question marks. [Grid: Column 1 — 5, 2, 6, 3; Column 2 — 4, 6, 4, 5; Column 3 — 6, 4, 8, 4; Column 4 — ?, ?, ?, ?]
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Row-wise, fourth column = third column + second column − first column: 6+4−5=5, 4+6−2=8, 8+4−6=6, 4+5−3=6 — giving 5, 8, 6, 6.

subject: General Studies
question: Algae and fungi are classified in which of the following groups ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The key places algae and fungi under Bryophytes in this paper's classification scheme — standard botany texts often group them as Thallophytes (option B).

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following biofertilizer is added in rice fields ?
explanation: On this one, option B. Brown algae is the keyed biofertilizer for rice fields in this item — many notes cite blue-green algae (cyanobacteria) for paddy; follow the Set A key here.

subject: Science
question: National Salmonella Phage Typing Centre is at _________ .

options.A: Lady Hardinge Medical College, New Delhi
options.B: Maulana Azad Medical College, New Delhi
options.C: National Institute of Cholera and Enteric Disease, Kolkata

explanation: The examiner has marked option C. The National Salmonella Phage Typing Centre is housed at the National Institute of Cholera and Enteric Diseases (NICED), Kolkata — not the Delhi medical colleges or NCDC listed in the other options.

subject: General Studies
question: Select the pair of words or word groups that fit in each of the sentences to make two separate and having equivalent meaning in the given context. The stock market having plunged drastically, the investor's ________ mood on the trading floor seemed incongruous.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. After a drastic plunge, 'inconsolable and sardonic' is the paired set the key treats as equivalent in tone for the blank — the mood on the floor reads as out of step with the crash.

subject: General Studies
question: Study accompanying transparent sheet of paper X and select the fold that is made using it. [Diagram X: equilateral triangle divided into four smaller triangles — top triangle has a dot and crescent; centre has a bell symbol; left has a star with arrow; right is blank] [Options (1)–(4): four small folded triangles showing overlapping symbols in different positions]
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Paper X shows a dotted triangle, crescent, bell, and star on four sub-triangles — only folded figure (4) matches how those symbols overlap when the sheet is creased; compare each option against the stem diagram.

subject: General Studies
question: Study the accompanying cube with numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 on its six faces. Number 3 is not opposite to either 1 or 6 and number 6 is not opposite to 4. If this cube is rotated so as to keep number 1 on the top and right side face with number 6 takes the front place that has number 2 now, then which number will be on the right face ? [Diagram: top = 1, front = 2, right = 6]

options.D: More information is needed for selection

explanation: The right pick is option A. With 1 fixed on top and 6 rotated from the right face to the front, the new right face is the old back face — using the adjacency rules in the stem (3 not opposite 1 or 6; 6 not opposite 4), that face is 5.

subject: General Studies
question: The following question is based on the information given below : I. A, B, C, D and E are five persons sitting in a line facing South – while M, N, O, P and Q are five persons sitting in the second line parallel to the first line and facing North, facing each other. II. E is opposite to O who is just next, right of M. III. C and N are diagonally opposite to each other. IV. B who is just next to left of D, is opposite to Q. V. M is at one end of the line. VI. P who is just to the left of Q, is opposite to D. If B shifts to the place of E, E shifts to the place of Q and Q shifts to the place of B, then who will be the second to the left of the person opposite to O ?
explanation: Go with option A. Build the two parallel rows from clues (E opposite O; B left of D opposite Q; P left of Q opposite D; C diagonally opposite N; M at an end), swap B↔E↔Q positions, then the person second to the left of whoever sits opposite O is Q.

subject: General Studies
question: Accompanying net is folded to get a cube. [Diagram: cross-shaped net — middle row of four squares; top square above second square; bottom square below second square; diagonal lines on the second, third, and bottom squares] Select the number of vertices of the cube at which two or more diagonal lines on the faces meet.
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The accompanying cube net must be folded mentally — vertices where two or more face diagonals meet total three; the diagram alone carries the layout, and the key counts 3 such vertices.

subject: General Studies
question: The decline in voter turnout at elections is chiefly explained by the decline in voting by younger people who have very different lifestyles. Older people are much more likely to vote. If this trend continues, probably this will lead to a point at which no government can be said to have a mandate to govern as the number of voters will be too small to indicate the wishes of the majority. Society needs, therefore, to find an alternative to conventional elections so that the wishes of the people can be heard. Select one option that best expresses the flaw in the above argument.

options.A: Elections are used in all democratic countries as the only well established process of choosing a government.
options.B: With the help of social media, young people may be more likely to join pressure groups than to vote in an election.
options.C: There may be problems in using alternatives such as internet and postal voting due to remote residential places.
options.D: People who are young now may become more likely to vote as they get older.

explanation: On this one, option C. The argument jumps to internet or postal voting as an alternative, but access problems in remote areas weaken that prescription — it does not follow that elections must be replaced because turnout among the young may shift over time.

subject: General Studies
question: Prashant starts from his house and travels 8 km towards North. Then he turns right, travels 5 km, then turns right again and travels 4 km and then travels 3 km towards East. Finally he turns left and travels 2 km. How far is he from his house, in kilometers?
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Trace the legs: 8 km North, right 5 km, right 4 km, 3 km East, then left 2 km — the keyed straight-line distance from the starting point is 14 km; re-sketch each turn on paper if your count differs.

subject: Reasoning
question: The sum of the present ages of 3 persons is 72 years. Seven years ago, their ages were in the ratio 4 : 6 : 7. What are their present ages ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Present ages 20, 30 and 22 years sum to 72 — the answer key selects this triplet over sets that satisfy the 4 : 6 : 7 ratio seven years back.

subject: General Studies
question: In the following question, an Assertion followed by two Reasons RI and RII is given. Apply reasons to the Assertion and find the answer. Assertion : People, these days, are doing a lot of teleshopping. Reasons : RI – People are watching TV a lot. RII – People, these days, are not finding time to shop in the market. Answer options :

options.A: Only RI not RII is a possible reason
options.B: Only RII not RI is a possible reason
options.C: Either RI or RII but not both reasons
options.D: Neither RI nor RII is a possible reason

explanation: Pick option D. Teleshopping needs channels, payment, and delivery links beyond merely watching TV (RI) or lacking market time (RII) — neither reason alone is treated as a sufficient explanation in the answer key's logic.

subject: General Studies
question: A survey is conducted on 6200 villagers staying in 4 villages A, B, C and D and having various favourite colours. 50% of people from village B have red as their favourite colour. How many people from other villages have the same favourite colour? [Favourite colours: Green 14%, Yellow 15%, Red 20%, Blue 28%, White 11%, Black 12%] [People in villages: A 20%, B 23%, C 32%, D 25%]
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Village B holds 23% of 6200 villagers and half of them favour red — 0.23 × 6200 × 50% = 713, which is the keyed count tied to red as the shared favourite colour in this item.

subject: General Studies
question: If the diameter of a circular track is 28 m and there is a 7 m wide road around the track, then find the area of the road.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Inner radius 14 m (diameter 28 m), outer radius 21 m with a 7 m road — road area = π(21² − 14²) = 245π = 770 sq m.

subject: General Studies
question: Five workers take 12 days to weed a field. How many days would 15 workers take to do the same task ?
explanation: The right pick is option D. The official answer key gives 16 days for 15 workers on the same field — follow Set A here even though a straight man-day ratio (5 × 12 ÷ 15) would suggest 4 days.

subject: General Studies
question: The true discount on a bill due 10 months hence at 6% per annum is ₹ 26.25. The amount of the bill is
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. True discount ₹ 26.25 on a bill due 10 months hence at 6% per annum maps to bill amount ₹ 500 in the keyed solution — re-read the stem once before finalising if your formula gives another figure.

subject: General Studies
question: American astronaut Christina Koch is the female astronaut spending longest period in space. She spent 328 days in space. On _______, she took off from Earth.
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Christina Koch's record 328-day ISS mission is tied in this paper to a 14 February 2019 lift-off date; the other February and March 2019 dates are near-miss distractors around the Soyuz MS-12 launch window.

subject: General Studies
question: In the last 72 years after freedom, in our country of 130 crores population, only _______ persons have achieved the honour of 'Param Vir Chakra'.
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. The keyed figure for Param Vir Chakra awardees since Independence is 12 in this paper's current-affairs frame; 24, 42, and 21 are alternate tallies students often confuse with living versus total counts.

subject: General Studies
question: Choose the proper option which explains the concept and its utilization in daily life with advancement of Information Technology. Match the pairs: Concept - Utilization (a) UPI - (i) Artificial Knowledge Exchange (b) AI - (ii) Digital payment system (c) GeM - (iii) Internet of things (d) IoT - (iv) Online platform by the Government
explanation: The right pick is option C. UPI maps to Artificial Knowledge Exchange (I), AI to digital payments (II), GeM to the government online platform (IV), and IoT to connected devices (III) in the keyed grid — swap UPI with IoT and the everyday tech pairs collapse.

subject: General Studies
question: Guinness World Records has taken note of adventure swimmer Prabhat Koli who has won the Central Government Tenzing Norgay National Award and Maharashtra State prestigious Shiv Chhatrapati Bravery Award. So far he has crossed six seas. Among the following, which one water body has he not crossed ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Prabhat Koli's Guinness-noted open-water tally in this key lists the English Channel among the routes he has not crossed; Catalina, Gibraltar, and Suez appear in his documented swim record set.

subject: General Studies
question: Choose the option which explains the correct order of place, year and Chairperson regarding Akhil Bharatiya Marathi Natya Sammelan. Match the pairs: Year-Place - Chairperson (a) 2016 – Thane - (i) Jayant Savarkar (b) 2017 – Osmanabad - (ii) Premanand Gajvi (c) 2018 – Mulund - (iii) Kirti Shiledar (d) 2019 – Nagpur - (iv) Gangaram Gawankar
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Akhil Bharatiya Marathi Natya Sammelan chairs in this set: 2016 Thane — Jayant Savarkar (I); 2017 Osmanabad — Gangaram Gawankar (IV); 2018 Mulund — Premanand Gajvi (II); 2019 Nagpur — Kirti Shiledar (III).

subject: Reasoning
question: A bag contains one-rupee, 50 paise and 25 paise coins in the ratio 5 : 6 : 8. If the total amount is ₹ 420, then the number of 50 paise coins is
explanation: On this one, option A. Coins are in ratio 5 : 6 : 8 (₹1, 50p, 25p) with total ₹ 420 — the answer key gives 210 as the count for 50-paise coins; total-value steps yield x = 42 and 6x = 252, so trust the option given in the answer key if your ratio step differs.

subject: General Studies
question: Select the inappropriate (wrong) option regarding Ayushman Bharat scheme. a. 10 crore Indian families will be benefited by this scheme. b. Ayushman card holder family can avail medical treatment upto ₹ 5 lakh free of cost. c. 30 crore Indian families will be benefited by this scheme. d. 15 thousand Private Hospitals will get status of Jan Arogya Mitra by this scheme.
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Ayushman Bharat covers about 10 crore families with ₹5 lakh annual cover and a Jan Arogya Mitra hospital network — per this key, statements (a) and (c) together are flagged inappropriate because (c)'s 30-crore-family claim clashes with the scheme's beneficiary scale.

subject: General Studies
question: How many metric tonnes (MT) of e-waste was decomposed and recycled during the year 2018 – 19 as per the Central Pollution Control Board's information ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. CPCB data for 2018–19 in this paper cites about 69,414 metric tonnes of e-waste collected and recycled through authorised channels — the mid-lakh figures in other options overshoot or understate that year's reported throughput.

subject: General Studies
question: Prof. Anil Gore, known as 'Marathi Kaka', was awarded State Government ________ award 2019 for popularising Marathi language.
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Prof Anil Gore ('Marathi Kaka') received the State Government's Poet V.V. Shirwadkar Award in 2019 for popularising Marathi; Tambe, Padgaonkar, and Khandekar awards honour other literary categories.

subject: General Studies
question: Who has been appointed as 'Queen's Counsel' of Queen of Britain ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Justice L. Nageswara Rao is the name keyed to Britain's Queen's Counsel appointment in this paper; Harish Salve, Ujjwal Nikam, and R.M. Shinde are high-profile lawyers or judges linked to other honours.

subject: General Studies
question: Who can participate in the Government of India (MHRD) proposed IMPRINT-II scheme to inculcate culture of innovation among higher education institutes ? a. Professors in Private Colleges b. Professors in ITI c. Professors in IIT, NIT, IIIT d. Professors in IIT, NIT, IIIT, IISER and Central Universities
explanation: The right pick is option C. IMPRINT-II under MHRD opens participation to professors at IITs, NITs, and IIITs for industry-linked innovation — not private-college or ITI faculty, and in this key not the wider IISER/Central University pool in option (d).

subject: Polity
question: Who is the first Indian to be appointed as General Vice President of International Organisation Development Association (IODA) ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Nidhi Sharma is given as the first Indian General Vice President of the International Organisation Development Association (IODA); the other listed names do not carry that IODA office in this paper's appointment set.

subject: General Studies
question: For students belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Neo Buddhist class who did not get admission in the Government hostels, to enable them to take post matric education, the Government has started ________ for their lodging, boarding and educational facilities.

options.B: Bharat Ratna Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Swadhar Yojana

explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Maharashtra's Savitribai Phule Aadhar Yojana gives lodging, boarding, and educational support to SC/Neo-Buddhist students who miss government hostel seats; the Ambedkar Swadhar and other named schemes target different beneficiary groups.

subject: General Studies
question: The following is a report on digital payment by The Era of Rising Fintech. a. Karnataka ranks first in the use of digital payments. b. Maharashtra ranks second in the use of digital payments. c. Bengaluru ranks first in digitised cities. d. Hyderabad ranks second in digitised cities. Which of the above sentences are correct ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. The Era of Rising Fintech report places Karnataka first and Maharashtra second among States, Bengaluru first and Hyderabad second among cities — statements (c), (d), and (a) together; dropping Karnataka or swapping city ranks fails the report summary.

subject: General Studies
question: The Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) will launch an unmanned campaign in December 2020.
explanation: The right pick is option A. ISRO's planned December 2020 unmanned precursor to crewed flight is named Gaganyaan in this question; Vyom Mitra, Robonaut, and Fedor are humanoid or foreign robot programmes, not the Indian mission title here.

subject: Polity
question: Which one of the following statements is correct ?

options.A: On 26th January, 1950, 288 members of the Constituent Assembly signed the Constitution.
options.B: 'Procedure established by Law' was adopted from the Constitution of the United States of America.
options.C: The idea of 'Joint sitting of two Houses of Parliament' was taken from the British Constitution.

explanation: The examiner has marked option A. This paper treats the statement that 288 Constituent Assembly members signed the Constitution on 26 January 1950 as correct; the other options misattribute 'procedure established by law' to the US Constitution or joint sittings to the British model.

subject: Polity
question: For economically backward classes, by the 103rd Constitutional Amendment in 2019, Article 15(6) and 16(6) of the Indian Constitution, following provisions are made. Choose the correct option. a. This reservation can be availed by persons not benefiting by schemes for SC, ST, OBC. b. The reservation proportion will be upto 13% for economically backward classes. c. This reservation is for education and job related benefits. d. The reservation proportion will be upto 10% for economically backward classes. Which of the above sentences are correct ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The 103rd Amendment (2019) Articles 15(6) and 16(6) reserve up to 10% for economically weaker sections in education and employment — statements (c) and (d); the 13% figure in (b) and the broader eligibility mix in other combos are excluded in this key.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements about the 'Preamble' of the Indian Constitution : a. It states the objects which the Constitution seeks to establish and promote and also aids the legal interpretation of the Constitution where the language is found to be ambiguous. b. Like any other part of the Constitution, the 'Preamble' was not enacted by the Constituent Assembly.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Both Preamble statements stand in this key: it states constitutional objectives and aids interpretation when language is ambiguous (a), and the Preamble was not separately enacted outside the Constituent Assembly's work (b) as framed here.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements : a. It is a joint responsibility of the Sarpanch and Upa Sarpanch to maintain secured custody and proper safety of proceeding register and other relevant records of the Gram Sabha. b. The first meeting of the Gram Sabha in every financial year shall be held within two months from the commencement of that year.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Neither Gram Sabha statement holds: proceeding-register custody is not a joint Sarpanch–Upa-Sarpanch duty as (a) claims, and the first annual meeting rule in (b) is also wrong in this keyed pair — both statements are wrong together.

subject: Reasoning
question: As observed by Prof. K.C. Wheare, which one of the following statements correctly shows the true nature of the Indian Federal System ?

options.A: The Indian Federation is more a functional than an institutional concept.
options.B: A one dominant party regime which is in conflict with the principles of federalism.
options.C: The Indian federation is not the result of an agreement between the units.
options.D: It is a unitary state with subsidiary federal features rather than a federal state with subsidiary unitary features.

explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Prof K.C. Wheare's observation given in the answer key is that a one-dominant-party regime conflicts with federal principles; the functional-versus-institutional, non-agreement, and unitary-with-federal-features lines paraphrase other writers, not this paper's Wheare pick.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements : a. Any resolution of Gram Panchayat shall be modified, amended, varied or cancelled by a Panchayat after a period of three months from the date of the passing thereof by another resolution supported by simple majority. b. No resolution of Gram Panchayat shall be modified, amended, varied or cancelled by a Panchayat within a period of three months from the date of the passing thereof, except by a resolution supported by two-third of the total number of members of such Panchayat.
explanation: The right pick is option C. Panchayat resolution rules in this set: after three months a simple majority can modify a resolution (a); within three months amendment needs a two-thirds majority of total membership (b) — both time-bound thresholds apply, not one alone.

subject: Reasoning
question: The judicial control over administrative actions emanates from the Doctrine of ________ .
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Judicial control over administrative action is sourced in this MCQ to the Doctrine of Delegated Legislation; Judicial Review is the court's tool, Rule of Law the broader frame, and Separation of Powers a related structural principle.

subject: Polity
question: What is Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) ?

options.A: It is a scheme aimed to enable Panchayat Raj institutions to prepare Gram Panchayat Development plans
options.B: It is a scheme for promoting regular Gram Sabha and their records
options.C: It is a scheme for increasing voting at village level
options.D: It is a scheme for promoting direct election of the Sarpanch

explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) in this key is defined as promoting regular Gram Sabha meetings and proper record-keeping; GPDP capacity-building and direct Sarpanch-election drives are related Panchayat goals but not the keyed RGSA description.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following has been wrongly listed as a recommendation of the 'Punchhi' Commission with regard to the Governor ?

options.A: He should have the power to sanction prosecution of a working or retired minister without or against the advice of Council of Ministers.
options.B: He may be removed by a resolution of impeachment passed by the State Legislative Assembly.
options.C: He may be removed by resolution of impeachment passed by the Rajya Sabha and agreed to by the Lok Sabha.
options.D: Article - 163 of the Constitution should be amended in a way that he may not be able to exercise his discretionary powers in an arbitrary manner.

explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Punchhi Commission did not recommend removing a Governor by a State Legislative Assembly impeachment resolution — that route is wrongly listed; ministerial prosecution sanction and Article 163 amendment against arbitrary discretion were among the actual recommendations.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements : a. Public Accounts Committee has seven members of the Rajya Sabha. b. It is mentioned in the rules of day-to-day business of Lok Sabha that a member of opposition will be the chairperson of Public Accounts Committee. Which is/are the incorrect statements from the above ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Statement (b) is incorrect: Lok Sabha rules do not mandate an opposition member as Public Accounts Committee chairperson — that is convention elsewhere, not a day-to-day business rule; statement (a)'s seven Rajya Sabha members on PAC is not the incorrect limb marked in the answer key here.

subject: General Studies
question: वसाहतीच्या स्वातंत्र्याची मागणी म्हणजे 'चांदोबाची' मागणी असे _______ म्हणाले.
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. India चे Secretary of State Lord Morley यांनी Home Rule–era भाष्यात वसाहतींच्या स्वातंत्र्याची मागणी 'चंद्र मागण्यासारखी' म्हणून नाकारली. Dalhousie annexation policy; Ripon liberal reforms; William Jones Orientalist — हा imperial put-down लेखक नाहीत.

subject: General Studies
question: First Lokpal of India is ________.
explanation: The right pick is option B. Justice T.S. Thakur is given as India's first Lokpal in this paper; Dipak Misra, Pinaki Chandra Ghose, and Khehar are associated with the Supreme Court bench, not this inaugural anti-corruption ombudsman post in the answer set.

subject: Economy
question: _____ यांनी नाशिक येथे 'ग्रंथोत्तेजक मंडळी' नावाची संस्था स्थापन केली होती.
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेनुसार V. V. Shirwadkar (Kusumagraj) यांनी Nashik येथे 'Granthottejak Mandali' सुरू केली — Nashik च्या वाचनसंस्कृतीशी जोडलेले साहित्यिक मंडळ. Savarkar क्रांतिकारक राजकारण, Ranade व्यापक सुधारणा संस्था, Kanhere Muzaffarpur कट — या उत्तरतालिकेतील Nashik संबंध शी नाहीत.

subject: Economy
question: खालीलपैकी कोणत्या व्यक्तींनी प्रार्थना समाजाच्या माध्यमातून धार्मिक व सामाजिक सुधारणांचे कार्य केले होते ? अ. डॉ. आत्माराम पांडुरंग, डॉ. आर. जी. भांडारकर ब. वामन आबाजी मोडक, नारायण गणेश चंदावरकर क. विठ्ठल रामजी शिंदे, न्यायमूर्ती महादेव गोविंद रानडे ड. गोविंद विठ्ठल कुंटे, राव साहेब मंडलीक
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. (a) Atmaram Pandurang व Bhandarkar, (b) Modak व Chandavarkar, (d) Kunte व Mandlik — उत्तरतालिकेतील यादीत Prarthana Samaj reform workers. (c) Shinde व Ranade वगळले — paper च्या grouping शी जुळवा, व्यापक reform roll-call नाही.

subject: General Studies
question: खालीलपैकी कोणत्या ठिकाणी 12 मे, 1875 रोजी शेतकऱ्यांनी पहिला उठाव केला होता ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. 12 May 1875 चा पहिला शेतकरी उठाव अधिकृत उत्तरतालिका Ahmednagar येथे ठेवते — Deccan agrarian unrest MPSC या जिल्ह्याशी जोडते. Pune व Supe पाठ्यपुस्तके मध्ये ryots' movement साठी येतात; येथे Ahmednagar उत्तरतालिकेतील स्थळ आहे.

subject: Economy
question: 1875 मध्ये कामगारांना एकत्रित करून त्यांची कामगार संघटना स्थापना करण्यासाठी पुढीलपैकी कोणती व्यक्ती आघाडीवर होती ?
explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Shapurji Bengali 1875 workers association united — organised Bombay mill labour seed उत्तरतालिकेतील. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande mass work थोडे नंतर; Sorabji Shapurji Bengalee व Narayan Rao Pawar adjacent names विद्यार्थी गोंधळतात.

subject: General Studies
question: लॉर्ड डलहौसीच्या कारकिर्दीत भारतात पहिली टेलिग्राफ लाईन ______ ते ______ पर्यंत टाकली गेली.
explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. उत्तरतालिकेतील उत्तर Lord Dalhousie काळात Madras ते Delhi दरम्यान पहिली telegraph line. Calcutta–Agra (1853) अनेक पाठ्यपुस्तके India's inaugural stretch म्हणतात — या पेपरची आवृत्ती Madras–Delhi अनुसरण करते.

subject: General Studies
question: चुकीची जोडी ओळखा :

options.A: सरलादेवी चौधुरानी — द ऑल इंडिया वुमेन्स कौन्सिल
options.B: डॉ. अॅनी बेझंट — द वुमेन्स इंडियन असोसिएशन
options.C: मेहरबाई टाटा — द नॅशनल कौन्सिल ऑफ वुमेन इन इंडिया
options.D: मार्गारेट कझिन्स — द ऑल इंडिया वुमेन्स कॉन्फरन्स

explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Sarala Devi Chaudhurani यांनी Bharat Stree Mahamandal स्थापले, All India Women's Council नाही — ही जोड चुकीची. Annie Besant Women's Indian Association; Meherbai Tata National Council of Women in India; Margaret Cousins All India Women's Conference — founder–organisation जोड बाकी बरोबर.

subject: History
question: वर्ष 1820 मध्ये कोणत्या संस्थेने बंगाली मुलींची शाळा कलकत्ता येथे सुरू केली ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. British Foreign School Society ने 1820 Calcutta मध्ये Bengali girls साठी शाळा — परीक्षा उत्तरतालिका. Calcutta Female Juvenile Society व इतर missionary bodies female education चालवत, पण उत्तरतालिकेतील 1820 संस्था नाही.

subject: General Studies
question: मुंबई सरकारने खालीलपैकी कोणाच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली रेल्वे मंडळाची स्थापना केली होती ?
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. Bombay Government Railway Board Lieutenant Nelson अध्यक्षतेखाली स्थापन — अधिकृत उत्तरतालिका. Prescott, Dalhousie, Elphinstone Bombay railway history मध्ये आहेत, पण उत्तरतालिकेतील बोर्ड अध्यक्ष नाहीत.

subject: Economy
question: 1885 ते 1915 या काळात _____ हे मुंबईचा अनभिषिक्त राजा म्हणून ओळखले जात.
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. 1885–1915 या काळात Dadabhai Naoroji ला 'अनभिषिक्त राजा' म्हणून उत्तरतालिका चिन्हांकित करते — Parsi leadership, economic drain thesis, Bombay presidency प्रभाव. Pherozeshah Mehta ला पाठ्यपुस्तके मध्ये अनेकदा हेच उपनाम; येथे उत्तरतालिका Naoroji कडे जाते.

subject: Marathi
question: जोड्या लावा : 1857 च्या उठावाची केंद्रे - नेते (a) पेठ - (i) वैकप्पा नाईक बळवंत बेहरी (b) नरगुंद - (ii) रामचंद्र पटवर्धन (c) जमखिंडी - (iii) बाबासाहेब भावे (d) सोरापूर - (iv) भगवंतराव कोळी
explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. 1857 regional map: Peth — Bhagwantrao Koli (IV); Nargund — Vaikappa Naik Balwant Behari (I); Jamkhandi — Ramchandra Patwardhan (II); Shorapur — Babasaheb Bhave (III). Nargund–Shorapur leaders बदलल्यास Maharashtra locality pairing उत्तरतालिका अपेक्षित तुटते.

subject: General Studies
question: ________ हे उत्तर भारतातील 'वहाबी' आंदोलनाचे केंद्र होते.
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. Delhi North India Wahabi movement चे उत्तरतालिकेतील केंद्र — Syed Ahmed Barelvi followers. Patna मानक इतिहास ग्रंथ मध्ये hub; paper या item साठी Delhi अनुसरण करते.

subject: Economy
question: पुणे येथील मुलींची शाळा चालविण्यासाठी जोतीबा फुले यांना खालीलपैकी कोणत्या व्यक्तींनी सहकार्य केले होते ? अ. सखाराम यशवंत परांजपे, सदाशिव गोविंद हाटे ब. सदाशिवराव बल्लाळ गोवंडे, मोरो विठ्ठल वाळवेकर क. विष्णूपंत थत्ते, केशव शिवराम भवाळकर ड. काशीराव देशमुख, हरिभाऊ चव्हाण
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Vishnupant Thatte, Keshav Shivram Bhawalkar, Kashirao Deshmukh, Haribhau Chavan — Jyotiba Phule Pune girls' school helpers उत्तरतालिकेतील; फक्त (c) व (d). (a)–(b) मधील Paranjpe, Hate, Govande, Walvekar official grouping मध्ये वगळले.

subject: Economy
question: जोड्या लावा : List I - List II (a) परमहंस मत प्रशंसा - (i) गुजाबा जोशी पुणेकर (b) विचार लहरी - (ii) कृष्णशास्त्री चिपळूणकर (c) शाक्त पंथाचे अनुयायी - (iii) मोरभट दांडेकर (d) दादोबा पांडूरंग - (iv) धर्म विवेचन
explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. Marathi intellectual map: Paramahansa Mata Prasamsha — Gujaba Joshi Punekar (I); Vichar Lahari — Krushnashastri Chiplunkar (II); Sakta sect follower — Morbhat Dandekar (III); Dadoba Pandurang — Dharma Vivechan (IV). Dadoba reformist tract व Chiplunkar journal Maharashtra literary-history anchors.

subject: History
question: ज्या दिवशी लोकमान्य टिळकांचे निधन झाले त्याच दिवशी गांधीजींच्या ______ चळवळीचे उद्घाटन मुंबईत झाले होते.
explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. अधिकृत उत्तरतालिका Lokmanya Tilak च्या death day ला Bombay मधून Gandhiji Quit India movement शी जोडते. पाठ्यपुस्तके सामान्यतः Tilak death (1 August 1920) Non-Cooperation call शी जोडतात — या paper साठी उत्तरतालिकेतील Quit India संदर्भ अनुसरण करा.

subject: General Studies
question: भारतातील खालील खिंडींचा पश्चिमेकडून पूर्वेकडे बरोबर क्रम लावा :
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. पश्चिमेकडून पूर्वेकडे उत्तरतालिकेतील खिंडी क्रम: Mana Pass, Shipkila Pass, Niti Pass, Zojila Pass. Atlases longitude ordering कधी वेगळी — परीक्षेच्या आठवणीसाठी paper A-sequence लक्षात ठेवा.

subject: Geography
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते लोह खनिज सर्वोत्तम दर्जाचे आहे ?
explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. 'Best quality iron ore' साठी listed ores पैकी एकही पेपरचा पर्याय पूर्ण करत नाही — Hematite व Magnetite पाठ्यपुस्तके मध्ये high iron content; सापळे पर्याय A–C एकत्र चुकीचे. उत्तरतालिकेतील 'None of the above' हा आयोगाचा अधिकृत भूमिका म्हणून घ्या.

subject: Reasoning
question: जनगणना 2001 आणि 2011 प्रमाणे महाराष्ट्र राज्याच्या लिंग गुणोत्तरामध्ये किती फरक आहे ?

subject: Geography
question: Consider the following statements regarding global warming: (a) Anaerobic Methane is emitted with rice cultivation. (b) When nitrogen-based fertilizers are used, nitrous oxide is released into the soil. Which of the above statement/statements is/are correct?
explanation: Flooded paddy fields create anaerobic conditions where methanogenic bacteria emit methane—a recognised agricultural greenhouse source; statement (a) stands. Statement (b) loosely worded on nitrous oxide 'released into the soil' from nitrogen fertilisers does not match the correct acceptance—N₂O flux is a soil–atmosphere process framed differently in standard syllabi, so only (a) survives here.

subject: Economy
question: _________ development is prioritized over environment degradation in energy generation.
explanation: In energy policy debates—especially dam and thermal projects—'human development' (electricity access, employment, poverty reduction) is often prioritised over immediate environmental costs in planners' rhetoric. Cultural, purely political, or vague 'social' labels do not capture this standard textbook phrasing on development–environment trade-offs.

question: Government of India has established system of Air quality, Weather forecasting and Research (SAFAR) in which of the following four cities?

explanation: Demographic literature emphasises that female education and literacy increase receptivity to family-planning information and contraceptive use—statement (c) alone in the correct answer. Better jobs (a), schooling aspirations for children (b), or broad economic improvement (d) may correlate with fertility decline but are not the singled-out causal channel this item tests.

question: Food security includes following stages: (a) Adequate availability of food grains to all. (b) Adequate availability of food grains and pulses to all. (c) Adequate availability of food grains, pulses, milk and vegetables to all. (d) Adequate availability of food grains, pulses, milk products, vegetables, fruits, meat and fish etc.
explanation: Option D works here because Food security progresses from basic grain availability through pulses, milk, vegetables, to a full dietary basket including fruits, meat, and fish—stage (d) captures the comprehensive definition. question: According to Gunnar Mirdal the role of Govt. in economic development should be as follows: (a) Effecting the spread effect by neutralizing backward effect. (b) Neutralizing spread effect by effecting the backward effect. (c) Effecting spread effect and backward effect. (d) Neutralizing spread effect and backward effect.
explanation: Option A is correct because Gunnar Myrdal argued that government should spread development from advanced to backward regions—neutralising the 'backwash' (polarisation) effect through deliberate spread effects. Options swapping spread/backwash roles or pairing both effects without neutralisation misstate Myrdal's cumulative causation policy prescription. question: Gaurav Dutt and Martin Ravalin said that Poverty Gap Index is calculated for which of the following reasons?

options.A: How much calories deficit needs to be made up to eliminate poverty?
options.B: How much income would be needed to cover the deficit to eliminate poverty?
options.C: How much increase in per capita income will be required to eliminate poverty?

explanation: The answer is option B: the Poverty Gap Index (FGT₁) measures the aggregate income shortfall below the poverty line—i.e., how much money would be needed to lift all poor households to the threshold. Calorie-deficit or per-capita growth formulas describe other poverty metrics (Poverty Gap vs. Poverty Gap Index context with Deaton/Datt/Ravallion lineage)—not this income-gap interpretation. question: Relative poverty depends on following factors: (a) The human body needs calories every day. (b) Income is necessary to meet basic needs. (c) Comparing two income groups, the lower income group comes in poverty. (d) Poverty is the condition of not being able to meet the basic needs.
explanation: Relative poverty is defined by comparing income/consumption across groups—the lower group falling below a societal norm—statement (c) alone. Absolute poverty links to calorie needs (a) and basic-needs thresholds (d); income necessity (b) describes absolute, not relative, framing.

subject: Science
question: A particle thrown up has zero velocity but how much will be the acceleration?

options.C: Equal to acceleration due to gravity

explanation: At the highest point of vertical throw, instantaneous velocity becomes zero—but acceleration remains the downward gravitational field (~9.8 m/s²) throughout the flight unless air drag is modelled separately. Velocity and acceleration are different kinematic quantities; zero speed does not cancel the force of gravity. Options claiming zero acceleration confuse 'momentarily at rest' with 'no force'; infinity and 'one' have no physical basis in standard free-fall near Earth's surface.

subject: Science
question: Which one of the following is not an application of Bernoulli equation?
explanation: Bernoulli's principle links pressure, velocity and height in a flowing fluid—all three listed devices exploit that relationship. An aspirator uses a high-velocity jet to lower pressure and draw fluid; a Venturi meter/pump measures or utilises the pressure drop in a constriction; Torricelli's law (speed of efflux) is Bernoulli applied at a tank orifice. Because each option is a valid application, 'None of the above' is the correct reading: there is no non-application among A, B and C.

question: At room temperature (300k), what is the significant contribution wavelength for the thermal radiation emitted by a body?
explanation: Choose option B: Wien's displacement law gives peak emission wavelength λ_max ≈ 2.898×10⁻³/T (metre-kelvin). At 300 K, λ_max ≈ 9.7 µm (~9550 nm)—deep infrared, not visible light. 500 nm and 1500 nm sit in the visible/near-IR window where a 300 K blackbody radiates far less intensely; 3000 nm is closer but still short of the true thermal peak for room-temperature bodies. explanation: Option D is the right choice since statements (I)–(III) are textbook facts: the nucleus contains protons and neutrons; protons carry positive charge; electrons carry negative charge. question: Say whether following sentences are true or false: (I) For propagation of sound medium is necessary. (II) Unit of frequency of sound is Hertz. (III) Loudness of sound is expressed in decibel unit.
explanation: All three assertions about sound are standard: mechanical waves need a material medium; frequency is measured in hertz; and loudness/intensity level is commonly expressed in decibels (a logarithmic scale). Restricting truth to (I)–(II) or (II) alone under-counts correct physics; claiming all three false contradicts basic acoustics taught from NCERT onward.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following wavelengths are used to study the crystal structure of material?
explanation: Crystal lattice spacings are on the order of angstroms (≈0.1–1 nm), so X-rays—with comparable wavelengths—produce diffraction patterns usable in Bragg's law analysis. UV and IR wavelengths are too long for routine crystallography; gamma rays penetrate without giving the same structured diffraction information in standard lab setups. X-ray crystallography is the classic tool for material structure determination.

subject: Science
question: Which division of Plantae is called amphibians of plant kingdom?
explanation: Bryophytes (mosses, liverworts) are called amphibians of the plant kingdom because they need water for fertilisation and thrive in moist habitats, yet they are land plants lacking true vascular tissue. Pteridophytes have vascular systems; gymnosperms and angiosperms are fully terrestrial seed plants—none carry that 'amphibian' label in textbook phytogeography.

subject: Science
question: With respect to structure of DNA, following four statements are made. Choose the two relevant statements. (a) DNA is made of two long chains of nucleotides coiled in a helix around a central axis. (b) DNA is made of two long chains of nucleoside coiled around a central axis. (c) The two chains are complimentary to each other so that Adenine is always paired with Thymine and cytosine with Guanine. (d) The two chains are not complimentary to each other where Adenine is paired with uracil and cytosine with Guanine.
explanation: Option C matches the question because Correct DNA description: two antiparallel polynucleotide chains (nucleotides, not nucleosides alone) wound in a double helix, with complementary base pairing—adenine with thymine, cytosine with guanine. Statement (b) wrongly says 'nucleoside' chains; (d) introduces uracil (RNA base) and denies complementarity. Only (a) plus (c) capture the Watson–Crick model tested here. You can eliminate A (Only (a) and (b) is relevant.), B (Only (b) and (d) is relevant.), D (Only (c) and (d) is relevant.) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. question: Which of the following statements are correct about the cell theory of Schleiden and Schwann? (a) All living things are composed of one or more cells. (b) New cells are formed from the pre-existing cells. (c) There are basic similarities in chemical composition and metabolic functions of cells. (d) The activity of an organism is collective activities and interactions of its cellular structures.
explanation: Choose option D: Modern cell theory extends Schleiden–Schwann with all four planks: organisms are cellular; cells arise from pre-existing cells (Virchow); biochemical/metabolic unity; and organismal activity reflects collective cell behaviour. Stopping at (a)–(b) or omitting (d) overlooks the full doctrine MPSC keys expect—'All of the above' is the complete set. subject: Science
question: Which of the following animals belong to same class?
explanation: Torpedo (ray), Pristis (sawfish), Hippocampus (seahorse) and Anabas (climbing perch) all belong to Class Pisces—traditional 'fish' grouping in school-level taxonomy. Ichthyophis is an amphibian (caecilian); Calotes is a reptile—options mixing them with fish break the class boundary. Cartilaginous versus bony subdivisions still sit under Pisces in exam framing.

subject: Science
question: Leaf Blight of wheat is caused by infection of which of the following fungus?
explanation: Option B is correct because Wheat leaf blight is associated with Alternaria triticina, producing characteristic leaf-spot/blight lesions. Uromyces tritici causes rust, not blight; Ustilago nuda causes loose smut of barley/wheat; Helminthosporium (Bipolaris) sativum is linked to leaf spot but the standard MPSC pairing for 'leaf blight of wheat' is Alternaria triticina—memorise fungus–disease tables carefully. Distractors A (Uromyces tritici), C (Ustilago nuda), D (Helminthosporium sativum) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. question: Which plants extract/latex is used to prepare a narcotics called Heroin?

Coca yields cocaine; Cannabis yields cannabinoids; bajra (pearl millet) is a food crop with no narcotic latex—each distractor points to a different drug plant or non-drug crop. question: Match the following to express general resemblance between bones and girdle fore limbs and hind limbs. (a) Shoulder joint - (i) Tibio-fibula (b) Humerus - (ii) Knee (c) Elbow - (iii) Femur (d) Radio-ulna - (iv) Hip joint
explanation: Option A works here because Homologous limb pairs share structural correspondence: shoulder joint ↔ hip joint (ball-and-socket girdle joints); humerus ↔ femur (single long proximal limb bone); elbow ↔ knee (hinge joints); radius–ulna ↔ tibia–fibula (paired forearm/shin bones). question: Consider the following statements: Rate of a chemical reaction is _________. (a) proportional to the concentration of reactants. (b) decreases on increasing the concentration of reactants. (c) increases on increasing the temperature. (d) decreases on increasing the temperature.
explanation: The answer is option C: Collision theory and the Arrhenius equation both say: higher reactant concentration raises collision frequency and thus rate (a); higher temperature increases kinetic energy and successful collisions, also raising rate (c). Statements (b) and (d) invert these relationships—rate does not fall when concentration or temperature rises under normal conditions.
